Omuntu yali angambye, emyaka mingi oluvannyuma lw'okufa kwe, nti “John M. Whitall yali omusajja asinga okwagalibwa mu Philadelphia,” era mu bibiina ebimu, nkakasa nti kino kyali kya mazima. Maama naye yali ayagalibwa mu ngeri y'emu. Yali maama asanyusa nnyo, oboolyawo nga taalina ssanyu lingi nga taata, naye bulijjo nga yeeteeseteese okulwanirira ensonga y'abaana be buli wantu era mu biseera byonna, era nga lwazi lwe tuddukiramu olutalemererwa mu buli kabenje. Obuwoomi n'obulungi, obutukuvu n'amazima, byalabika nga biva mu kubaawo kwe okw'ekisa; era, eri buli muntu eyamusisinkananga, yali muzzi wa maanyi eri buli kirungi era ekisaanidde. Abantu mu nnaku zino boogera ku mbeera y'empewo eyeetoolodde buli omu ku ffe, ekintu ekifaanana n'ekitangaala ekibulijjo kisiigibwa okwetooloola emitwe gy'abatukuvu. Bagamba nti kirabika ng'ekibikka ku mubiri gwonna, era nti kikwata ku bulungi oba ku bubi ku bonna abasembera okumpi nakyo. Kiyitibwa “aura,” era kye kivaamu mu mpisa za buli muntu n'obuntu bwe obw'omunda ennyo. Ezimu ku aura, batugamba, za kizikiza era za nnaku, era zireeta obunafu wadde n'akabi, ate endala za langi ya kimuli, oba za zaabu, oba za langi z'amayinja ag'omuwendo, oba za bbululu ery'eggulu nga zijjudde ekitangaala, era enkwatagana yaazo esanyusa era ezzaamu amaanyi; era bino byonna oboolyawo nga tewali kigambo kyogeddwa mu mbeera zonna zombi. Singa endowooza eno ya mazima, mpulira nga nkakasa nti taata ne maama bange baalina “aura” ezijjudde omusana gw'eggulu gwennyini, era, awatali kumanya nsonga, abaana baabwe baabeeranga mu ssanyu ery'olubeerera. Nti obwana obwabeezebwa bwe butyo tebwandiremeddwa kubaako kukwatako kunene ku byafaayo eby'oluvannyuma eby'emmeeme yonna kirabika gye ndi nga kya mazima ddala, era okuzuula kwange okwasembayo era okumatiza okwa Kitange ali mu Ggulu nkuwa nnyo ku ekyo kye nnali mmanyi ku bulungi bw'abazadde bange ab'oku nsi. Tebaayogeranga bingi ku ddiini, kubanga entiisa y'Abakwaka ey'okweyingiza wakati w'emmeeme n'Omutonzi waayo yali ezze eleeta empisa y'okusirika okwali tekwanguyirwa kumenyebwa, naye baalaganga mu lwatu nti obulamu bwabwe bwabeezebwanga mu kitundu eky'okukkiriza okw'amazima ku Katonda abeerawo bulijjo. Twali tetuyinza butalaba nti gy'abo yali wa mazima okusukka amazima gonna amalala. Ku kuyigirizibwa okw'eddiini, twalina katono; naye ku kyokulabirako eky'eddiini n'obuyinza bwakwo, twalina omugabo ogutaggwaawo. Si lwa kwogera, wabula lwa kubeera obulamu obwa buli lunaku, ebifaananyi lwe byateekebwa ku mitima gyaffe egy'obwana. Nzijukira lumu, wabula, taata bwe yayogera okuva mu kujjula kw'omutima gwe, era kye yayogera bwe kyanteekako ekifaananyi ekikwata nnyo era eky'olubeerera. Nnali mwana alowooleza nnyo ebintu, kyennava ntya nnyo ekizikiza, kye nnajjuzanga ebisolo eby'entiisa eby'engeri zonna, nga byekwese wansi w'ebitanda oba emabega w'enzigi, nga byeteeseteese okufubutuka ne binkokkola mu kaseera konna. Mazima ddala, olw'okusirika okungi okw'obwana, saakyogerako, naye mu ngeri emu taata ku nkomerero n'ategeera nti ntya ekizikiza, era mu kifo ky'okusekerera entiisa yange oba okunnenya, nga bwe nnawulira mu mutima gwange omuto ogw'obunaku era ogw'obusirusiru nti kye nsaanira olw'okuleeta oluyoogaano bwe lutyo, yaŋŋamba n'okwagala, n'anteeka ku vviivi lye, era ng'anzingiza omukono gwe omwagalwa ogw'amaanyi, n'ayogera, mu ddoboozi ery'obukakafu obungi ennyo, nti, “Lwaki, Han, tewamanya nti tewabaawo kintu na kimu eky'okutya? Tewamanya nti Kitaawo ali mu Ggulu abeera naawe bulijjo, era nti mazima ddala anaakulabiriranga bulijjo?” Era nga nkyakankana era nga njugumira, yayongerako, ng'eyeewuunya nti wandibaddewo omuntu yenna mu nsi atamanyi kino, nti, “Nnalowooza nti, mazima ddala, wamanyi kino, mwana wange.” Sirijja kwerabira ekifaananyi ekikwata ennyo kino kye kyanteekako, wadde okuweebwa eddembe okuva mu ntiisa amangwago era okw'olubeerera kwe kyampa; era bulijjo mbadde nkakasa nti okwogera kuno okumu okw'ekintu eky'amazima, okwali eri taata ekintu eky'amazima ekisinga obukulu mu bulamu bwe, kwe kwasinga ekintu kirala kyonna okukolagana n'okuwulira okumatiza okw'okubaawo kwa Katonda okumaze ebbanga eddene nga gwe mugabo gwange. Si nkola ya ddiini, taata gye yategeeza ku mukolo guno oguteerabirwa, wabula kyali kintu kya mazima, ekyangu, ekitawakanyizibwa, kye yeewuunya nti nze saamanya; era, olw'okuba nga kwe kwogera ekintu eky'amazima, kyali kikubagiza nnyo okusinga obuweereza bwonna oba empaka zonna bwe zaali ziyinza okubeera. Katonda yali nange, era ekyo kyali kimala; kubanga mazima ddala, olw'okuba nga ali nange, yandindabiridde nga kya butonde. Nzijukira nti taata bwe yampannula okuva ku maviivi ge n'aŋŋamba n'essanyu nti nzirukemu era nti nneme kuddayo kutya, nnatambula mu ngeri ey'ekitiibwa, nga mpulira nga mu ngeri emu ndi bulungi munda mu kigo ekitalabika mwe nnasobolera okusekerera n'okunyooma ebisolo byonna eby'entiisa ebyekwese eby'ekizikiza, era nga nsobola okuwulira okuwuuma kwabyo okw'obusungu awatali kutya. Nteeba nti obutabaawo bulijjo bw'okuyigiriza kwonna okw'eddiini okw'obutereevu okuva eri abazadde baffe kwayamba okufuula ebiseera ebitono lwe baayogera okuba ebisikiriza okusingawo; naye, ka kibe bwe kityo, nsobola okwogera mu mazima nti, wadde nga emirundi mingi byabikkibwako okumala akaseera, obukakafu obw'omukolo ogwo bubadde bulijjo nange mu ntobo, era emirundi enkumi n'enkumi mu bulamu bwange okuva olwo, ebigambo bya taata mu kiseera ekyo bindeetedde obuyambi.

fields.title: Obwana Bwange nga Omukwaka
fields.body_html:
Oluvannyuma lw'obuyinza obuzadde bwange bwe bwatuusa ku bulamu bwange obwo obw'obuvubuka, waaliwo obuyinza obw'Ekibiina eky'eddiini kye nnasaliddwa okuba omunnamu okuva we nnazaalibwa. Sirowooza nti kyandinsobose okwogera mu bigambo engeri obuyinza buno gye bwali obw'amaanyi era nga busaasaanidde mu buli kimu. Buli kigambo, endowooza, n'ekikolwa eky'obulamu bwaffe byali binnyikiziddwa mu Bukwaka. Tewaali kadde na kamu lwe twava mu bwo.

Si kubanga twali twagala okuva mu bwo, kubanga tetwamanya kirala eky'enjawulo; naye, nga olugero lwange bwe lulaga, buli kika ky'okutegeera kwaffe kyali kijjuliddwa era kirimibwa bwo. Buli lunaku, nneebaza Katonda kubanga bwali buyinza obw'obutuukirivu era obugulumiza omuntu.

Naye newankubadde bwe bwali obw'amaanyi bwe butyo mu bulamu bwaffe, Obukwaka obw'ekiseera kyange tebwaleeta buyinza bwabwo ku bw'okuyigiriza okungi okw'ebweru. Ekimu ku bye baakkiririzaamu ennyo kyali eky'okuyigiriza okw'omunda okuva eri Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutuukira ku buli mwoyo, era kino kyaziyiza okuyigiriza okungi okuva mu kamwa k'omuntu. Abakwaka baakkiriza nga bituufu ddala ebigambo by'Omutume Yokaana nti waliwo “Omusana ogw'amazima ogumulisa buli muntu ajja mu nsi,” era okuyigiriza kwabwe okusookerwako kwali nti “Omusana” guno, singa gunoonyezebwa era gugonderwa n'obwesigwa, gwandikulembedde buli muntu okumutuusa mu mazima gonna. Kyebava balowooza nti kyandibadde kutawaanya wakati w'omwoyo n'Omukulembeze waagwo n'Omuyigiriza waagwo ow'Ekika kya Katonda okuyingiza okuyigiriza kwonna okw'omuntu obuntu. Baatuyigiriza okuwuliriza n'okugondera eddoboozi lya Katonda mu myoyo gyaffe, era baakkiriza nti singa twakikola okusinziira ku kutegeera kwaffe okusinga, Omukulembeze waffe ow'Ekika kya Katonda yandituyigirizza byonna bye kyetaagisa ffe okumanya ku by'enjigiriza oba ku nzikiriza.

Waaliwo ekintu eky'ekitiibwa mu kutegeera kuno okw'obuntu bw'omuntu ng'omuntu obwo. Kwaleka buli mwoyo mu bwetwaze obutuufu mu maaso g'Omutonzi waagwo, nga gweteefuteefu okuyigirizibwa butereevu okuva gy'ali, awatali kutawaanya kw'omuntu yenna, okuggyako ng'omuntu oyo aluubiddwa Katonda yennyini. Era newankubadde mu nnaku zange ez'obuvubuka saakiteekateeka mu bigambo mu bulambulukufu, wabula embeera gye kwaleeta, n'ekitiibwa eky'obuntu kye kwawa buli mwoyo gw'omuntu — oba gw'amagezi oba gwa bunafu, oba gugagga oba mwavu, oba guyize oba gutayize, oba gwakadde oba gwato — kyakola buli omu ku ffe okuwulira okuva mu nnaku zaffe ezisooka obwetwaze obw'omunda obw'obwakabaka nga tewali muntu, ne bazadde baffe, ayinza kubukwatako.

Bibbuli bwe yatusomerwa, ekintu ekyakolebwanga emirundi mingi, naddala ku ttuntu z'“Olunaku Olusooka,” tewaali nnyinnyonnyola ngi eyagezebwako. Mu kifo ky'ekyo, akaseera akatono ak'okusirika okunene kaakuumibwanga ku nkomerero y'okusoma, olwo “Omusana ogw'omunda” gusobole, singa kiba nga Katonda ky'ayagala, okututegeeza amakulu g'ekyo ekyali kisomeddwa. Naye, ntya nti nze kennyini, nnali nkyali nga sinnazuukuka nnyo, ekyandinnyinnyonnyolebbwako kingi. Naye okuwulira kuno kwali kwa maanyi nnyo mu Bakwaka mu nnaku zange nti okuyigiriza okw'eddiini okutereevu okuva mu kamwa k'abantu, okuggyako mu kubuulira okwaluubiddwa, bulijjo kwandinnabonekedde nga kwa nsi — kwa nsi. Nnawulira nga kwali kirungi eri “abantu b'ensi” bokka, abo, olw'obutamanya kwabwe ku Musana ogw'omunda, be baalina okwetaaga okutunula ebweru olw'okuyigirizibwa. Mu butuufu, okunnyonnyola kwonna okwa Bayibbuli, okuggyako okwo okwandibadde kuluubiddwa butereevu, kwawulirwanga nga kwa nsi; era ekibiina ky'okuyiga Bayibbuli n'amasomero g'oku Ssande byali bitwalibwa ng'ebifo eby'okwesanyusa okw'ensi, nga tewali Mukwaka mutuufu yenna asaanidde kubaagalako. Okuyigirizibwa kwaffe kwali kutuukira, so si okuva mu kamwa k'abayigiriza abantu, wabula okuva mu ddoboozi ery'omunda ery'Omuyigiriza ow'Ekika kya Katonda yennyini.

Mu kino, Emikwano egy'edda gyakkiriza bokka ekyo Awomutukuvu Agusitino kye yayigiriza bwe yagamba nti: “Ye Mukama ow'omunda ayigiriza, ye kuluusanyizibwa okuyigiriza; ng'okuluusanyizibwa n'okufukibwako amafuta tebiriiwo, tekiriiko makulu nti ebigambo eby'ebweru bikubibwa munda.”

Kyebava okubuulira kwabwe okusinga kwakolebwa mu kubuulirira okuwuliriza “eliraana ery'omunda” lino, n'okuligondera bwe liwulikika; era tewali na mulundi n'ogumu, mu nnaku zange zonna ez'obuto, gwe njjukira okuwulira ekika kirala kyonna eky'okubuulira. Si kubanga tekyandibaddewo, wabula, okubuulira okw'enjigiriza, singa nnali n'amatu ag'okukiwulira; naye mu butuufu, tewaali bibuuzo bya ddiini bya kika kyonna, okuggyako olukkiriza olumu olw'amaanyi nti mu ngeri emu oba endala nteekwa okufuba okuba omulungi, ebyali bijjudde mu birowoozo byange okutuusa nga nnina emyaka kkumi na mukaaga. Nnabeera mu nsi eyo ey'ekyewuunyo era ey'ekyama ey'obwana, ewali ewewuunye nnyo okuva mu “nsi y'abakulu” eyali yeetoolodde, ng'ekintu kyonna eky'ebweru kyalabika ng'omuzannyo ogw'okuyita obuyisi. Mu nsi yange, byonna byali bya bwereere era byangu, awatali kwetaaga kubuuza kwonna. Abantu abakulu abaali banneetoolodde balabika nga balina ebyo bye baafaako eby'obusiru n'okweraliikirira kwabwe okw'obusirusiru, naye bino byali si kintu gye ndi mu kifo kyange eky'ekyewuunyo.

Oluusi, omu ku bakulu bano ab'obusirusiru bwe yandiwaanyisizza nti walijja ekiseera nange lwe ndikula, obulumi bwandinjidde olw'endowooza embi eyo, era nnandimalidde okuyimirizaayimirizaayo olunaku olubi olwo bwe kyandisoboseeko nga nga nnigaana okusiba enviiri zange mu kifundikwa emabega, oba okukkiriza engoye zange okuwanvuuka okusinga amaviivi gange. Nnalina endowooza nti abantu abakulu baali baagala okuba n'obulamu bw'abaana, n'okuzannya emizannyo gy'abaana, n'okusanyuka nga bwe kityo abaana kwe twali twagala, naye nga waaliwo etteeka eryabiziyiza. Era abantu bwe baayogeranga mu maaso gange ku kyetaagisa okw'“okusitula omusaalaba” bwe wakula, nnalowooza nti baali bategeeza nti wanditeekeddwa okulekera awo okulinnya emiti, okukulukuusa empeta, okudduka embiro, oba okutambulira ku ntikko z'ebisenge, newankubadde ng'ebbanga lyonna wandiyagadde okukola ebintu bino nga bwe kyabadde; era omutima gwange ogw'obwana emirundi mingi gwajjulanga okusaasira okunene abakulu ab'ennaku abaali banneetoolodde.

Nnali kika ky'omuntu ow'omukwabakwaba era ataliiko kye yeeraliikirira, era okutuusa nga nnina emyaka kkumi na mukaaga nnali mwana bwana wa mutima gwangu, atalina buvunaanyizibwa, nga nnamalirira okufuna essanyu lyonna lye nnasobola mu bulamu, era nga sirina kwerowooza kwa maanyi ku mu okwo okutabula abavubuka emirundi mingi.

Amazima gaali nti, nga bwe nsobola okujjukira, sirina wa nnali neerowoozaako, nze kennyini, n'akatono. Emikwano gyange egy'edda kaakano bantegeeza nti nnali mbalibwa ng'omuwala omulungi ennyo, naye sikimanya. Ekibuuzo ku ndabika yange tekyagera na kunnijjira ku mutwe. Ekibuuzo ekyokka ekyanjagaza ddala kyali ku ssanyu lyange, era engeri gye nnalabika, oba abantu kye baalowoozanga ku nze, byali bintu ebitaalabika na katono okunfaako.

Njjukira bulungi omulundi ogusooka ebibuuzo ng'ebyo bwe byeyingiza, n'engeri ey'obusungu gye nnabigaanamu. Ndowooza nti nnali nnina emyaka nga kkumi n'egumu. Maama yali antumye mu kisenge eky'okusembeza abagenyi okulaba abamu ku mikwano gye abaali bansabye. Awatali kutya, nnaleka ebisomo byange ne ndaga eri ekisenge eky'okusembeza abagenyi; awo amangu ago, nga nnaakanaakana okuyingira, ne nneewuunya nnyo era ne nnyekanga olw'entiisa. Nnali sinnaba na kuwulira kuwuulira kufaanana, era nnakusanga nga tekusanyusa n'akatono. Era bwe nnakyusa akakwate k'oluggi, ne njogera nti, “Kino kya busiru.

Lwaki ntye abantu abo abali munda? Nkakasa nti tebajja kunkuba masasi, era sikkiriza nti bajja kulowooza kintu kyonna ku nze; era ne bwe banaakikola, tekiyinza kunnuma, era nsalawo obutatya n'akatono.” Era bwe nnagamba kino, mu bugenderevu ne nsuula okutya kwange emabega, ne nyingira mu kisenge awatali kutya, nga nkulese kwonna ebweru w'oluggi.

Nnali nvumbuse, newankubadde ng'olwo saalina magezi mangi okukiteeka mu bigambo, nti okutya kwali kwerowoozaako nnyini yekka, era nti okwerabira wekka kwali ddagala eddungi eritajjulukuka; era sijjukira kaddannuma kutuuka okubonaabona olw'okutya ekintu nate. Bwe kwajjanga, nnakusuulanga emabega nga bwe nnakola omulundi ogusooka, era mu butuufu ne nnigaana okukussaako essira lyonna.

Kyebava, nga bwe nsobola okujjukira, obulamu bwange okutuusa nga nnina emyaka kkumi na mukaaga, we kwajjira okuzuukuka kwange okw'eddiini, bwali bulamu bw'omwana atalina kulowooza n'akatono. Okwekulembera n'okwekebera byali bintu bye saategeera n'akatono, era ebibuuzo eby'eddiini saabirootako. Nkyusa amaaso ne ndaba n'okwewuunya nti omuntu atalina kulowooza bwe ntyo yandisobodde okukuumibwa okuva ku bibi ebimeruka nga bwe nnakuumibwa, naye nkiraba nti kino nteekwa okukyeebaza embeera ennungi, ennene, era ejjudde eya Bukwaka ey'obulungi n'obutuukirivu mwe nnabeera, era eyafuula okumeruka kwonna okw'ekika ekyo ekyewunyisa okubula.

Njogedde ku Kkanisa mwe nnazaalibwa nga kibiina ky'eddiini. Bulijjo yayitibwanga mu nnaku zange ez'obuto “Ekibiina eky'Eddiini eky'Emikwano,” era teyayogerwangako, nga bwe kiri kaakano emirundi mingi, nti “Kkanisa y'Abakwaka.”

Abakwaka ab'edda baalina obujulizi obw'amaanyi obw'obutayita ku bo nga Kkanisa, kubanga tebeeyita Kkanisa mu makulu gonna ag'okuggyamu abalala oba ag'okuli mu bo. Kkanisa, ng'endowooza yaabwe bw'eyali, yali mubiri ogutalabika ogw'abakkiriza abali mu buli nzikiriza na buli ggwanga, era bo, nga “Emikwano,” baali kibiina bokka mu Kkanisa eno ennene ey'ensi yonna etalabika.

Baaggya erinnya lyabwe mu bigambo bya Mukama waffe mu Yokaana 15:14–15 nti: “Mmwe muli mikwano gyange bwe mukola bye mbalagira. Okuva kaakano sikyabayita baddu; kubanga omuddu tamanyi ky'akola mukama we; naye mmwe mbayise mikwano; kubanga byonna bye nnawulira eri Kitange mbibategeezezza.” Ekigendererwa kyabwe ekimu mu bulamu kyali okukola kyonna Mukama ky'alagira, era kyebava bakkiriza nti baali baakkirizibbwa okuyingira mu kifo kino ekitukuvu eky'omukwano gwa Katonda. Okusooka baali tebalina ndowooza yonna ey'okwawukanamu bibiina, wabula okwegatta kwabwe mu birowoozo byabwe kwali kibiina bwokka eky'emikwano (awatali S nnene wadde F nnene), abaakuŋŋaananga wamu okugabana, ng'emikwano n'emikwano ginnaagyo, ebibikkulibwa eby'Ekika kya Katonda ebyakolebwa buli omu, n'okugumyagana okufuba okunoonya obutuukirivu obwo omukwano ogw'Ekika kya Katonda bwe gwetaaga.

Nti “ekibiina ky'emikwano” kino mpolampola ne kyefuula okuba n'ennyanjula entongole n'ennukuta ennene, ne kifuuka “Ekibiina eky'Eddiini eky'Emikwano,” ne kikula ne kifuuka ekibiina eky'enjawulo, kino, ndowooza, kyali kivaamu ekyetaagisa ekya buli ntambula nga zino. Naye bulijjo kyandabikira ng'okugwa okuva ku bwangu n'obwensi bwonna obw'endowooza esooka.

Erinnya lya Mukwaka lyali libateekeddwako mu nnaku zaabwe ez'edda olw'ekituufu nti, bwe baabuuliranga mu Nkuŋŋaana zaabwe, baalabibwanga nga bakankana oba nga batiitiira wansi w'ekyo kye baakkiriza nti maanyi ga Mwoyo Mutukuvu. Nze kennyini, ne mu biseera eby'akakkamu ennyo bwe nnali omwana, nnalabanga emirundi mingi ababuulizi mu Nkuŋŋaana zaffe nga bakankana era nga batiitiira okuva ku mutwe okutuuka ku bigere, era nkakasa nti bulijjo nnawuliranga nti obubaka obwaweebwanga mu mbeera eno bwalina okuluusanyizibwa n'okufukibwako amafuta okw'enjawulo okwabwo, okusukka obulala bwonna. Mu butuufu, omubuulizi bwe yabanga tannaba na “kukankana” okumala okukuba emitima gyabwe n'okukankanya amagulu gaabwe, teyabalibwanga abangi ng'alina “okuyitibwa” okutuufu eri obuweereza n'akatono, era omuntu tayinza kwewuunya nti erinnya “Mukwaka” lyeriweekera ku kibiina.

Naye erinnya lye baali beerondedde bo lyali lisinga essanyu, era lyali linnyonnyola bulungi ekyo kye baali ddala. “Okukankana” kwali, oluvannyuma lwa byonna, kikolwa bwekyo mu ddiini yaabwe, naye omukwano gwe gwali ensibuko yaayo. Kubanga baakkiriza nti be mikwano gya Katonda, baategeera nti baali bateekwa okuba, mu ngeri ey'amazima ennyo, emikwano gy'ebitonde byonna bye yatonda. Baakkiriza nga kituufu ddala nti yatonda amawanga gonna ag'abantu mu musaayi gumu, era nti bonna kyebaava babeera baganda baabwe. Omuntu teyandiremye kutegeera okuwulira kuno okw'omukwano ogw'ensi yonna mu kusinza n'omulimu gwonna ogw'ekibiina, era nze kennyini, kwannyweza nnyo mu bulamu bwange obw'obuvubuka, nga n'okutuusa leero, okuba omunnamu w'Ekibiina eky'Emikwano gye ndi kitegeeza okuba omukwano gwa buli muntu. Era buli we wabeerawo okunyigirizibwa oba okubonaabona wonna mu nsi, mangu ago nneewuunya obw'obulala nti mu abasooka okwanguyako okununula waliba akakiiko k'Ekibiina eky'Emikwano.

Mu butuufu, balina akakiiko akanywevu akakuŋŋaana bulijjo okulowooza ku nsonga ez'obutali bwenkanya n'ez'obwetaavu, era kayitibwa mu ngeri ey'amakulu “Olukuŋŋaana olw'Ababonaabona.” Ekibiina, era bulijjo kibadde, mukwano gwa bonna abanyigirizibwa. Kyebava, ne bwe nsi ey'ebweru bw'etera okubayita “Abakwaka,” nsanyuka nti bo bennyini banywerera ku linnya ery'okwagalibwa “Emikwano.”

Emikwano gyange egy'edda kaakano bantegeeza nti nnali mbalibwa ng'omuwala omulungi ennyo, naye sikimanya. Ekibuuzo ku ndabika yange tekyagera na kunnijjira ku mutwe. Ekibuuzo ekyokka ekyanjagaza ddala kyali ku ssanyu lyange, era engeri gye nnalabika, oba abantu kye baalowoozanga ku nze, byali bintu ebitaalabika na katono okunfaako. Njjukira bulungi omulundi ogusooka ebibuuzo ng'ebyo bwe byeyingiza, n'engeri ey'obusungu gye nnabigaanamu. Ndowooza nti nnali nnina emyaka nga kkumi n'egumu. Maama yali antumye mu kisenge eky'okusembeza abagenyi okulaba abamu ku mikwano gye abaali bansabye. Awatali kutya, nnaleka ebisomo byange ne ndaga eri ekisenge eky'okusembeza abagenyi; awo amangu ago, nga nnaakanaakana okuyingira, ne nneewuunya nnyo era ne nnyekanga olw'entiisa. Nnali sinnaba na kuwulira kuwuulira kufaanana, era nnakusanga nga tekusanyusa n'akatono. Era bwe nnakyusa akakwate k'oluggi, ne njogera nti, “Kino kya busiru. Lwaki ntye abantu abo abali munda? Nkakasa nti tebajja kunkuba masasi, era sikkiriza nti bajja kulowooza kintu kyonna ku nze; era ne bwe banaakikola, tekiyinza kunnuma, era nsalawo obutatya n'akatono.” Era bwe nnagamba kino, mu bugenderevu ne nsuula okutya kwange emabega, ne nyingira mu kisenge awatali kutya, nga nkulese kwonna ebweru w'oluggi. Nnali nvumbuse, newankubadde ng'olwo saalina magezi mangi okukiteeka mu bigambo, nti okutya kwali kwerowoozaako nnyini yekka, era nti okwerabira wekka kwali ddagala eddungi eritajjulukuka; era sijjukira kaddannuma kutuuka okubonaabona olw'okutya ekintu nate. Bwe kwajjanga, nnakusuulanga emabega nga bwe nnakola omulundi ogusooka, era mu butuufu ne nnigaana okukussaako essira lyonna. Kyebava, nga bwe nsobola okujjukira, obulamu bwange okutuusa nga nnina emyaka kkumi na mukaaga, we kwajjira okuzuukuka kwange okw'eddiini, bwali bulamu bw'omwana atalina kulowooza n'akatono. Okwekulembera n'okwekebera byali bintu bye saategeera n'akatono, era ebibuuzo eby'eddiini saabirootako. Nkyusa amaaso ne ndaba n'okwewuunya nti omuntu atalina kulowooza bwe ntyo yandisobodde okukuumibwa okuva ku bibi ebimeruka nga bwe nnakuumibwa, naye nkiraba nti kino nteekwa okukyeebaza embeera ennungi, ennene, era ejjudde eya Bukwaka ey'obulungi n'obutuukirivu mwe nnabeera, era eyafuula okumeruka kwonna okw'ekika ekyo ekyewunyisa okubula. Njogedde ku Kkanisa mwe nnazaalibwa nga kibiina ky'eddiini. Bulijjo yayitibwanga mu nnaku zange ez'obuto “Ekibiina eky'Eddiini eky'Emikwano,” era teyayogerwangako, nga bwe kiri kaakano emirundi mingi, nti “Kkanisa y'Abakwaka.” Abakwaka ab'edda baalina obujulizi obw'amaanyi obw'obutayita ku bo nga Kkanisa, kubanga tebeeyita Kkanisa mu makulu gonna ag'okuggyamu abalala oba ag'okuli mu bo. Kkanisa, ng'endowooza yaabwe bw'eyali, yali mubiri ogutalabika ogw'abakkiriza abali mu buli nzikiriza na buli ggwanga, era bo, nga “Emikwano,” baali kibiina bokka mu Kkanisa eno ennene ey'ensi yonna etalabika. Baaggya erinnya lyabwe mu bigambo bya Mukama waffe mu Yokaana 15:14–15 nti: “Mmwe muli mikwano gyange bwe mukola bye mbalagira. Okuva kaakano sikyabayita baddu; kubanga omuddu tamanyi ky'akola mukama we; naye mmwe mbayise mikwano; kubanga byonna bye nnawulira eri Kitange mbibategeezezza.” Ekigendererwa kyabwe ekimu mu bulamu kyali okukola kyonna Mukama ky'alagira, era kyebava bakkiriza nti baali baakkirizibbwa okuyingira mu kifo kino ekitukuvu eky'omukwano gwa Katonda. Okusooka baali tebalina ndowooza yonna ey'okwawukanamu bibiina, wabula okwegatta kwabwe mu birowoozo byabwe kwali kibiina bwokka eky'emikwano (awatali S nnene wadde F nnene), abaakuŋŋaananga wamu okugabana, ng'emikwano n'emikwano ginnaagyo, ebibikkulibwa eby'Ekika kya Katonda ebyakolebwa buli omu, n'okugumyagana okufuba okunoonya obutuukirivu obwo omukwano ogw'Ekika kya Katonda bwe gwetaaga. Nti “ekibiina ky'emikwano” kino mpolampola ne kyefuula okuba n'ennyanjula entongole n'ennukuta ennene, ne kifuuka “Ekibiina eky'Eddiini eky'Emikwano,” ne kikula ne kifuuka ekibiina eky'enjawulo, kino, ndowooza, kyali kivaamu ekyetaagisa ekya buli ntambula nga zino. Naye bulijjo kyandabikira ng'okugwa okuva ku bwangu n'obwensi bwonna obw'endowooza esooka. Erinnya lya Mukwaka lyali libateekeddwako mu nnaku zaabwe ez'edda olw'ekituufu nti, bwe baabuuliranga mu Nkuŋŋaana zaabwe, baalabibwanga nga bakankana oba nga batiitiira wansi w'ekyo kye baakkiriza nti maanyi ga Mwoyo Mutukuvu. Nze kennyini, ne mu biseera eby'akakkamu ennyo bwe nnali omwana, nnalabanga emirundi mingi ababuulizi mu Nkuŋŋaana zaffe nga bakankana era nga batiitiira okuva ku mutwe okutuuka ku bigere, era nkakasa nti bulijjo nnawuliranga nti obubaka obwaweebwanga mu mbeera eno bwalina okuluusanyizibwa n'okufukibwako amafuta okw'enjawulo okwabwo, okusukka obulala bwonna. Mu butuufu, omubuulizi bwe yabanga tannaba na “kukankana” okumala okukuba emitima gyabwe n'okukankanya amagulu gaabwe, teyabalibwanga abangi ng'alina “okuyitibwa” okutuufu eri obuweereza n'akatono, era omuntu tayinza kwewuunya nti erinnya “Mukwaka” lyeriweekera ku kibiina. Naye erinnya lye baali beerondedde bo lyali lisinga essanyu, era lyali linnyonnyola bulungi ekyo kye baali ddala. “Okukankana” kwali, oluvannyuma lwa byonna, kikolwa bwekyo mu ddiini yaabwe, naye omukwano gwe gwali ensibuko yaayo. Kubanga baakkiriza nti be mikwano gya Katonda, baategeera nti baali bateekwa okuba, mu ngeri ey'amazima ennyo, emikwano gy'ebitonde byonna bye yatonda. Baakkiriza nga kituufu ddala nti yatonda amawanga gonna ag'abantu mu musaayi gumu, era nti bonna kyebaava babeera baganda baabwe. Omuntu teyandiremye kutegeera okuwulira kuno okw'omukwano ogw'ensi yonna mu kusinza n'omulimu gwonna ogw'ekibiina, era nze kennyini, kwannyweza nnyo mu bulamu bwange obw'obuvubuka, nga n'okutuusa leero, okuba omunnamu w'Ekibiina eky'Emikwano gye ndi kitegeeza okuba omukwano gwa buli muntu. Era buli we wabeerawo okunyigirizibwa oba okubonaabona wonna mu nsi, mangu ago nneewuunya obw'obulala nti mu abasooka okwanguyako okununula waliba akakiiko k'Ekibiina eky'Emikwano. Mu butuufu, balina akakiiko akanywevu akakuŋŋaana bulijjo okulowooza ku nsonga ez'obutali bwenkanya n'ez'obwetaavu, era kayitibwa mu ngeri ey'amakulu “Olukuŋŋaana olw'Ababonaabona.” Ekibiina, era bulijjo kibadde, mukwano gwa bonna abanyigirizibwa. Kyebava, ne bwe nsi ey'ebweru bw'etera okubayita “Abakwaka,” nsanyuka nti bo bennyini banywerera ku linnya ery'okwagalibwa “Emikwano.”

fields.title: Obukwakeri
fields.body_html:
Nga sinnaba kwogera ku nsonga y'engeri Obukwakeri gye bwakosaamu obulamu bwange obw'obuto, njagala kitegeerekeke bulungi nti sigezaako mu ngeri yonna kuwa nnyonnyola ntuufu ey'Obukwakeri nga bakadde bange bwe baabutegeera era bwe baabubeerera, wabula njogera bwe bwakosa omuwala omuto atannakula, eyali ayaayaanira ebintu, eyalina oluuyi olw'eddiini olweyoleka mu butonde bwe, naye nga ajjudde obulamu n'amaanyi ennyo okusobola okufaayo ennyo ku bibuuzo ebitali bikwata ku mirimu gye egya buli lunaku n'ebisanyusa.

Siyinza kudda mabega ne nzuula njigiriza yonna enkakafu eyaleeta endowooza zange, era mu kiseera ekyo saazibumba mu bigambo, naye ebifaananyi bye nkyalina eby'ennaku ezo kaakati binfaananako ng'byava mu mbeera eya bulijjo eyali enneetoolodde. Ab'eŋŋanda zange abakulu ne mikwano gyange balabika nga tebaalina kirowoozo kya kutonda mbeera eyo, era singa baali balamu kaakati, bandeewuunyizza nnyo ku ntegeeza zange ezimu. Naye ekituufu kisigala nti Obukwakeri obw'obulamu bwange obw'obuto bwandekera ebifaananyi eby'amaanyi bye mpandiika, era njagala kubiwaayo mu bwesimbu nga bwe nsobola, ng'ekitundu ku byafaayo byange ebyange, so si mu ngeri yonna ng'ennyonnyola ey'obuyinza ey'endowooza z'Abakwakeri.

Bwe tuddayo mu lunyiriri lwa bajjajjaffe, tukizuula nti baava e Bungereza mu kyasa eky'ekkumi n'omusanvu, awamu n'ekibinja ekinene eky'Abakwakeri abaali, olw'obutasobola kufuna mu nsi yaabwe omwoyo ogwo ogw'eddembe ery'eddiini, ogwali omusingi omukulu ogw'okukkiriza kwabwe, ne banoonya obubudamo mu nsi empya ey'Ebugwanjuba, nga basuubira okusimba eyo eggwanga abaana baabwe mwe bandisobodde okufuna eddembe ery'okusinza Katonda ng'emmeeme zaabwe bwe zaabalagira, eddembe lye baagaanibwa mu nsi enkadde.

Abakwakeri bano baali basenze okusinga mu bibangirizi ebyasimbibwa William Penn okumpi ne Philadelphia ne mu byetoolo byakyo, ku mbuga zombi ez'omugga Delaware, era baali bafuuse, we nnazaalirwa, ekibinja eky'obuyinza obungi era ekissibwamu ekitiibwa nnyo.

Kyokka, ekitundu kinene eky'obuggya bwabwe obw'olubereberye n'obunyiikivu bwabwe kyali kiweddewo, era eyali esigadde yali ddiini eya ntegeevu nnyo, eya kasirise, eyakkiriza okwoleka okutono nnyo, era eyali ey'omunda ennyo okusinga bwe kindabikira kaakati okuba amagezi. Waaliwo ekyasigala okuva mu nnaku ez'edda, okukkiriza okunywevu mu ekyo ekyayogerwangako nga “obulagirizi obulabika obw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu,” ekitegeeza eddoboozi lya Katonda erisongovu era erimanyibwa mu mutima; n'okwewaayo okw'obwesigwa eri ebyo ebyayitibwanga “obujulizi bw'Ab'oluganda,” obujulizi obwo bwe kwali okwoleka okw'ebweru okw'okukakasa amazima kwe baakkiriza nti kwabikkulirwa butereevu “ekitangaala eky'omunda” eri George Fox, omutandisi w'ekibiina, n'eri abagoberezi be ab'olubereberye.

Ebingi ku ebyo bye baakakasa byali bikontana n'endowooza eza bulijjo ez'abantu abaali batwetoolodde, era okubigoberera kwabwe kyaleetera Abakwakeri ab'omu biseera byange okuba ab'enjawulo ennyo. Naye twayigirizibwa nti kyali kitiibwa kinene okuba “abantu ba Katonda ab'enjawulo,” era nze, ku lwange, nakkiriza ddala nti ffe Abakwakeri ffe twali twogerwako mu Ekyamateeka eky'Okuddamu awagamba nti: “Mukama akulonze okuba abantu ab'enjawulo gy'ali okusinga amawanga gonna agali ku nsi.”

Mu maaso g'ekitiibwa ekifaanana bwe kityo, ebintu bye twali “twawukanamu,” ebyo, nkkiriza, emirundi mingi ebyatuleetera ensonyi nnyingi ne n'okugezesebwa, byalabika ng'engeri ey'“akabonero” ak'ekisa kya Katonda eky'enjawulo; era mu kifo ky'okuswazibwa olw'enjawulo yaabwe, Abakwakeri ab'omu biseera byange mu kyama beenyumirizanga mu byo, ne mu njawulo gye byaleeta. Ffe abaana Abakwakeri twanywa akatundu ku mpisa eno, era bwe twatambulanga mu nguudo nga twambadde engoye zaffe ez'Abakwakeri ez'enjawulo, ne abaana ab'oku nguudo bwe baatuvumanga, nga bwe baakolanga emirundi mingi, nga bagamba nti, “Quaker, Quaker, mash potato,” twawuliranga okwewulira okw'obusukkulumu okwatuwaanirira, okwaggyanga akatono ku busungu obwali bugendereddwa, ne kutusobozesa okuddamu n'okunyooma okulungi, ng'abasinze ennyo mu nsonga eyo, nti, “Dutchy, Dutchy, Mash-pay-touchy!” Bwe twali Abakwakeri, bo mpozzi baali bazzukulu b'Abadaaki ab'olubereberye, oba nga bwe baayitibwanga, “Dutch Redemptioners,” abaali abaddu b'abasenze abaasooka; era wadde kiri kityo, twali tumaliridde nti balina okumanya nga bwe twabalowoozanga.

Nzijukira nti bannyinaze ne nze bwe twamala okuzuula okuddamu kuno okw'amaanyi, twasobola okusirisa abanyigiriza baffe abasinga obungi. Naye emirundi egimu kyali kizibu nnyo eri ffe abaana Abakwakeri okuwalirizibwa okutwala omugabo gwaffe ogw'okuyigganyizibwa “olw'omuntu ow'omunda,” kubanga zaali mmeeme z'abakadde baffe so si zaffe; era, awamu n'amalala gaffe ag'okuba abantu ba Katonda ab'enjawulo, twawuliranga era emirundi mingi okuwulira okugobwa mu bantu, kwe ndaba, bwe ndaba emabega, nga tetwandisaanidde kusabibwa kugumira.

Wadde kiri kityo, sirina kubuusabuusa nti kyassaawo mu mpisa zaffe engeri ey'obwetwaze obunywevu obwatugasa nnyo mu bulamu bwaffe obw'oluvannyuma. Nze, ku lwange, bulijjo nsiimye olw'okununulibwa okuva mu kutya omuntu. Obutassaayo mwoyo ku kunenyezebwa, okwo, nkakasa, kwe kwabuusibwa mu mwoyo gwange olw'okuyigganyizibwa kuno okw'olubereberye “olw'omuntu ow'omunda.”

Waaliwo, nga bwe njogedde, okuyigirizibwa okw'eddiini okutereevu okutono nnyo eri Abakwakeri abato mu biseera byange.

Emirundi egimu twabuulirwanga mu nkuŋŋaana zaffe, nga Ow'oluganda eyabeeranga waggulu akubiriza “abavubuka abaagalwa” okuba abeesigwa eri Omulagirizi waabwe Omutukuvu, naye tewaali njigiriza wadde nkola za nzikiriza ze twali tuyigirizibwa. Okuggyako ng'omuntu azuukusiddwa mu ngeri emu, tewaali na kimu ku bibuuzo ebikakampuza emitwe gy'abavubuka ab'omu biseera bino ekyali kirootebwa abavubuka ab'omu kibinja kyange, waakiri nga bwe namanya. Ekitonde ekitamanyi ddala byonna ebiyitibwa amazima ag'eddiini okusinga nze nga bwe nnali okutuusa mu myaka gy'obukulu ekkumi n'omukaaga, we nnazuukukira, tekiyinzika kutegeerekeka mu biseera bino ebya kaakati. Ekibuuzo kyonna eky'eddiini eri nze kyali kyokka nga kiri nti nnali mulungi okumala okugenda mu ggulu, oba nga mubi ennyo okusaanira omuliro. Ku by'okuba nga waaliwo “enteekateeka ey'obulokozi,” oba ekintu kyonna nga “okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'okukkiriza,” tekyawulirwa mu ffe.

Ensonga emu enkulu mu ndowooza yaffe ey'eddiini yali nga eri ku kuba nti twanoonyanga era ne tugondera “obulagirizi obulabika” obw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, gye twalagirwanga bulijjo; era okuyigirizibwa kwokka okunkakafu kwe twafuna ku bulamu bwaffe obw'eddiini kwali mu “bujulizi bw'Ab'oluganda,” ne mu “bibuuzo” ebyasomebwanga ne biddibwamu buli mwezi mu “nkuŋŋaana ez'omwezi ez'emirimu,” ezaakubibwanga bulijjo buli kkuŋŋaaniro ly'Abakwakeri.

Twali tetulina masomero ga Ssande wadde amasomo ga Bayibuli; mu butuufu, nga bwe njogedde, gano gaatwalibwanga ng'engeri ey'“emirimu egy'ekitonde,” egyakkirizibwanga kwokka mu “bantu ab'ensi” (nga twategeeza buli muntu atali Mukwakeri), kubanga baali mu butamanya, nga bwe twakkiriza, ku njigiriza ennene ennyo ez'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ezaali obusika bwaffe obw'enjawulo. So n'ekibiina kyaffe tekyatuyigiriza kusaba kwonna okwa bulijjo, kubanga Ab'oluganda baakkiriza nti bandisobodde okusaba mu ngeri ekkirizibwa Omwoyo bwe yabakwatanga okusaba. Nga tuli baana bato, bazadde baffe baali batuyigirizza okusaba okw'obwana, kwe twaddiŋŋanamu buli kiro nga tumaze okusaanikirwa mu kitanda, nga tetunnaweebwa ebinywegero eby'okusiibula eby'oluvannyuma.

Naye bwe twakula, ne bazadde baffe bwe beeyongera okutegeera obwetwaze bwaffe obwa buli omu, okusaba kuno okw'obwana okwa buli kiro kwalekebwawo, era embeera ey'Ekikwakeri ku by'okusaba mpolampola ne yeeyongera okufuga; era mu kiseera nze, waakiri, ne ntuuka okuwulira ng'olw'obutafaayo bwange n'obutassaayo mwoyo, kyali kumpi n'okuba ekikyamu eri nze okugezaako okusaba.

Obukwakeri buno kye bwayigiriza ku kusaba kiyinza okukuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva mu kyakuggyibwa kino ekiva mu byawandiikibwa bya Isaac Pennington. Agamba nti, “Okusaba kirabo. Omuntu tayinza kusaba lwa yeeyagalidde; wabula ateekwa okutunula n'okulinda, Kitaffe lw'anaakoleeza mu ye okussa okw'obulamu okudda gy'ali.”

Olw'ekyo, twali tetumanyi ssaala nteeketeeke era n'okuyigirizibwa tetwayigirizibwa Essaala ya Mukama. Okutuusa lwe nnali omukazi, mu butuufu saagimanya ku mutima, era ne kaakati, emirundi mingi mbuliŋŋana akaseera nga ngezaako okugiddamu. Amazima gennyini gali nti nga ndi mwana, nafuna endowooza mu ngeri emu nti Essaala ya Mukama yali “gay,” era nti abantu “gay” bokka be baali balindirirwa okugikozesa. Nga twogera “gay” twategeeza buli kintu ekitali kya Kikwakeri. Abakwakeri baali “ba bwereere,” ne ensi yonna esigadde, ne n'ey'Ekkanisa, baali “gay.”

Kyandabikira ne nga kya “gay” mu bujjuvu okufukamira mu kusaba. Ffe Ab'oluganda bulijjo twayimiriranga ng'okusaba kuweebwayo mu nkuŋŋaana zaffe, era bwe twasabanga nga tugenda okwebaka ekiro, kyakolebwanga nga tumaze okuyingira mu kitanda. Era bwe kyabangawo oluusi, omu ku ffe abato n'agezaako okufukamira ku mabbali g'ekitanda kye olw'okusaba kwe okw'akawungeezi, bulijjo twawuliranga nti kyali kwewaayo kwa nnaku eri omwoyo ogw'ensi, era kyali kya kukungubagirwa ng'okudda ennyuma okuva mu kukkiriza okw'amazima.

Mu butuufu, emikolo gyonna egy'Ekkanisa oba egy'Ekapella gyatulabikira nga gya “gay” era egy'ensi nnyo, era okwegatta mu gyo kyalabika ng'okumpi kwenkanankana n'okwonoona; era okutuusa lwe nnafumbirwa, mu butuufu saali nnayingira kifo kya kusinza kyonna okuggyako ennyumba z'Enkuŋŋaana z'Ab'oluganda. Nandiwuliddewo nga kya “kugwa okuva mu kisa” mu bujjuvu singa nnakikola.

Sisobola kujjukira nti twayigirizibwa mu bwenkanya kimu ku bintu bino, oba nti waliwo eyali anjogedde mu bigambo ebijjuvu nti Abakwakeri be baali “abantu ab'enjawulo” abaayogerwako mu Bayibuli ng'abaagalwa ennyo Katonda. Naye engeri y'okubuulira gye twawulirizanga, era eky'amazima nga tetugitegeeramu wabula kitundu kyokka, ku bikwata ku nkizo n'emikisa egy'enjawulo yaffe, kyaleeta endowooza ku butamanya bwange obw'obuto nti mu ngeri emu, olw'“enjawulo” yaffe, twali abantu ab'ekisa kya Katonda eky'enjawulo. Nzijukira bulungi nnyo okuba n'okuwulira okusongovu nti ffe twali Abayisirayeri ab'amazima Bayibuli be yayogerako, era nti bonna abaali si Bakwakeri baali ba mu “Bamawanga ab'ebweru.” Okwogera amazima gonna, nga ndi mwana nnalina n'endowooza etabuse mu mutima gwange nti ffe Abakwakeri twalina Katonda ow'enjawulo era omukulu ennyo okusinga abalala, era nti Katonda Abakristaayo abalala gwe baasinza yali omu ku “Bakatonda b'Abamawanga” Bayibuli be yavumirira.

Nti saali nzekka mu nneewulira zino kirakibwa mu byakuggyibwa bino wammanga eby'ebijjukizo ebyaakafulumizibwa eby'Ow'oluganda Omunnamerika, ali omusomesa omukugu ow'omu biseera bino.

Agamba nti: “Nkakasa ddala nti tewaali Muyisirayeri mu nnaku ez'okukulaakulana kwa Isirayeri eyalina okukakasibwa okukakafu okwenkana nga kwange nti nnali wa mu bantu ab'enjawulo Mukama be yeerondera okuba ababe, nga nange bwe nnali. Waaliwo eri nze enjawukana entuufu wakati wa ‘ffe’ n'omuntu omulala yenna. Obufalisaayo buno tebwanjigirizibwa, so tebwakubirizibwa butereevu muntu yenna, naye newankubadde ekyo nnabulina. Singa nnalina ekintu kyonna mu nsi eky'okwenyumiririzaamu, kyali nti nnali Mukwakeri. Abalala abaali okumpi nange baalina ebintu ebigambika ebisingako bye nnali nabyo. Obulamu bwabwe bwali bwangu, so tebaalina kulwanirira kuzibu okufuna ebintu bye baayagala nga ffe bwe twalina. Naye baali si ‘balonde,’ ffe nga tuli! Okuva wansi ennyo gye nsobola okutuuka mu kujjukira kwange, nsanga okuwulira kuno okw'obusukkulumu — engeri ey'obusika obw'okuzaalirwa mu kisa n'okuganja kwa Katonda. Ndowooza kyava mu kitundu ku bifaananyi bye nnafuna okuva mu ‘Ab'oluganda abatambuze,’ abaakyalira nga balina obuyinza obutayogerekeka ku nze. Kya lwatu kirabika ng'endowooza empenvu nnyo, era bwe kyali, naye obuyinza bwakyo bwali bukulu ddala ku nze. Kyawa akatiibwa ku bulamu bwange obutono okuwulira nti nnali wa mu bantu ba Katonda bennyini; nti, mu nsi yonna, twali twalondeddwa okuba ababe, era nti eby'amagero bye byakolebwa ku lwaffe, era twali abantu ab'okwagala kwe n'okulabirira kwe okw'enjawulo.

“Buli muntu eka, awamu n'abagenyi baffe abangi, yakkiriza mu bujjuvu obulagirizi obwa Katonda obw'amangu ago. Abo abaava mu nkuŋŋaana yaffe okugenda okukola omulimu ogw'eddiini ogugaziyiziddwa, era waaliwo obukyala bungi bwe bwatuukirizibwa, bulijjo baalabika ng'abalondeddwa butereevu eri obutume buno obw'amakulu ng'abannabbi ab'edda bwe baali. Okuva wansi ennyo gye nsobola okujjukira, nsobola okulaba Ab'oluganda nga batudde nga boogera ne jjajjange omukazi ku ‘nsonga’ eyali ‘ebazitoowerera,’ era ensonga yonna yalabika ng'ey'amakulu nga singa baali bayitiddwa kabaka ow'ensi okuddukanya emirimu gy'obwakabaka. Kyali kitundu ku nsonga zino ez'okulondebwa kwa Katonda, n'endowooza eteesalako nti Katonda yali akozesa abantu bano, be nnali mmanyi, okuba ababaka be, ekyankakasa ennyo ku kituufu nti twali abantu be be yalonda. Wadde bwe kiri, nakulira n'endowooza eno ng'enywevu ddala.”

Nkkiriza nti buli muvubuka “Ow'oluganda” mu kibinja mwe nnali yandikkirizza nti alina enneewulira ze zimu. Twali “abantu ba Katonda abalonde,” era, olw'ekyo, twali ba mu kitiibwa ky'obukungu obw'eddiini obwali obw'amazima nga bwe buyinza okuba obukungu bwonna obw'ensi; era sikkiriza nti waaliwo omukungu yenna oba dyuuka yenna eyali yeenyumiririza mu kifo kye eky'obukungu obw'ensi okusinga ffe bwe twenyumiririzanga mu kyaffe eky'omu ggulu.
fields.body_text: Nga sinnaba kwogera ku nsonga y'engeri Obukwakeri gye bwakosaamu obulamu bwange obw'obuto, njagala kitegeerekeke bulungi nti sigezaako mu ngeri yonna kuwa nnyonnyola ntuufu ey'Obukwakeri nga bakadde bange bwe baabutegeera era bwe baabubeerera, wabula njogera bwe bwakosa omuwala omuto atannakula, eyali ayaayaanira ebintu, eyalina oluuyi olw'eddiini olweyoleka mu butonde bwe, naye nga ajjudde obulamu n'amaanyi ennyo okusobola okufaayo ennyo ku bibuuzo ebitali bikwata ku mirimu gye egya buli lunaku n'ebisanyusa. Siyinza kudda mabega ne nzuula njigiriza yonna enkakafu eyaleeta endowooza zange, era mu kiseera ekyo saazibumba mu bigambo, naye ebifaananyi bye nkyalina eby'ennaku ezo kaakati binfaananako ng'byava mu mbeera eya bulijjo eyali enneetoolodde. Ab'eŋŋanda zange abakulu ne mikwano gyange balabika nga tebaalina kirowoozo kya kutonda mbeera eyo, era singa baali balamu kaakati, bandeewuunyizza nnyo ku ntegeeza zange ezimu. Naye ekituufu kisigala nti Obukwakeri obw'obulamu bwange obw'obuto bwandekera ebifaananyi eby'amaanyi bye mpandiika, era njagala kubiwaayo mu bwesimbu nga bwe nsobola, ng'ekitundu ku byafaayo byange ebyange, so si mu ngeri yonna ng'ennyonnyola ey'obuyinza ey'endowooza z'Abakwakeri. Bwe tuddayo mu lunyiriri lwa bajjajjaffe, tukizuula nti baava e Bungereza mu kyasa eky'ekkumi n'omusanvu, awamu n'ekibinja ekinene eky'Abakwakeri abaali, olw'obutasobola kufuna mu nsi yaabwe omwoyo ogwo ogw'eddembe ery'eddiini, ogwali omusingi omukulu ogw'okukkiriza kwabwe, ne banoonya obubudamo mu nsi empya ey'Ebugwanjuba, nga basuubira okusimba eyo eggwanga abaana baabwe mwe bandisobodde okufuna eddembe ery'okusinza Katonda ng'emmeeme zaabwe bwe zaabalagira, eddembe lye baagaanibwa mu nsi enkadde. Abakwakeri bano baali basenze okusinga mu bibangirizi ebyasimbibwa William Penn okumpi ne Philadelphia ne mu byetoolo byakyo, ku mbuga zombi ez'omugga Delaware, era baali bafuuse, we nnazaalirwa, ekibinja eky'obuyinza obungi era ekissibwamu ekitiibwa nnyo. Kyokka, ekitundu kinene eky'obuggya bwabwe obw'olubereberye n'obunyiikivu bwabwe kyali kiweddewo, era eyali esigadde yali ddiini eya ntegeevu nnyo, eya kasirise, eyakkiriza okwoleka okutono nnyo, era eyali ey'omunda ennyo okusinga bwe kindabikira kaakati okuba amagezi. Waaliwo ekyasigala okuva mu nnaku ez'edda, okukkiriza okunywevu mu ekyo ekyayogerwangako nga “obulagirizi obulabika obw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu,” ekitegeeza eddoboozi lya Katonda erisongovu era erimanyibwa mu mutima; n'okwewaayo okw'obwesigwa eri ebyo ebyayitibwanga “obujulizi bw'Ab'oluganda,” obujulizi obwo bwe kwali okwoleka okw'ebweru okw'okukakasa amazima kwe baakkiriza nti kwabikkulirwa butereevu “ekitangaala eky'omunda” eri George Fox, omutandisi w'ekibiina, n'eri abagoberezi be ab'olubereberye. Ebingi ku ebyo bye baakakasa byali bikontana n'endowooza eza bulijjo ez'abantu abaali batwetoolodde, era okubigoberera kwabwe kyaleetera Abakwakeri ab'omu biseera byange okuba ab'enjawulo ennyo. Naye twayigirizibwa nti kyali kitiibwa kinene okuba “abantu ba Katonda ab'enjawulo,” era nze, ku lwange, nakkiriza ddala nti ffe Abakwakeri ffe twali twogerwako mu Ekyamateeka eky'Okuddamu awagamba nti: “Mukama akulonze okuba abantu ab'enjawulo gy'ali okusinga amawanga gonna agali ku nsi.” Mu maaso g'ekitiibwa ekifaanana bwe kityo, ebintu bye twali “twawukanamu,” ebyo, nkkiriza, emirundi mingi ebyatuleetera ensonyi nnyingi ne n'okugezesebwa, byalabika ng'engeri ey'“akabonero” ak'ekisa kya Katonda eky'enjawulo; era mu kifo ky'okuswazibwa olw'enjawulo yaabwe, Abakwakeri ab'omu biseera byange mu kyama beenyumirizanga mu byo, ne mu njawulo gye byaleeta. Ffe abaana Abakwakeri twanywa akatundu ku mpisa eno, era bwe twatambulanga mu nguudo nga twambadde engoye zaffe ez'Abakwakeri ez'enjawulo, ne abaana ab'oku nguudo bwe baatuvumanga, nga bwe baakolanga emirundi mingi, nga bagamba nti, “Quaker, Quaker, mash potato,” twawuliranga okwewulira okw'obusukkulumu okwatuwaanirira, okwaggyanga akatono ku busungu obwali bugendereddwa, ne kutusobozesa okuddamu n'okunyooma okulungi, ng'abasinze ennyo mu nsonga eyo, nti, “Dutchy, Dutchy, Mash-pay-touchy!” Bwe twali Abakwakeri, bo mpozzi baali bazzukulu b'Abadaaki ab'olubereberye, oba nga bwe baayitibwanga, “Dutch Redemptioners,” abaali abaddu b'abasenze abaasooka; era wadde kiri kityo, twali tumaliridde nti balina okumanya nga bwe twabalowoozanga. Nzijukira nti bannyinaze ne nze bwe twamala okuzuula okuddamu kuno okw'amaanyi, twasobola okusirisa abanyigiriza baffe abasinga obungi. Naye emirundi egimu kyali kizibu nnyo eri ffe abaana Abakwakeri okuwalirizibwa okutwala omugabo gwaffe ogw'okuyigganyizibwa “olw'omuntu ow'omunda,” kubanga zaali mmeeme z'abakadde baffe so si zaffe; era, awamu n'amalala gaffe ag'okuba abantu ba Katonda ab'enjawulo, twawuliranga era emirundi mingi okuwulira okugobwa mu bantu, kwe ndaba, bwe ndaba emabega, nga tetwandisaanidde kusabibwa kugumira. Wadde kiri kityo, sirina kubuusabuusa nti kyassaawo mu mpisa zaffe engeri ey'obwetwaze obunywevu obwatugasa nnyo mu bulamu bwaffe obw'oluvannyuma. Nze, ku lwange, bulijjo nsiimye olw'okununulibwa okuva mu kutya omuntu. Obutassaayo mwoyo ku kunenyezebwa, okwo, nkakasa, kwe kwabuusibwa mu mwoyo gwange olw'okuyigganyizibwa kuno okw'olubereberye “olw'omuntu ow'omunda.” Waaliwo, nga bwe njogedde, okuyigirizibwa okw'eddiini okutereevu okutono nnyo eri Abakwakeri abato mu biseera byange. Emirundi egimu twabuulirwanga mu nkuŋŋaana zaffe, nga Ow'oluganda eyabeeranga waggulu akubiriza “abavubuka abaagalwa” okuba abeesigwa eri Omulagirizi waabwe Omutukuvu, naye tewaali njigiriza wadde nkola za nzikiriza ze twali tuyigirizibwa. Okuggyako ng'omuntu azuukusiddwa mu ngeri emu, tewaali na kimu ku bibuuzo ebikakampuza emitwe gy'abavubuka ab'omu biseera bino ekyali kirootebwa abavubuka ab'omu kibinja kyange, waakiri nga bwe namanya. Ekitonde ekitamanyi ddala byonna ebiyitibwa amazima ag'eddiini okusinga nze nga bwe nnali okutuusa mu myaka gy'obukulu ekkumi n'omukaaga, we nnazuukukira, tekiyinzika kutegeerekeka mu biseera bino ebya kaakati. Ekibuuzo kyonna eky'eddiini eri nze kyali kyokka nga kiri nti nnali mulungi okumala okugenda mu ggulu, oba nga mubi ennyo okusaanira omuliro. Ku by'okuba nga waaliwo “enteekateeka ey'obulokozi,” oba ekintu kyonna nga “okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'okukkiriza,” tekyawulirwa mu ffe. Ensonga emu enkulu mu ndowooza yaffe ey'eddiini yali nga eri ku kuba nti twanoonyanga era ne tugondera “obulagirizi obulabika” obw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, gye twalagirwanga bulijjo; era okuyigirizibwa kwokka okunkakafu kwe twafuna ku bulamu bwaffe obw'eddiini kwali mu “bujulizi bw'Ab'oluganda,” ne mu “bibuuzo” ebyasomebwanga ne biddibwamu buli mwezi mu “nkuŋŋaana ez'omwezi ez'emirimu,” ezaakubibwanga bulijjo buli kkuŋŋaaniro ly'Abakwakeri. Twali tetulina masomero ga Ssande wadde amasomo ga Bayibuli; mu butuufu, nga bwe njogedde, gano gaatwalibwanga ng'engeri ey'“emirimu egy'ekitonde,” egyakkirizibwanga kwokka mu “bantu ab'ensi” (nga twategeeza buli muntu atali Mukwakeri), kubanga baali mu butamanya, nga bwe twakkiriza, ku njigiriza ennene ennyo ez'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ezaali obusika bwaffe obw'enjawulo. So n'ekibiina kyaffe tekyatuyigiriza kusaba kwonna okwa bulijjo, kubanga Ab'oluganda baakkiriza nti bandisobodde okusaba mu ngeri ekkirizibwa Omwoyo bwe yabakwatanga okusaba. Nga tuli baana bato, bazadde baffe baali batuyigirizza okusaba okw'obwana, kwe twaddiŋŋanamu buli kiro nga tumaze okusaanikirwa mu kitanda, nga tetunnaweebwa ebinywegero eby'okusiibula eby'oluvannyuma. Naye bwe twakula, ne bazadde baffe bwe beeyongera okutegeera obwetwaze bwaffe obwa buli omu, okusaba kuno okw'obwana okwa buli kiro kwalekebwawo, era embeera ey'Ekikwakeri ku by'okusaba mpolampola ne yeeyongera okufuga; era mu kiseera nze, waakiri, ne ntuuka okuwulira ng'olw'obutafaayo bwange n'obutassaayo mwoyo, kyali kumpi n'okuba ekikyamu eri nze okugezaako okusaba. Obukwakeri buno kye bwayigiriza ku kusaba kiyinza okukuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva mu kyakuggyibwa kino ekiva mu byawandiikibwa bya Isaac Pennington. Agamba nti, “Okusaba kirabo. Omuntu tayinza kusaba lwa yeeyagalidde; wabula ateekwa okutunula n'okulinda, Kitaffe lw'anaakoleeza mu ye okussa okw'obulamu okudda gy'ali.” Olw'ekyo, twali tetumanyi ssaala nteeketeeke era n'okuyigirizibwa tetwayigirizibwa Essaala ya Mukama. Okutuusa lwe nnali omukazi, mu butuufu saagimanya ku mutima, era ne kaakati, emirundi mingi mbuliŋŋana akaseera nga ngezaako okugiddamu. Amazima gennyini gali nti nga ndi mwana, nafuna endowooza mu ngeri emu nti Essaala ya Mukama yali “gay,” era nti abantu “gay” bokka be baali balindirirwa okugikozesa. Nga twogera “gay” twategeeza buli kintu ekitali kya Kikwakeri. Abakwakeri baali “ba bwereere,” ne ensi yonna esigadde, ne n'ey'Ekkanisa, baali “gay.” Kyandabikira ne nga kya “gay” mu bujjuvu okufukamira mu kusaba. Ffe Ab'oluganda bulijjo twayimiriranga ng'okusaba kuweebwayo mu nkuŋŋaana zaffe, era bwe twasabanga nga tugenda okwebaka ekiro, kyakolebwanga nga tumaze okuyingira mu kitanda. Era bwe kyabangawo oluusi, omu ku ffe abato n'agezaako okufukamira ku mabbali g'ekitanda kye olw'okusaba kwe okw'akawungeezi, bulijjo twawuliranga nti kyali kwewaayo kwa nnaku eri omwoyo ogw'ensi, era kyali kya kukungubagirwa ng'okudda ennyuma okuva mu kukkiriza okw'amazima. Mu butuufu, emikolo gyonna egy'Ekkanisa oba egy'Ekapella gyatulabikira nga gya “gay” era egy'ensi nnyo, era okwegatta mu gyo kyalabika ng'okumpi kwenkanankana n'okwonoona; era okutuusa lwe nnafumbirwa, mu butuufu saali nnayingira kifo kya kusinza kyonna okuggyako ennyumba z'Enkuŋŋaana z'Ab'oluganda. Nandiwuliddewo nga kya “kugwa okuva mu kisa” mu bujjuvu singa nnakikola. Sisobola kujjukira nti twayigirizibwa mu bwenkanya kimu ku bintu bino, oba nti waliwo eyali anjogedde mu bigambo ebijjuvu nti Abakwakeri be baali “abantu ab'enjawulo” abaayogerwako mu Bayibuli ng'abaagalwa ennyo Katonda. Naye engeri y'okubuulira gye twawulirizanga, era eky'amazima nga tetugitegeeramu wabula kitundu kyokka, ku bikwata ku nkizo n'emikisa egy'enjawulo yaffe, kyaleeta endowooza ku butamanya bwange obw'obuto nti mu ngeri emu, olw'“enjawulo” yaffe, twali abantu ab'ekisa kya Katonda eky'enjawulo. Nzijukira bulungi nnyo okuba n'okuwulira okusongovu nti ffe twali Abayisirayeri ab'amazima Bayibuli be yayogerako, era nti bonna abaali si Bakwakeri baali ba mu “Bamawanga ab'ebweru.” Okwogera amazima gonna, nga ndi mwana nnalina n'endowooza etabuse mu mutima gwange nti ffe Abakwakeri twalina Katonda ow'enjawulo era omukulu ennyo okusinga abalala, era nti Katonda Abakristaayo abalala gwe baasinza yali omu ku “Bakatonda b'Abamawanga” Bayibuli be yavumirira. Nti saali nzekka mu nneewulira zino kirakibwa mu byakuggyibwa bino wammanga eby'ebijjukizo ebyaakafulumizibwa eby'Ow'oluganda Omunnamerika, ali omusomesa omukugu ow'omu biseera bino. Agamba nti: “Nkakasa ddala nti tewaali Muyisirayeri mu nnaku ez'okukulaakulana kwa Isirayeri eyalina okukakasibwa okukakafu okwenkana nga kwange nti nnali wa mu bantu ab'enjawulo Mukama be yeerondera okuba ababe, nga nange bwe nnali. Waaliwo eri nze enjawukana entuufu wakati wa ‘ffe’ n'omuntu omulala yenna. Obufalisaayo buno tebwanjigirizibwa, so tebwakubirizibwa butereevu muntu yenna, naye newankubadde ekyo nnabulina. Singa nnalina ekintu kyonna mu nsi eky'okwenyumiririzaamu, kyali nti nnali Mukwakeri. Abalala abaali okumpi nange baalina ebintu ebigambika ebisingako bye nnali nabyo. fields.title: Amazima g'Abakwakeri, n'Obuweereza bw'Abakwakeri
fields.body_html:
Ab’Emikwano baali bakakasa nnyo nti okukkiriza kwabwe kwe kwali okukkiriza okw’amazima okwayolesebwa mu Bayibuli era okwabuulirwa Abatume, ne kiba nti mu kwogera ku kwo, mu biseera byange, baakuyitanga “Amazima,” n’ennukuta ennene “A,” era baayogeranga ku mulimu gw’eddiini ogw’ekibiina nga “okuweereza Amazima.”

Nzijukira nti embalaasi za taata n’amagaali ge baabiyita “embalaasi n’amagaali g’Amazima,” kubanga byabeeranga bulijjo nga bikozesebwa okutwala ababuulizi okuva mu lukuŋŋaana olumu okudda mu lulala, oba okutuma emirimu ku lw’Abakadde oba Abalabirizi. N’okukkiriza okw’obuto okutabuuza, nakkiriza ebyo byonna ddala, ne nkulira ku ndowooza eyeeyawudde nti ffe “Ab’Emikwano” twali n’“Amazima” ffekka, nga tussa essira ery’amaanyi ku kigambo “go,” ekyayawulanga ddala ekyo okuva ku kukwata amazima agamu mu mangi. Agaffe gaali amazima gonna, era nga tewali kirala wabula amazima gennyini, era nga tegayinza kulongoosebwa. Bwe ntyo bwe nnalowoozanga mu nnaku z’obuvubuka bwange.

Naye tekiyinza kuwakanyizibwa nti “Ab’Emikwano” baalina amazima mangi (awatali kigambo “go”). Buli ndowooza ku bintu bya Katonda gye nazuula oluvannyuma, na buli nkyukakyuka gye nakubiririza oluvannyuma, kaakano nkitegeera nti byalina ensibuko yaabyo mu ndowooza z’Ekibiina; era emirundi n’emirundi, ekintu ekiggya oba okukakasibwa okuggya bwe kwanjolekera, neesanga nga njogera nti, “Kale, ekyo kye kyali Ab’Emikwano ab’edda kye baali bategeeza, wadde nga saakitegeera olubereberye.”

Emisingi gyabwe emikulu egy’empisa n’egy’eddiini mingi giyingiziddwa mpolampola era gyigijjizza Abakristaayo abalala — kwe kugamba, okutaputa Bayibuli mu ngeri ey’Omwoyo mu kifo ky’okugigoberera olukalala; okukozesa Ssabbiiti ku lw’omuntu, so si omuntu ku lwa Ssabbiiti; okuteeka akabonero wansi w’okukkiriza kw’Omwoyo kwe kakiikirira; obutaba na mugaso munene bwa nzikiriza na nnyiriri z’enjigiriza, oba obwa mikolo n’emikolo egy’eddiini; okukyawa obuddu; obukulu obw’amaanyi obw’okwefuga; n’omwoyo okutuuka butereevu eri Katonda awatali muntu muwuubuzi.

Naye mu biseera Abakwakeri lwe baasooka okulangirira ebintu bino, byalabika ng’ebigambo ebizibu abantu abatono be baayinza okugumira. Era n’abaffe abaakulira nabyo okuva mu bwana bwaffe twetaaga emyaka mingi egy’okukula mu mwoyo n’okumulisibwa nga tetunnabitegeera bulungi.

Kimu ku mazima ge baali bakutte nga bakulembedde ennyo ebiseera byabwe kyali ku kwenkanankana mu maaso ga Katonda wakati w’abasajja n’abakazi. Baawa “abakazi Ab’Emikwano” ekifo ekyenkanyi n’“abasajja Ab’Emikwano” mu mulimu gw’obuweereza, ne mu kufuga Ekibiina.

Waaliwo abakazi Ababuulizi, n’abakazi Abakadde, n’abakazi Abalabirizi, abaatuulanga mu kitiibwa kyekimu n’abasajja Ababuulizi, Abakadde, n’Abalabirizi, ku ntebe empanvu mu nnyiriri ez’ekitiibwa, nga batunudde eri ekibiina — abasajja ku ludda olumu olw’ekkubo eriri wakati, n’abakazi ku ludda olulala. Ababuulizi (oba Abaweereza, nga bwe twabayitanga) baatuulanga ku mutwe gw’ennyiriri zino ez’ekitiibwa, abasinga obukulu n’obuzito nga be basemberera waggulu, ne bagenda bakendeera okutuuka ku bato abaakayingira, ab’ebirabo byabwe byali byakakasibwa.

Enkola y’obuweereza mu Ab’Emikwano yali ya njawulo nnyo ku y’ekkanisa endala yonna.

Baakkiririza ddala nti Katonda yekka ye ayinza okufuula omuntu Omuweereza, era nti tewali kubuulira kutuufu okuggyako okubuulira okuva butereevu era amangwago mu Ye. Baakkiriza, ng’ekyokwewesa ekituufu kyokka eky’omulimu gw’obuweereza, ekigambo ekiri mu Matayo 10:18–20, era baakkiriza nti ebisuubizo byakyo byalituukirira ddala eri buli mwoyo omwesigwa, oba musajja oba mukazi, oba muto oba mukulu, oba muyivu oba atali muyivu: “Era mulitwalibwa mu maaso g’abafuzi ne bakabaka ku lwange, okuba obujulirwa gye bali n’eri Abaamawanga. Naye bwe balibawaayo, temweraliikiriranga muyogere mutya oba ki kye muligamba; kubanga kye muligamba muliweebwa mu ssaawa eyo. Kubanga si mmwe aboogera, wabula Omwoyo gwa Kitammwe y’ayogerera mu mmwe.”

Ekisuubizo kino kyalimu gye bali “Okuyita” kw’Abakwakeri n’“Okwawulibwa” kw’Abakwakeri; era “okusomera obuweereza” mu masomero amakulu oba mu bitabo, oba okwawulibwa nga bassaako emikono gy’abantu, byabalabikanga ng’okugaana okuyita n’okwawulibwa okwa Katonda kwokka, era nga bivaamu kye baayitanga “obuweereza obukolebwa abantu.” Mu ndowooza yaabwe, Abaweereza baayinza kufuulibwa Katonda yekka, era amaanyi ag’okubuulira gaali “ekirabo” ekiweebwa butereevu Ye yekka.

Ekyo kyokka ekyayinzika kwali Abakadde n’Abalabirizi b’olukuŋŋaana okwekaliriza engeri ekirabo kino gye kyagenda kikulaakulana; era, bwe kyabalabikanga nti okwogera kwalimu obubonero obutategeerekeka bulala obw’okufukibwako amafuta okwa Katonda, baakuŋŋaananga wamu ne basalawo oba okuwandiika oba obutawandiika mu bitabo byabwe eby’olukuŋŋaana nti “baakakasa” nti gundi Muweereza. Ekikolwa kino eky’“okuwandiika” oba “okukakasa” tekyafuulanga aboogezi Baweereza; kyali kutegeera na kukakasa kyokka eky’ekituufu nti Katonda yali amaze okubafuula bwe batyo.

Kino bwe kyamalanga okukolebwa, baayitibwanga “Abaweereza abaakakasibwa,” era ffe abato twawuliranga nti baali bayingiziddwa mu ntikko y’eggulu lyennyini.

Ate era, olwokubanga Katonda yali abafudde Abaweereza, empeera yaabwe yali eteekwa okuva mu Ye yekka. Tebaweebwanga nsimbi wadde emisaala, naye obuweereza bwabwe, obwaweebwa ku bwereere okuva waggulu, baabuwaayo ku bwereere eri bannaabwe, awatali nsimbi era awatali muwendo.

N’olwekyo, Abaweereza b’Abakwakeri bonna beeyongeranga mu mirimu gyabwe egya bulijjo nga “bakozesa ebirabo byabwe,” nga beeyimirizaawo n’ensimbi zaabwe, oba nga bakola obusuubuzi bwabwe oba emirimu gyabwe egya bulijjo. Emirundi mingi kyabalekeranga akaseera katono okusoma oba okwetegekera, naye, olwokubanga tewali kusoma wadde kwetegekera okwakkirizibwanga, kino tekyaleeta buzibu.

Si nti tewaali kutendekebwa kwa njawulo kwa buweereza kwokka, naye tekyalowoozebwanga kutuufu okwetegekera okuweereza oba olukuŋŋaana lwonna olw’enjawulo. “Ab’Emikwano” baali basaanira okugenda mu nkuŋŋaana zaabwe ng’ebirowoozo byabwe bikalu, nga beeteefuteefu okufuna obubaka bwonna Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’ayinza okulaba nga kirungi okugaba. Tewaali n’omu ku bo eyayinzanga okumanya nga tannaba nti okuluŋŋamizibwa kujja kujja gy’ali oba tekujja; era ekisuubizo kyali kya lwatu nti, bwe kijja, kye baali bagenda okwogera kyali kya kubaweebwa mu ssaawa eyo.

N’olwekyo, okwetegekera kwonna okw’okubuulira kwawuliddwanga ng’obuteesigwa eri Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era kwayitibwanga “omulimu gw’ekitonde,” ekitegeeza nti kyali kitonde ekiri mu muntu, so si Omwoyo gwa Katonda, ekyali kifuga. Era tewaali kubuulira kwa ngeri eyo okwawuliddwanga nti kulina “okufukibwako amafuta okw’Omwoyo” okwali akakebera k’Abakwakeri ak’obuweereza bwonna.

Nsanze mu kitabo eky’edda eky’ebiggyibwa mu byawandiika bya Isaac Penington ebigambo bino ebikwata ku baweereza, ebiraga bulungi endowooza y’Abakwakeri.

“Si kubuulira bintu bya mazima ekifuula omuntu Omuweereza ow’amazima, wabula okuweebwa obuweereza bwe okuva eri Mukama. Enjiri ya Mukama, y’eteekwa okubuulirwa, era eteekwa okubuulirwa mu maanyi ge; era abaweereza ababuulira bo bateekwa okwambazibwa amaanyi ge, era okutumibwa Ye. … Oyo anaaba Omuweereza ow’amazima ateekwa okuweebwa ekirabo kye, n’obuweereza bwe, n’okukozesa byombi, okuva eri Mukama, era ateekwa okuba omukakafu mu buweereza bwe okusigala mu maanyi. … Ateekwa okulinda mu mirimu gye egy’enjawulo, okwambazibwa ensonga n’amaanyi okuva waggulu, nga tannaba kwasamya kamwa ke mu bujulirwa ku lwa Mukama.”

N’endowooza eno ku kubuulira, kyangu okutegeera nti “okulabika mu buweereza,” nga bwe kyayogerwanga mu ngeri ey’ekyafaayo, kyandiwuliddwa bonna nga si mutendera mukulu nnyo gwokka, naye n’ogutiisa ddala. Mu nnaku zange ez’obuto, bulijjo kyayogerwangako nga “okusitula omusaalaba” era kyatunuulirwanga ng’ekiweebwayo ekisinga obukulu omwoyo kye guyinza okuwaayo. Bulijjo kimbadde kizibu okutegeera empulira eno, kubanga mu bwange bwennyini, okubuulira kubadde kwa ssanyu okusingira ddala okuba ekiweebwayo. Naye oboolyawo kino kiyinza okuba nga kyava ku kubanga nzikirizza ekitundu ekimu oba ekirala ku kye Ab’Emikwano ab’edda kye bandiyita “ekitonde” okuyingira mu buweereza bwange, era ebigambo byange sisibye ku nsibuko ey’ekitiibwa ekingi bwe ntyo.

Ebbaluwa enkadde eya mmange ekwata ku “kulabika mu buweereza” kwa mwannyina, kojja wange John Tatum, ejja kunnyonnyola embeera y’empulira gye nnyonnyodde. Awandiikira kitaawe ne nnyina ku kukyala kwe yakyala kojja we, n’agamba nti: “Muwulidde ku kiweebwayo mwannyinaffe John omwagalwa ky’awaddeyo mu biseera bino, ng’awuliza kye nzikiriza nti kubadde kye yawuliranga eky’obuvunaanyizibwa okumala ebbanga, bw’awaddeyo okulabika mu bujulirwa n’okwegayirira mu lujjudde mu nkuŋŋaana zaabwe? Kibaddewo kasookedde tugendayo, naye ffembi twakwatibwa nnyo obubonero obw’okulafuubana n’okwewaayo okw’obuwombeefu obwalabikanga mu mpisa ze eza buli lunaku n’emboozi ze. Nsuubira ffenna tulyagala okumuwa amaanyi ag’okusaasira kwaffe okusinga obuwombeefu, n’okumusabira aluŋŋamizibwe, era akulemberwe, era akuumibwe mu kkubo ettuufu. Ntegeera nti emirundi mingi awulira nga ali bwannamunigina nnyo. Yaŋgamba nti, ‘Ah, mwannyinaze omwagalwa, kibadde kiseera kya ntiisa gye ndi mu biseera bino, mwe nnina okunoonya mu nnimiro ne mu bibira nzekka, ne nsaba n’amaanyi mangi olw’amaanyi n’okukuumibwa.’”

Sisobola butalowooza nti yali ndowooza ya bukyamu ku buweereza obw’Ekikristaayo eyaleetera Ab’Emikwano okuyita mu ntalo ng’ezo ku kye leero kyaanirizibwa ng’enkizo ey’ekitiibwa. Naye Obukwakeri bwonna mu biseera byange bwalimu ekitundu ekimu oba ekirala eky’omwoyo guno ogw’okwefiiriza ogw’okuwaayo, era yali ngeri ya bulijjo ddala ey’okutunuulira ensonga eno nga buli muyingira omuggya mu buweereza yagwangamu awatali kutegeera.

Nti abamu ku bo oluusi n’oluusi baafunanga akatego ku nkizo ey’obuweereza kiragibwa ekintu ekyaliwo ne kojja John yennyini oyo emyaka egiwerako oluvannyuma. Yali ayogera ne muganda wange ku “kukyala kw’eddiini” kwe yali akyaze mu biseera bino mu Nkuŋŋaana ez’oku lusalosalo, era, bwe baali baawukana, n’ayogera mu ddoboozi ery’ekitiibwa era ery’ennaku nti: “Kale onoolaba, James omwagalwa, omusaalaba omuzito bwe guteekeddwa ku nze.” Muganda wange yalaga okusaasira kwe, ne baawukana, buli omu n’akwata ekkubo lye.

Naye mu kaseera katono, kojja wange n’akomawo mangu, n’akwata muganda wange ku mukono n’agamba nti: “Ntya, James omwagalwa, nti nnaleese endowooza ey’obukyamu mu kye njogedde ku buweereza bwange nga musaalaba. Amazima gankaka okukwatula gy’oli nti si musaalaba n’akatono, wabula nkizo ya mukisa nnyo era esanyusa. Ntya nti ffe ababuulizi twogera nga bwe twogera ku musaalaba mu kubuulira, olw’empisa okusinga olw’ekituufu kyonna.”

Kyokka, buli kintu kyagattibwa okufuula obuweereza bw’Abakwakeri ensonga ey’ekyama ennyo era ey’ekitiibwa gye ffe abato. Waaliwo ekintu ekisikiriza ekitayogerekeka mu ndowooza ey’okuluŋŋamizibwa okwa butereevu era amangwago okw’ababuulizi baffe. Twalabikanga nga tuli, ng’okugamba, ku mabbali gennyini g’ensi ey’omwoyo, ng’obudde bwonna kigigi kiyinza okuggyibwako, ne tuyinza okufuna okubikkulirwa okw’ekyama okuva ku ludda olulala; era okwegomba okw’amaanyi, kyokka n’entiisa ey’ekitiibwa, gye twalabiriranga era ne twalindirira okubikkulirwa kuno tekuyinza, nkakasa, kutegeerwa mulembe guno ogw’abato, wadde nga bo bennyini baba Bakwakeri.

Entiisa n’ekyama byetooloolanga, gye tuli, buli “Mukwano aweereza,” oba musajja oba mukazi, oba mugagga oba mwavu, oba w’amagezi oba wa bwangu; era kino nga tekikwatagana n’obuntu bw’Omuweereza. Kyava kyokka era ddala ku kituufu nti twakkiriza nti Abaweereza be baali abalanzi abalondeddwa Katonda okulangirira ebirowoozo bya Katonda, era nti buli kigambo kye baayinza okwogera kyaluŋŋamizibwanga butereevu, era nga kya lwatu ng’ekitasobya nga Bayibuli yennyini bw’eri. N’olwekyo, ekyo omu ku bo kye yayinza “okuluŋŋamizibwa” okugamba omuntu kyali kya bukulu bwa maanyi ennyo, era nga kya kukkiriza okusinga obuziba. Kimu ku bintu ebyansanyusanga ennyo mu bulamu bwange obw’obuto, n’olwekyo, kyali kisoboka nti obudde bwonna nnyinza okubuulirwa nzekka oba okwogererwako obunnabbi “Omukwano aweereza.”
