Naye Mukama yeebazibwe, bangi bajja okulaba obutaliimu bw'empisa eyo ey'okuggyako enkuufiira eri abantu, ne bawulira obuzito bw'obujulizi bw'Amazima obwakikontana.” Abagoberezi ba George Fox bonna baakkiriza okubikkulirwa kuno ng'obulagirizi eri bo bennyini nga bwe kwali eri ye. Baaleka empisa ez'ensi ze yanenya, nga babitwala ng'ekiweebwayo eri Amazima era ng'engeri ey'okukola ebikolwa byabwe bibe bilaga bulungi omwoyo gwe baayatula. Okwefiiriza kuno kwagenda mu maaso okutuuka mu biseera byange, wadde nga ndowooza nti bangi ku abo abaakukola tebaakyategeera bulungi ensonga eziri emabega w'enjawulo zino. Ab'Omukwano abamu mu buvubuka bwange baatuuka n'okutwala okwambala enkuufiira mu biseera byonna bwe kyasobokanga — ne mu kiseera eky'okulya — ng'ekika ky'obuvunaanyizibwa obw'eddiini. Lumu, omuvubuka gwe nnali mmanyi yali atambula n'Omukadde mu nguudo z'e Wilmington, mu Delaware. Omukadde yali amuwabula ku bukulu obw'okuwagira obujulizi bw'Ab'Omukwano mu mbeera zonna, n'agamba nti: “Nnalabye, munnange omuvubuka omwagalwa, n'essanyu lingi, nti weegendereza obutaggyako nkuufiira yo bw'osisinkana ba mikwano bo mu luguudo, wadde okugiggyako bw'oyingira mu nnyumba y'olukuŋŋaana okutuusa lw'otudde mu kifo kyo. Naye ndaba nga waliwo ekifo eky'obwesigwa obusingako mu nsonga eno, era nziggye omutima okukugamba nti nzikiriza nti kituufu gye ndi okwambala enkuufiira yange mu biseera byonna okuggyako nga ndi mu kitanda. Ngyambala amangu ddala nga ngolokoka mu makya, era ssiwulira ddembe kugiggyako okutuusa nga nnyambadde engoye zange ez'ekiro, nga tennaba kugalamira mu kitanda ekiro.” Empisa eno ey'okusigaza enkuufiira ku mutwe emirundi mingi yaleetanga enkaayana n'okugezesebwa eri Abakwakeri, abaali, olw'obuvunaanyizibwa obw'ekibiina oba obw'ebyobusuubuzi, basabibwanga okulabika mu maaso g'abantu abaali basuubira akabonero kano ak'ekitiibwa. Mu Njaali z'Ab'Omukwano ez'edda (Friends' Journals), mulimu ebyafaayo bingi ku kubonaabona okwaleetebwa “obujulizi buno obw'enkuufiira.” Mu Njaali ya Thomas Ellwood, mukwano gwa Milton, eyakkiriza endowooza z'Ab'Omukwano, annyonnyola obukyayi bwa kitaawe obw'amaanyi eri obujulizi buno. Awandiika nti: “Okulaba enkuufiira yange ku mutwe gwange bwe nnayingira mu maaso ge kyamusunguwaza nnyo, n'andumba n'emikono gyombi, n'ansikako enkuufiira yange n'amaanyi n'agisuula wala; oluvannyuma n'ankuba ebikonde ku mutwe, n'aŋŋamba nti, ‘Ggwe omusajja, genda waggulu mu kisenge kyo.’” Ku lunaku olulala, ategeeza engeri gye yagenda ku mmeeza y'ekyekiro ng'ayambadde enkuufiira ye: “Nga naaka nnyingira, nnasobola okulaba ku ndabika ya kitange nti enkuufiira yange yali ekyali kimwesittaza. Naye bwe nnatuula, nga sinnalya kantu konna, yakyeyongera okukiraga bwe yaŋŋamba nti, ‘Bw'oba tosobola kumatira kujja ku kyekiro nga toli na Hise yo ku mutwe (bwe yayita enkuufiira yange), kkaakkati golokoka ogende olye ekyekiro kyo awalala.’ Bwe nnawulira kino, nnagolokoka okuva ku mmeeza ne ŋŋenda mu ffumbiro, we nnasigala okutuusa abaddu lwe baatuula ku kyekiro, ne ndyoka ntuula nabo nga nsanyufu.” Emyaka mingi oluvannyuma lw'ekyo Ellwood kye yayitamu, Ow'omukwano Omungereza omugagga, Joseph John Gurney, yannyonnyola okugezesebwa kwe mu 1810: “Nnali nsuubizza edda ennaku nga tennatuuka ku mbaga y'ekyekiro. Wiiki ssatu nga tezinnatuuka, nnali mu kutya nga mmanyi nti nteekwa okuyingira mu kisenge eky'okusembezaamu abagenyi nga nnyambadde enkuufiira. Okwefiiriza kuno, ne bwe kwaba nga kwewuunyisa era nga tekunnyonnyoleka, saayinza kukwewala. Nga nnyambadde ebyambalo by'Ow'omukwano, era nga nnyambadde enkuufiira, nnayingira mu kisenge mu kiseera kye nnali ntidde, ne nkwata omukazi nnannyini nnyumba mu ngalo, ne nziira mu kisasi, ne nteekawo enkuufiira yange, ne nkomawo. Nnaddayo eka nga nnina emirembe egy'ekigero. Oluvannyuma, nnalina okukola ekintu kye kimu ewa omulabirizi. Ekyavaamu kwe kuba nti nneesanga nga ndi Mukwakeri atajjululukana, nga ntegeerekeka bulungi nga nnatwala embeera eyo, era ku mbaga z'ekyekiro — okuggyako ez'omu maka — saayongera kuyitibwa.” Oluvannyuma nnyo, kitaffe omwagalwa ffe yalina okusoomoozebwa okufaanana. Lumu, yali asuubira okulondebwa okuba kapiteeni w'ekyombo eky'omugaso, era bwe yali yeeteekateeka okusaba bannannyini kyo, yalwanagana nnyo kubanga yakkiriza nti kyali kya buvunaanyizibwa bwe okuyingira mu maaso gaabwe ng'ayambadde enkuufiira. Yatya nti kino kyandibafuulidde ekikyamu ku ye, naye yasigala anywevu mu kye yakkiriza okuba obuvunaanyizibwa bwe obw'eddiini, era yeesiga nti Mukama yandimuwadde omukisa. Mu kitabo kye eky'ebyafaayo, awandiika nti: “Abamu ku ba mikwano bange baalowooza nti ebyambalo byange ebyereere n'olulimi lwange byandinziyizza, naye nnabagamba balinde balabe oba sijja kufuna kifo olw'omukisa gwa Katonda, gwe mpa buli buwanguzi bwange mu bulamu. Ekyombo New Jersey kyasooka okuteekebwa mu mazzi ku lunaku olusooka olw'Omwezi ogw'ekkumi n'ebiri, 1824, era ku lw'okusatu, Whitton Evans, nnannyini kyo, yampa obuvunaanyizibwa okukiduumira.” Bwe nnali nsoma ekitabo eky'okunyuma ennyo mu biseera bino, The Testament of Ignatius Loyola, nnewuunya okuzuula nti omutukuvu ono ow'edda ow'omu kyasa eky'ekkumi n'omukaaga yalina ebingi ku bibuuzo bino eby'omunda eby'Abakwakeri ab'edda. Awandiika nti empisa ye mu kwogera n'abantu yali okuleka ebitiibwa byonna nga “Ssebo wange Omukama” oba “Ow'ekitiibwa Omusumba,” ng'akkiriza nti obwereere obwo bwe bwali empisa ya Kristo n'Abatume be. Era ategeeza engeri gye yakemebwa, olw'okutya ebyandivuddemu, okuwummuza empisa eno mu nsonga ya kapiteeni omu, era nti amangu ddala bwe yakitegeera nga kwe kukemebwa, yamalirira nti: “Bwe kiri bwe kityo, sijja kumuyita Ssebo wange Omukama, wadde okumussaamu ekitiibwa, wadde okuggyako enkuufiira ku mutwe gwange.” Mu butuufu, mu byafaayo byonna eby'Ekikristaayo, emu ku ngeri abakkiriza abeewaddeyo gye baalagangamu okwewaayo kwabwe yali okuyita mu njawulo mu byambalo oba mu nnjogera, era ng'oggyeeko ekika kye ekyo kye kyatwala, Ab'Omukwano ab'edda tebaali ba njawulo mu kino. Naye mu ngeri ey'enjawulo eri ebibiina ebirala bingi eby'Ekikristaayo, baalina ne bujulizi obw'enjawulo obwakontana n'amabala gonna amakaayirivu, agaali, olw'ensonga ezitali za lwatu ddala, gatwalibwa ng'ag'ensi. Amabala aga kikaaki n'agaddugavuddugavu gaatwalibwa ng'agatali g'ensi, era ebyambalo byaffe ebisinga byali bya ngeri emu ku mabala gano. Oluusi akaddugavu katono kaakkirizibwanga, era mu ngeri ey'okwewuunya, akakobe akaddugavu kaakkirizibwanga oluusi, naye akamyufu, obubuluu, akapinki, oba akakyenvu byali bigaaniddwa ddala nga “amasanyuufu ennyo.” Nnali mmanyi n'Ab'Omukwano abamu ab'omwoyo omunyiikivu abataawuliranga ddembe kulima bimuli bya jeraniyamu ebimyufu ennyo mu nnimiro zaabwe oba okuterekamu ekita ky'ebimuli ebimyufu mu bisenge byabwe eby'okusembezaamu abagenyi. Bwe nnamala okufuuka omuyigiriza w'eddiini eyategeerekeka, abantu abaali mu buzibu obw'omwoyo emirundi mingi bajjanga gye ndi okunoonya obuyambi. Mu bo mwalimu Ow'omukwano omuvubuka eyalina omuntu ow'omunda omunyiikivu ennyo, eyajja lumu ng'aweddemu amaanyi olw'ebimuli bya jeraniyamu ebimyufu. Yali abeera mu kitundu kimu eky'ennyumba eyagabwamu ebbiri mu bitundu eby'ebweru w'ekibuga Philadelphia. Mu maaso g'ennyumba zombi mwalimu akannimiro akatono akagabaanwa nga kalina ekitanda ky'ebimuli eky'obumbwe, ke bombi ne muliraanwa we baaddiŋŋananga okujjuza buli mwaka. Omwaka ogwo, gwali mulundi gwe, era ng'ayagala okusanyusa muliraanwa we, yamubuuza ebimuli bye baali baba basimba. Muliraanwa yayagala ebimuli bya jeraniyamu ebimyufu, era mukwano gwange yali anaatera okubiragira olwo ekibuuzo eky'amangu ne kimukwata nga tekimukkiriza kuleka bimuli bimyufu ng'ebyo kuyonja nnimiro eri mu maaso g'ennyumba ye. Yalwanagana era n'akisabira, era gye yeeyongera okusaba, eddoboozi ery'omunda ne lyeyongera okwewulikika nga limugamba nti tekyandibadde kituufu okusimba jeraniyamu ebimyufu. Naye engeri y'okunnyonnyola kino eri muliraanwa we — atamanyi kantu ku Ab'Omukwano — teyagisobola kulowooza, era yajja gye ndi ng'aweddemu amaanyi ennyo okunoonya obuyambi. Bulijjo nsanga nti tewali kintu kizibu kulwanyisa okusinga ebibuuzo eby'omunda. Wadde nga nnafuba nnyo okukakasa mukwano gwange omunaku, eyali atabuse ennyo, nti waliwo ebintu mu bulamu obw'Ekikristaayo ebisingako obukulu ku langi z'ebimuli mu nnimiro zaffe — era nti Mukama ayinza okusanyusibwa okusingako empisa ennungi n'ekisa eri muliraanwa we okusinga etteeka lyonna eritanyeenyezebwa erikwata ku langi z'ebimuli, ezo, mu butuufu, ye kennyini ze yatonda era noolwekyo tazinyiigira — byonna byali bya bwereere. Ku nkomerero, nnawalirizibwa okumuwa amagezi ge nnali sikkiririzaamu nnyo: nnamugamba nti “buuza Josiya.” Josiya yali balo, era nnali mmanyi nti yalina amagezi amalungi ag'ekigero. Wadde nga mu bulijjo saakkirizanga baami kusalirawo bakazi baabwe nsonga za ngeri eno, mu mbeera eno, kyali kifaanana ng'ekyetaagisa ddala. Obwesige bwange bwakakasibwa, kubanga Josiya yagamba — mu magezi mangi — nti yandyetisse obuvunaanyizibwa obw'ebimuli bya jeraniyamu ebimyufu ku bibegabega bye ye, era nti yali akakasa nti Mukama tandinyiizeddwa okulaba, mu maaso g'ennyumba yaabwe, ebimuli bye yatonda ye kennyini. Ng'ekitali kya kwewuunya, ng'ebiseera bwe byagenda, enkyukakyuka mu ndowooza zino ezaali ez'ekikankalubo zaatandika okulabika, era mu bulamu bwange nnalabye enkyukakyuka ezaajjanga mpolampola nga, bwe nnali omwana, nnandizirowoozezza ng'okuvvoola Katonda okuzirowoozaako obulowoozi. Abavubuka ab'omulembe gwange — abaatwala obujulizi buno obw'edda ng'obw' “empisa z'abakadde” bwokka so nga si nzikiriza z'obuntu bwabwe — bwe baakula ne batuuka mu bukulu, baabuleka mpolampola. Olukuŋŋaana lwa buli mwaka olumu ng'oluddirira ne lumanyiira enkyukakyuka ezandibakutamizza ku ttaka olw'ensonyi n'ennaku. Ab'Omukwano Abangereza, nga bwe nzijukira, be baasooka okukkakkana; naye Enkuŋŋaana za buli mwaka ez'Abamerika, okuggyako eyaffe ey'e Philadelphia, tezaali nnyuma nnyo. Ffe mu Philadelphia twanywerera ku mpisa zaffe ez'edda okumala ekiseera kyonna kye twasobola, naye ne ffe twateekwa okukkakkana ku nkomerero. Omu ku bannyinaze yafumbirwa n'abeera mu Lukuŋŋaana lwa buli mwaka olw'e Baltimore — Olukuŋŋaana olwaakkiriza enkyukakyuka zino amangu nnyo okutusinga, era ffe mu Philadelphia lwe twatwala nga “olw'amasanyuufu” mu ngeri ey'okunakuwaza. Naye muganda wange yatwala omwoyo gwa Philadelphia awamu naye, era ng'ekika kye ekinene eky'abaana abawala bwe baakula, yagezaako nnyo okubakuuma ku mutindo gwa Philadelphia ogw'obwereere. Naye byonna byali bya bwereere; ekiggya ekimu nga kiddirira ekirala ne kiyingira mpolampola, era yeesanga nga talina maanyi ga kukiziyiza. Eky'omukisa, yali aweereddwa ekirabo eky'okuseka okusanyusa, era ne mu makkati g'okulwanirira obwereere, yasobola okulaba obusiru bw'embeera. Yajja gye ndi lumu okunnyonnyola ebizibu bye n'okusaba amagezi gange. Bwe yamala okuteeka byonna mu maaso gange, amangu ago n'abuuka ng'alina akatangaala ak'obukujju mu liiso lye, n'ayimusa ekigere kimu waggulu, n'agamba nti: “Kaakkati, Hannah, nkwegayiridde ombuulire we kinaabeera obukuume okussa ekigere kyange wansi. Omulundi ogumu nnakissa wansi ku ngoye ez'okusseeko waggulu (overskirts), naye amangu ne nkiyimusa nate. Ne ndyoka nkissa wansi mu bimuli eby'ekikwakkulizo mu nkuufiira z'abaana, ne kinneetaagisa okukiyimusa nate. Oluvannyuma, nnakissa wansi ku mpeta ku ngalo zaabwe, era nate ne kiteekwa okuyimusibwa. Kaakkati saagala kukissa wansi nate okutuusa lwe nnaakakasa ddala nti sijja kwetaaga kukiyimusa. Olowooza, Hannah,” — era wano n'afuula amaaso ge nga ga bukulu obusekerezebwa — “nti nnyinza okugezaako mu bukuume okukissa wansi ku mpeta z'ennyindo?” Kino kyansukkirira obuzito bwange. Nnabwatuka mu kuseka, ne muganda wange n'anneegatta. Mu ngeri emu, embeera n'etereera, era yasalawo nti teyandiyongedde ku kufuba okutaliimu kw'okussa endowooza za Philadelphia ku Baltimore. Yandikkirizza enkyukakyuka ezitasoboka kwewalika ezaali ziteekwa okujja, ne mu kibiina eky'ekikankalubo nga Ab'Omukwano. Amazima amangu, nga bwe ndaze, gaali nti ekiruubirirwa ky'Abakwakeri bulijjo kyali kwewala kugoberera “enkola ez'obwereere ez'ensi.” Baayambalanga ekika ekiggya kyokka nga kimaze okukaddiwa era nga kiggwaawo. Ab'Omukwano ab'e Baltimore baali beetegefu okukola kino katono nga tebannaba ku Ab'Omukwano ab'e Philadelphia. Omu ku bawala ba bannyinaze ab'e Baltimore yaŋŋamba nti yajjukira okujja lumu e Philadelphia okwetaba mu mbaga eyakolebwa bannaabbe ab'e Philadelphia, n'awulira ng'ali w'ensi nnyo era omwonoonyi kubanga ekyambalo kye kyali kikoleddwa mu nkola ennaddaali okusinga eky'abo. Nga bino byonna Abakwakeri abavubuka ab'omulembe guno bwe batasobola kutegeera! Naye nga byonna bwe byali bya nnamaddala nnyo gye tuli.

fields.title: Okwogera Okw'Obwangu
fields.body_html:
“Okwogera okw'obwangu” okwayogerwako mu Kibuuzo eky'Okusatu, okusinga byonna kwategeeza okukozesa thee ne thou ng'oyogera n'omuntu omu, mu kifo ky'ekigambo ekya bulijjo you. Obujulizi buno, awamu n'obujulizi obw'engoye enkalu, bwe bwali obumu ku bubonero obukulu obwatwawulanga ng'abantu ab'enjawulo. Okugamba you eri omuntu omu — ka abe Mukwano oba omugwira — kyalowoozebwanga okuba ekyensi eky'oku ntikko era eky'obukuusa. So nayagala okumenya etteeka lino n'olumu, okutuusa lwe nafumbirwa.

Awo nga bwe kiri, kino kyaleetanga obuzibu mu kutabagana n'ab'ebweru w'ekibiina, kubanga engeri yaffe ey'enjawulo ey'okwogera teyalemwanga kuleeta ntunuulira ez'okwewuunya oba enseko ez'okuziyiza.

Emirandira gy'obujulizi buno gyali mu bwesimbu obutuukiridde obw'Emikwano ab'edda. Baawulira nga si kya mazima okukozesa ekigambo eky'obungi eri omuntu omu. Ate era, mu biseera byabwe, kyali kya bulijjo okuyita oyo ali waggulu you, nga thee ne thou bibikibwa ab'ettendo erya wansi. Naye Emikwano, abaakkiririzaanga nti abantu bonna benkanankana mu maaso ga Katonda — era abaakikkiririzaamu mu ngeri ey'omugaso ennyo — tebaayinza kugumiikiriza njawulo ng'eyo. Kyebava bayita buli muntu mu ngeri y'emu.

Emikwano abo ab'edda baali ba demokulasiya mu buli kawayiro k'obulamu bwabwe, si lwa nfumiikiriza za bufuzi wabula olw'okukakasa kwabwe okutasagaasagana nti Katonda yakola amawanga gonna ag'ensi okuva mu musaayi gumu, era nti bonna baali baana be mu ngeri y'emu. Gwali musingi mulungi ku gwe baazimbako empisa zaabwe, era guyamba okunnyonnyola empisa nnyingi eziyinza obutali ekyo okulabika ng'ez'enjawulo oba n'ez'obusirusiru.

Thomas Ellwood, mu byafaayo bye eby'obulamu bwe, ayogera ku bintu eby'enjawulo bye yawulira ng'ayitiddwa okuleka ng'amaze okukakasibwa amakulu g'enzikiriza y'Emikwano. Ku bikwata ku lulimi olw'obwangu, yawandiika nti okukozesa you eri omuntu omu kyali “ngeri ya kwogera eyonoonefu era etaliimu mazima,” eyayingizibwa mu “biseera eby'oluvannyuma era ebyonoonefu” ng'ekkubo ery'okuwaanawaana obwerimbi obw'ensi. Olw'okubanga Katonda bulijjo yayogeranga n'abantu ng'akozesa thou, era n'abantu bulijjo baayogeranga ne Katonda nga bakozesa thou, Ellwood yakitwala ng'obuvunaanyizibwa obw'empisa okugoberera ekyokulabirako ekyo. Wansi w'omusana ogw'ekyo kye yayita “akatangaala akalongoofu ak'ekitangaala kya Katonda,” yawulira ng'asaanidde okuleka empisa nnyingi “embi” bwe zityo ezaali zivuddeyo mu kiro ekiwanvu eky'ekizikiza eky'omwoyo.

Obujulizi buno bwali bwa maanyi nnyo mu buto bwange, ne kiba nti okugamba you eri omuntu omu kyandirabise ng'ekyensi eky'ekyewuunyo, nga kumpi kifaanana “eky'amasanyu” ng'okwambala siriki oba engoye enzigagavu. Ne bwe nakula ne ntandika okuyingira mu nsi ennyo, ne nsisinkana Abakristaayo abalungi era abanyiikivu abaakozesanga ekigambo ekyaziyizibwa nga tebalina kubuusabuusa n'akatono, kyansaba okufuba okunene okuwaliriza emimwa gyange egy'Ekikwano okukyogera. Mpolampola, obuzibu bwaggwaawo. Kaakano, oluvannyuma lw'emyaka egisukka mu nsanvu, thee ne thou binfuukidde bwe kiri olulimi olw'okwagalana okw'oku lusegere, nga biva bulijjo buli lwe waba omuntu atuuse mu mutima gwange mu mazima. Emirundi mingi neebuuza ku nneewulira zange eri omuntu nga nkozesa ekigezo kino: bwe mpulira nga njogera thee, mmanya nti ntandise okumwagala. Emikwano gyange mingi — abamu nga tebalina nkolagana yonna n'Emikwano — bakwatiddwa empisa eno okuva gye ndi, era bakozesa ebigambo ebyo ebyagalwa eby'edda mu bwetuwaanya bwaffe obw'ekyama. Munnange omwagalwa Frances Willard yali omu ku bo; twayogeraganga thee ne thou okumala emyaka mingi.

Omuwandiisi gwe najuliza emabega, mu A Boy's Religion, annyonnyola engeri gye yawuliramu ng'omwana ku bikwata ku kwogera okw'obwangu.

“Nagambanga ‘thee’ ne ‘thy’ eri buli muntu,” bwe yawandiika, “era nnandisinze okukozesa olulimi olw'obuvvoolo okusinga okugamba ‘you’ oba ‘yours’ eri omuntu yenna. Nalowooza nti Emikwano bokka be baagenda mu Ggulu, kyennava ndowooza nti okukozesa ‘thee’ ne ‘thy’ kwali kumu ku bigezo ebikulu eby'okuyingizibwa. Tewali n'omu eyali ambuulidde ekintu ng'ekyo, era singa nabuuza, nandiragiddwa amazima — naye okumala emyaka egiwera eyo ye yali enzikiriza yange enywevu.”

Yeeyongera okunnyonnyola engeri gye yasaasiranga baliraanwa be abo, mu birowoozo bye, abataali baakukkirizibwa “kuyingira,” n'awuniikirira lwaki tebeegatta ku Lukuŋŋaana ne bayiga okwogera obulungi. Yayigiriza n'omukwano gwe omu omuto “Omunnaggwanga” olulimi olw'obwangu, era omulenzi yalukozesa n'obwesigwa naye okutuusa okunyigirizibwa okw'ensi ey'ebweru, nga bwe yakyogera, “lwe kwayitirira obuzito” nga wamu n'emyaka kkumi n'ebiri.

Obujulizi obulala obwakwatagananga n'okwogera okw'obwangu kwali kuziyiza okuyita omuntu yenna Mr., Mrs., oba Miss. Ebitiibwa bino kyalowoozebwanga nti bimenya omwoyo gw'ebigambo bya Kristo, nti, “So temuyitibwanga bakulembeze: kubanga omukulembeze wammwe ali omu, ye Kristo.” Tewali Mukwano wa mazima eyandiwadde ekitiibwa omuntu omugagga ate n'akimmyako omwavu; kyebava bakozesa amannya ag'Ekikristaayo eri bonna — Thomas, Samuel, Abigail, Elizabeth, n'ebirala. (Twali tetulina Reginald, Bertrand, Ethel, oba Evelyn mu biro ebyo!)

Awo obukulu we bwasabanga ekitiibwa ekitono ekisingako, abavubuka baali basuubirwa okukozesa erinnya erijjuvu — Thomas Wistar, Abigail Evans, Samuel Bettle, Elizabeth Pitfield. Empisa eno yaleeta obuzibu obutakoma bwe waabanga okuli okukola n'“abantu b'ensi,” era n'ereeta ensonga nnyingi ez'okusoberwa.

Taata waffe omwagalwa yali munywevu nnyo ku nsonga eno, era teyasoboka kubuuzibwako — ka kibe kizibu kitya — okukozesa ebitiibwa “eby'amasanyu” Mr. oba Mrs. Nzijukira bulungi amasanyu ge twafuna, nga tumaze okukula, nga tulaba enkola ze ez'amagezi ez'okuwona obuzibu buli lwe yabanga tamanyi linnya lya muntu erisooka. Mu kifo kya Mr. oba Mrs., yagunjawo ekigambo eky'okudda mu kifo Cummishilamus, era yagambanga, okugeza, “Cummishilamus Coleman yagamba…” oba “Cummishilamus Coleman yakola…” Naye bwe yabanga alina okuwandiika ebbaluwa, teyayinzanga, mazima ddala, kuwandiika kigambo kya ngeri eyo, awo n'akyukira omu ku ffe, ng'amaaso ge amagalwa gamasamasa n'essanyu, n'agamba, “Jjangu, Han, ggwe tolina kubuusabuusa — oyinza okuwandiika Mr. oba Mrs. ku bbaluwa eno.”

Okwogera okw'obwangu kwatuziyiza n'okulamusa emikwano gyaffe nga tugamba good morning, good evening, oba okugamba good-bye nga tubaawukanako. Good-bye kyalowoozebwanga okuba ekyonoonefu ekivudde ku God be with you (Katonda abeere naawe), era olw'okubanga Katonda bulijjo yali naawe, kyalabika ng'engeri y'obutakkiriza okwogera okwegomba okwo. N'okugamba good morning oba good evening — okwegomba nti oyinza okuba n'enkya oba akawungeezi akalungi — kyategeezanga okubuusabuusa ku kya mazima, ekyamanyibwa buli Mukwano, nti enkya zo n'obudde bwo obw'akawungeezi, mu ntegeka y'Obulabirizi bwa Katonda, bulijjo bwateekwa okuba obulungi.

Nakula n'endowooza entangaavu nti ebigambo bino byali bya masanyu nnyo era bya nsi, era nti ekkubo ettuufu — oba, nga bwe twagambanga, ery'obwangu — kwali kulamusa mikwano nga tugamba How art thou? Oba how does thee do?, n'okubaawukanako n'ekigambo ekyangu Farewell.

Lwaki Farewell kyalowoozebwanga okuba eky'amazima okusinga good-bye, ne bwe kiba nti good-bye kyategeeza God be with you, sinnasobola kutegeera.

Mu ngeri egendera bulungi n'ekiruubirirwa ky'Emikwano eky'okwenkanankana okutuukiridde okw'abantu bonna mu maaso ga Katonda, okwogera okw'obwangu kwatuziyiza n'okuwa ekitiibwa Saint eri Omukristaayo yenna eyafa.

Tetwakkirizibwanga kukikozesa n'akatono, ne nga kasooka mu maaso g'erinnya. Okugeza, tetwayogeranga ku Njiri nga the Gospel according to St. Matthew oba St. Mark, wabula bulijjo nga Enjiri eya Matayo, oba Makko, Lukka, oba Yokaana.

Nakaseera nalaba, mu kitabo eky'ebyafaayo eky'edda okuva mu kyasa eky'ekkumi n'omusanvu, olugero olw'Omukwano omu ow'omuntima ogw'obwegendereza ennyo eyawulira ng'aziyizibwa okukozesa akasooka saint ne mu mannya g'ebifo. Lumu yafuna obuzibu bungi okuzuula St. Mary Axe kubanga, ng'aggyeewo Saint, yabuuza kokka “Mary Axe Street,” ekyo tewali n'omu eyakitegeera.

Ng'obujulizi obulwanyisa okusinza ebifaananyi, twaziyizibwa n'okuyita emyezi gy'omwaka oba ennaku z'omu wiiki n'amannya gaabyo “ag'abakaafiiri.” Twayigirizibwa okunywerera ku “bwangu obw'amazima” nga tukozesa ennamba: First Month, Second Month; oba First Day, Second Day, n'ebirala. Empisa eno yali ekozesebwa nnyo mu kibiina kyange ne kiba nti tekyanzijiranga na ku mutima okukozesa amannya ag'abakaafiiri.

Nzijukira okwewuunya ennyo bwe najja mu Bungereza mu 1873 ne nzuula nti Emikwano ab'e Bungereza baali balese empisa eyo ne badda ku mannya ag'edda “ag'abakaafiiri.” Okumala akaseera, nnali sisobola kwekakasa nti ddala baali Mikwano n'akatono. Era ne kaakano, bwe nteeka ennaku ku bbaluwa zange n'amannya ago, nkyawulira ng'eyita mu lugendo oluto oluziyiziddwa mu “nsi ey'amasanyu.”
fields.body_text: “Okwogera okw'obwangu” okwayogerwako mu Kibuuzo eky'Okusatu, okusinga byonna kwategeeza okukozesa thee ne thou ng'oyogera n'omuntu omu, mu kifo ky'ekigambo ekya bulijjo you. Obujulizi buno, awamu n'obujulizi obw'engoye enkalu, bwe bwali obumu ku bubonero obukulu obwatwawulanga ng'abantu ab'enjawulo. Okugamba you eri omuntu omu — ka abe Mukwano oba omugwira — kyalowoozebwanga okuba ekyensi eky'oku ntikko era eky'obukuusa. So nayagala okumenya etteeka lino n'olumu, okutuusa lwe nafumbirwa. Awo nga bwe kiri, kino kyaleetanga obuzibu mu kutabagana n'ab'ebweru w'ekibiina, kubanga engeri yaffe ey'enjawulo ey'okwogera teyalemwanga kuleeta ntunuulira ez'okwewuunya oba enseko ez'okuziyiza. Emirandira gy'obujulizi buno gyali mu bwesimbu obutuukiridde obw'Emikwano ab'edda. Baawulira nga si kya mazima okukozesa ekigambo eky'obungi eri omuntu omu. Ate era, mu biseera byabwe, kyali kya bulijjo okuyita oyo ali waggulu you, nga thee ne thou bibikibwa ab'ettendo erya wansi. Naye Emikwano, abaakkiririzaanga nti abantu bonna benkanankana mu maaso ga Katonda — era abaakikkiririzaamu mu ngeri ey'omugaso ennyo — tebaayinza kugumiikiriza njawulo ng'eyo. Kyebava bayita buli muntu mu ngeri y'emu. Emikwano abo ab'edda baali ba demokulasiya mu buli kawayiro k'obulamu bwabwe, si lwa nfumiikiriza za bufuzi wabula olw'okukakasa kwabwe okutasagaasagana nti Katonda yakola amawanga gonna ag'ensi okuva mu musaayi gumu, era nti bonna baali baana be mu ngeri y'emu. Gwali musingi mulungi ku gwe baazimbako empisa zaabwe, era guyamba okunnyonnyola empisa nnyingi eziyinza obutali ekyo okulabika ng'ez'enjawulo oba n'ez'obusirusiru. Thomas Ellwood, mu byafaayo bye eby'obulamu bwe, ayogera ku bintu eby'enjawulo bye yawulira ng'ayitiddwa okuleka ng'amaze okukakasibwa amakulu g'enzikiriza y'Emikwano. Ku bikwata ku lulimi olw'obwangu, yawandiika nti okukozesa you eri omuntu omu kyali “ngeri ya kwogera eyonoonefu era etaliimu mazima,” eyayingizibwa mu “biseera eby'oluvannyuma era ebyonoonefu” ng'ekkubo ery'okuwaanawaana obwerimbi obw'ensi. Olw'okubanga Katonda bulijjo yayogeranga n'abantu ng'akozesa thou, era n'abantu bulijjo baayogeranga ne Katonda nga bakozesa thou, Ellwood yakitwala ng'obuvunaanyizibwa obw'empisa okugoberera ekyokulabirako ekyo. Wansi w'omusana ogw'ekyo kye yayita “akatangaala akalongoofu ak'ekitangaala kya Katonda,” yawulira ng'asaanidde okuleka empisa nnyingi “embi” bwe zityo ezaali zivuddeyo mu kiro ekiwanvu eky'ekizikiza eky'omwoyo. Obujulizi buno bwali bwa maanyi nnyo mu buto bwange, ne kiba nti okugamba you eri omuntu omu kyandirabise ng'ekyensi eky'ekyewuunyo, nga kumpi kifaanana “eky'amasanyu” ng'okwambala siriki oba engoye enzigagavu. Ne bwe nakula ne ntandika okuyingira mu nsi ennyo, ne nsisinkana Abakristaayo abalungi era abanyiikivu abaakozesanga ekigambo ekyaziyizibwa nga tebalina kubuusabuusa n'akatono, kyansaba okufuba okunene okuwaliriza emimwa gyange egy'Ekikwano okukyogera. Mpolampola, obuzibu bwaggwaawo. Kaakano, oluvannyuma lw'emyaka egisukka mu nsanvu, thee ne thou binfuukidde bwe kiri olulimi olw'okwagalana okw'oku lusegere, nga biva bulijjo buli lwe waba omuntu atuuse mu mutima gwange mu mazima. Emirundi mingi neebuuza ku nneewulira zange eri omuntu nga nkozesa ekigezo kino: bwe mpulira nga njogera thee, mmanya nti ntandise okumwagala. Munnange omwagalwa Frances Willard yali omu ku bo; twayogeraganga thee ne thou okumala emyaka mingi. Omuwandiisi gwe najuliza emabega, mu A Boy's Religion, annyonnyola engeri gye yawuliramu ng'omwana ku bikwata ku kwogera okw'obwangu. “Nagambanga ‘thee’ ne ‘thy’ eri buli muntu,” bwe yawandiika, “era nnandisinze okukozesa olulimi olw'obuvvoolo okusinga okugamba ‘you’ oba ‘yours’ eri omuntu yenna. Nalowooza nti Emikwano bokka be baagenda mu Ggulu, kyennava ndowooza nti okukozesa ‘thee’ ne ‘thy’ kwali kumu ku bigezo ebikulu eby'okuyingizibwa. Tewali n'omu eyali ambuulidde ekintu ng'ekyo, era singa nabuuza, nandiragiddwa amazima — naye okumala emyaka egiwera eyo ye yali enzikiriza yange enywevu.” Yeeyongera okunnyonnyola engeri gye yasaasiranga baliraanwa be abo, mu birowoozo bye, abataali baakukkirizibwa “kuyingira,” n'awuniikirira lwaki tebeegatta ku Lukuŋŋaana ne bayiga okwogera obulungi. Yayigiriza n'omukwano gwe omu omuto “Omunnaggwanga” olulimi olw'obwangu, era omulenzi yalukozesa n'obwesigwa naye okutuusa okunyigirizibwa okw'ensi ey'ebweru, nga bwe yakyogera, “lwe kwayitirira obuzito” nga wamu n'emyaka kkumi n'ebiri. Obujulizi obulala obwakwatagananga n'okwogera okw'obwangu kwali kuziyiza okuyita omuntu yenna Mr., Mrs., oba Miss. fields.title: Obujulizi bw'Ab'oluganda obuwakanya Ebitabo eby'Obulimba, Ennyimba, n'Obukugu bw'Ebifaananyi
fields.body_html:
Ekintu ekirala ekyayimusibwa mu Kibuuzo kye kimu Ekyokusatu kyatuleetera obuzibu obutali butono: ekibuuzo eky'oba nga Ab'oluganda baali beegendereza okulera abaana baabwe mu “kusoma Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu emirundi mingi, n'okubaziyiza okusoma ebitabo ebyonoona.” Ebitabo byonna eby'engero ez'obulimba (fiction) eby'engeri zonna byatwalibwa Ab'oluganda ab'ennaku ezo nga “byonoona.” Ku nsonga eno, maama waffe yali munywevu nnyo, era tetwakkirizibwa kusoma na ngero ez'essomero lya Ssande ezitaliimu kabi n'akamu era ezaalondebwa n'obwegendereza. Ku by'ebitabo bya novello, ekigambo kyennyini kyatwalibwa nga kibi, era na leero sikozesa kigambo kyo awatali kuwulira okumpi n'okwewaliriza okw'obujeemu, ng'ekintu kye nkola mu bugenderevu ekitali kituufu.

Bwe twagenda tukula, olukoba lwaggwaamu obunywevu mu ngeri ey'obutonde, era bwe twatuuka ku myaka egyatusobozesa okutwala obulamu bwaffe mu ngalo zaffe katono, oluusi twali tuggya essanyu ery'entiisa mu katabo k'engero ke twali twazze eri omu ku mikwano gyaffe egy'oku ssomero. Ekimu ku ebyo bye njijukira ennyo kwe kuseera okw'engeri eyo, ekyeyongera okukwata mu mutima kubanga gwe gwali omulundi ogusooka lwe nagumira okulya olw'obuggya n'obuvumu ekibala ekyaziyizibwa.

Kyali kya mu ttumbi ku Lunaku olusooka (Ssande), nga tewali kintu kya maanyi ekyali kigenda mu maaso. Nnali nzee akatabo eri omu ku baali tuyiga naye, eyali antegeezezza nti “kalungi nnyo,” ne ntwala akatabo — n'essowaani ey'amaapo n'omugaati gwa gingerbread — ne nneegalika ku ludda olw'ebweru olw'ekitanda kyange okusoma n'okulya nga mwetegefu.

Olugero lwe nnasoma ku lunaku olwo, mu mbeera ennungi bwe ntyo, lwandaga ng'olwansembeza okumpi ennyo n'essanyu ettuufu lye nnali sinnaba kufuna, era lubeera mu kujjukira kwange ng'olumu ku nnaku ez'essanyu ennyingi mu bulamu bwange. Akatabo kaali The Earl's Daughter akaawandiikibwa Grace Aguilar. Mu ndowooza yange ento ey'Omukwakeri Omunnamerika, Earl yali kintu kya ngeri ya malayika omukulu okusinga omuntu owa bulijjo, era okuba muwala wa Earl kyali kumpi n'okuba muwala w'eggulu. Era na leero — newankubadde okwolesebwa amazima gonna obulamu kwe bunkoze ku by'ab'ekitiibwa (earls) ne bawala baabwe — okuwulira okw'edda okw'ekitiibwa ekyajjuza emmeeme yange okutya ku ttumbi ly'olunaku olwo olusooka edda, buli lwe kudda okumala akaseera buli earls oba ba countess lwe boogerwako mu maaso gange.

Naye newankubadde nga nnasanyukira olugero luno n'engero endala nnyo, bulijjo kyali kigenda n'omuntu ow'omunda ateganyizibwa, era kyantwalira emyaka amakumi ataano okwerugulula okuwulira nti okusoma ekintu kyonna eky'obulimba (fiction) kwali kibi.

Ekitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo bya buli lunaku (diary) kijjudde okulwanagana kwe nnayitamu olw'ekintu kino, era bwe mbisoma kaakano, sisobola butasaasira nnyo emmeeme envuyu, etamanyi era ento ennaku ennyingi eyabonyaabonyezebwa olw'omuze ogutaggwaawo ogw'okufuula okwewummuza okutaliiko kabi n'akatono okuba ekyonoono eky'empisa.

Ekyanzikkula ku nkomerero kwe kutegeera okwa mangu nti Mukama waffe yennyini yakozesanga bulijjo engero ez'okugerageranya (parables) — nga zo ngero buli — okunnyonnyola n'okunyweza okuyigiriza kwe. N'olwekyo, ebitabo eby'obulimba (fiction) mu byo byennyini tebyali, nga bwe nnali ndowooza bulijjo, kigambo kimu na kibi. Omutindo gwabyo ogw'empisa gwali gwesigamye ku ngeri ya fiction eyo gye yali, era emirundi mingi, fiction yasangibwanga ng'eyamba nnyo eri obutuukirivu.

Naye mmanyi Ab'oluganda bangi abaabonyaabonyezebwa okusalira okw'omwoyo ku nsonga eno okutuusa mu bukadde bwabwe.

Ennyimba yali nsonga endala Ab'oluganda ab'omu biseera byange gye baali balina obujulizi obw'amaanyi ennyo. Mu Discipline ey'e Philadelphia ey'omwaka 1873, nnasangamu ebigambo bino ku nsonga eyo, ebiraga bulungi endowooza y'Abakwakeri: “Tuddamu okulabula abantu baffe bonna obuteenyigira mu nnyimba, oba okubeera n'ebivuga mu mayumba gaabwe, nga tukkiriza nti omuze ogwo guleeta endowooza ennyangu era ey'obutaliimu, era gwesimattula ku kufumiitiriza okw'amaanyi okusaanira omuntu ateekwa okubalirwa, eyanguyiriza okutuuka ku kubalibwa kwe okw'enkomerero.… Omwoyo n'olulimi lwa Discipline biziyiza Ab'oluganda okukozesa ennyimba, awatali kuggyako na kimu ne ku lw'eyo eyitibwa entukuvu.… Abantu abo abeenyigira mu kukozesa ennyimba, oba abalina ebivuga mu mayumba gaabwe, beeteeka mu kussibwa mu nkola kw'olwo olw'okubiri olwa Discipline.… Era bwe bataliba bakomezebwa mu kufuba okulala, ne basobola okwenenya ebikolwa byabwe ebibi ne kimalira olukuŋŋaana, luteekwa okugenda mu maaso okulaga obutakwatagana bwaffe nabo.”

Discipline yagonderwa n'obunywevu bungi nnyo ku nsonga eno, ne sijjukira, mu buto bwange, muntu n'omu mu kibiina kyaffe ekironde eyalina ekivuga kya ngeri yonna, okusingira ddala piano, eyatwalibwa ng'esinga zonna okuba “ey'amasanyu ag'ensi.” Buli lwe nneesanga mu kisenge ekirimu piano, nneewulira ng'alinnyirira ku nsalo z'omuliro ogutazikira ddala.

Okumala emyaka mingi nga mmaze okuba omukazi, saawuliranga nnyimba wonna awatali kuwulira okwakisirise, okumu okuwoomerera, okw'okukomba ku kibala ekyaziyizibwa. N'okuyimba oba okufuuwa oluwa kyalabirwanga bubi. Nzijukira olulala, ekibinja ky'abavubuka Ab'oluganda bwe baali bamaze ekiseera eky'oluwummula olw'ekyeya awamu mu Newport, Owooluganda omukulu omwagalwa yatuyita mu kisenge kye n'atugamba n'obuzito nti yali anakuwadde nnyo okuwulira abamu ku ffe nga tufuuwa oluwa mu nnimiro ku lunaku olwayita, era yali asuubira nga tetuliddayo kumenya bujulizi bwa Ab'oluganda bwe kityo.

Nti Discipline ku nsonga eno teyali kigambo bugambo kikakasibwa ekituufu nti, bwe nnakula, era obujulizi buno bwe bwatandika okufiirwa amaanyi gaabwo ku bantu abatali ba “kufaayo” nnyo, nnamanya emisango egiwera Ab'oluganda — newankubadde nga mu bulala baali ba kulabirako — mwe baagobebwa mu kibiina olw'okubeera na piano mu maka gaabwe.

Era ng'ekiseera kya vvumbe nga 1865, bwe twagabira mutabani waffe Frank ekivuga ekya organ eky'omu nnyumba (tetwagumira kumuwa piano, nga twesanga nti organ zaali za “bwangu” okusingako), twalina okugikweka mu kimu ku bisenge eby'engulu eby'ennyumba okwewala okunyiiza abaganda baffe Abakwakeri.

Sirijjerawo kwewuunya kwange bwe nnasooka okutegeera nti ebivuga tebyakkirizibwa kyokka mu Baibuli, naye nga ddala twalagirwa okubikozesa. Olunaku olumu, nga nsoma Zabbuli, saali kumpi kukkiriza maaso gange bwe nnatuuka ku Zabbuli 150: “Mutendereze Mukama. Mumutendereze n'eddoboozi ly'ekkondeere; mumutendereze n'entongooli n'ennanga. Mumutendereze n'ebitaasa n'amazina; mumutendereze n'enkoba n'ebilere.” Sso siwuliranga Owooluganda ng'annyonnyola engeri gye baawoleza okuggya amaaso ku kino.

“Obwangu” (Plainness), mu biseera byange, era bwaggyamu ebifaananyi wonna okuggyako mu bitabo. Tewaali Mukwakeri wa kitiibwa eyandiwanikidde ebifaananyi ku bbugwe, so tebaawuliranga nga baddembeddwa okukwatibwa ebifaananyi byabwe. N'ebifaananyi ebiyitibwa daguerreotypes, bwe byasooka okulabika, byatwalibwa nga “bya masanyu ag'ensi” Ab'oluganda bonna abaali ddala “abanywevu.” Nzikiriza nti endowooza yali nti okuba n'ekifaananyi kye kiyinza okusiikuula amalala. Era olw'ensonga ezitategeerekeka bulungi, ebifaananyi oba ebibumbe byawulirwanga nga bya kabi mu by'omwoyo — bikemo eby'okusinza ebifaananyi (idolatry). Nnakulira nga nzikiriza nnyo nti kyali kibi okukyala mu ffumbiro ly'eby'obugenyi (art gallery) oba okutunuulira ekifaananyi ekibumbe (statue).

Nzijukira bulungi, nga nnina emyaka nga kkumi na musanvu, bwe nnesumulula okuva mu mpisa zonna ez'okulerebwa kwange ne ŋŋenda — omutima gwange nga gukuba ng'oyo agenda ku kizibu eky'obulabe era ekibi — mu Academy of Fine Arts mu Philadelphia. Waaliwo ekibumbe eky'amayinja ag'omu marumba (marble) ekya Hero ne Leander, era Leander yali tayambadde bulungi. Nkyeraba nga nnyimiridde mu maaso gaakyo, omutima gwange nga guli mu mimiro, nga njogera munda nti, “Ndowooza nja kugenda butereevu mu muliro ogutazikira olw'ekino, naye siyinza kukyewala. Bwe kinnaka okugenda, ka ngende —, naye nnaatunuulira ekifaananyi kino.” Tewali bigambo bisobola kunnyonnyola engeri gye nneewuliramu nga ndi mwonoonyi omuvumu ennyo. Era nzijukira obulungi okwewuunya kwange okwesanga oluvannyuma nga nnyimiridde awatali kabi mu Broad Street, awatali kutuukwako kabi, awatali kukwatibwa omusango ogw'amangu ogw'Omutonzi eyanyiizibwa.

Nkyasobola okulaba ekibumbe ekyo eky'amayinja obulungi ennyo, okusinga ekibumbe kyonna kye ndabye okuva olwo.

Newankubadde nga nzuunya oba kaakano kyandifudde ekikolwa ky'obukugu eky'ekitiibwa, kibadde mu kujjukira kwange ng'entikko y'ebikolwa by'obugenyi byonna, kubanga kyali kabonero ak'okununulwa kwange okuyingira mu nsi eteategeerekeka n'akatono. Tewali kabi na kamu ekyantuukako, era mpolampola ne nfuna obuvumu obw'okweyongerayo, okutuusa lwe nnayiga nti ekirabo eky'obukugu bw'ebifaananyi kirabo kya Katonda ddala nga bwe kiri ekirabo eky'okubala (mathematics), noolwekyo tekiyinza kuba kibi okukikuza. Era mpolampola Ab'oluganda nabo ne bakiyiga; okusalira okw'edda okuwakanya obukugu bw'ebifaananyi n'ennyimba kumaze kuggwaawo ddala.

Obujulizi obulala obwali mu “bwangu bw'ebyambalo” mu buto bwange bwali obwo obuwakanya ebirevu.

Empisa za Ab'oluganda bwe zaasooka okunywera, obwenyi obumwole bwe bwali ennono eya bonna. N'olwekyo, okusinziira ku musingi ogw'obutagoberera nnono z'ensi ezikyukakyuka, ebirevu bwe byatandika okwagalibwa, Abakwakeri ne banywerera ku bwenyi obumwole. Nzijukira bulungi omulundi ogusooka lwe nnalaba “omubuulizi” nga alina ekirevu. Yali Owooluganda eyali akyaze okuva mu Bungereza, gye baali abatali banywevu nnyo. Mu Nkuŋŋaana eziwera “enywevu,” yagaanibwa okuyingira mu gallery olw'ekirevu kye, era nzijukira bulungi okweraliikirira okunene okwalagibwa Abakadde ab'e Philadelphia ku bujulizi buno obw'ennaku obw'“okwewuubaala okwa mpolampola okw'omwoyo gw'ensi mu Lukuŋŋaana olwa buli mwaka olw'e London.”

Obujulizi buno obuwakanya ebirevu, nzikiriza nti, buli bumu — newankubadde oboolwa ensonga ez'enjawulo — eri bakabona Abakatoliki n'abasumba ab'ekitongole ekya High Church eky'Ekkanisa y'e Bungereza. Naye omuntu tayinza butasiima kunywerera okw'amaanyi ku ekyo kye baali bakkiririza mu bwesimbu nti kyali mulimu gwa ddini, newankubadde kaakano kye kirabika gye tuli ng'ekyensobi, okwaliraga abatukuvu abo ab'edda abaagalwa.
fields.body_text: Ekintu ekirala ekyayimusibwa mu Kibuuzo kye kimu Ekyokusatu kyatuleetera obuzibu obutali butono: ekibuuzo eky'oba nga Ab'oluganda baali beegendereza okulera abaana baabwe mu “kusoma Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu emirundi mingi, n'okubaziyiza okusoma ebitabo ebyonoona.” Ebitabo byonna eby'engero ez'obulimba (fiction) eby'engeri zonna byatwalibwa Ab'oluganda ab'ennaku ezo nga “byonoona.” Ku nsonga eno, maama waffe yali munywevu nnyo, era tetwakkirizibwa kusoma na ngero ez'essomero lya Ssande ezitaliimu kabi n'akamu era ezaalondebwa n'obwegendereza. Ku by'ebitabo bya novello, ekigambo kyennyini kyatwalibwa nga kibi, era na leero sikozesa kigambo kyo awatali kuwulira okumpi n'okwewaliriza okw'obujeemu, ng'ekintu kye nkola mu bugenderevu ekitali kituufu. Bwe twagenda tukula, olukoba lwaggwaamu obunywevu mu ngeri ey'obutonde, era bwe twatuuka ku myaka egyatusobozesa okutwala obulamu bwaffe mu ngalo zaffe katono, oluusi twali tuggya essanyu ery'entiisa mu katabo k'engero ke twali twazze eri omu ku mikwano gyaffe egy'oku ssomero. Ekimu ku ebyo bye njijukira ennyo kwe kuseera okw'engeri eyo, ekyeyongera okukwata mu mutima kubanga gwe gwali omulundi ogusooka lwe nagumira okulya olw'obuggya n'obuvumu ekibala ekyaziyizibwa. Kyali kya mu ttumbi ku Lunaku olusooka (Ssande), nga tewali kintu kya maanyi ekyali kigenda mu maaso. Nnali nzee akatabo eri omu ku baali tuyiga naye, eyali antegeezezza nti “kalungi nnyo,” ne ntwala akatabo — n'essowaani ey'amaapo n'omugaati gwa gingerbread — ne nneegalika ku ludda olw'ebweru olw'ekitanda kyange okusoma n'okulya nga mwetegefu. Olugero lwe nnasoma ku lunaku olwo, mu mbeera ennungi bwe ntyo, lwandaga ng'olwansembeza okumpi ennyo n'essanyu ettuufu lye nnali sinnaba kufuna, era lubeera mu kujjukira kwange ng'olumu ku nnaku ez'essanyu ennyingi mu bulamu bwange. Akatabo kaali The Earl's Daughter akaawandiikibwa Grace Aguilar. Mu ndowooza yange ento ey'Omukwakeri Omunnamerika, Earl yali kintu kya ngeri ya malayika omukulu okusinga omuntu owa bulijjo, era okuba muwala wa Earl kyali kumpi n'okuba muwala w'eggulu. Era na leero — newankubadde okwolesebwa amazima gonna obulamu kwe bunkoze ku by'ab'ekitiibwa (earls) ne bawala baabwe — okuwulira okw'edda okw'ekitiibwa ekyajjuza emmeeme yange okutya ku ttumbi ly'olunaku olwo olusooka edda, buli lwe kudda okumala akaseera buli earls oba ba countess lwe boogerwako mu maaso gange. Naye newankubadde nga nnasanyukira olugero luno n'engero endala nnyo, bulijjo kyali kigenda n'omuntu ow'omunda ateganyizibwa, era kyantwalira emyaka amakumi ataano okwerugulula okuwulira nti okusoma ekintu kyonna eky'obulimba (fiction) kwali kibi. Ekitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo bya buli lunaku (diary) kijjudde okulwanagana kwe nnayitamu olw'ekintu kino, era bwe mbisoma kaakano, sisobola butasaasira nnyo emmeeme envuyu, etamanyi era ento ennaku ennyingi eyabonyaabonyezebwa olw'omuze ogutaggwaawo ogw'okufuula okwewummuza okutaliiko kabi n'akatono okuba ekyonoono eky'empisa. Ekyanzikkula ku nkomerero kwe kutegeera okwa mangu nti Mukama waffe yennyini yakozesanga bulijjo engero ez'okugerageranya (parables) — nga zo ngero buli — okunnyonnyola n'okunyweza okuyigiriza kwe. fields.title: Ebiziyiza by'Abakwaka
fields.body_html:
Ebiziyiza by'obuntu ebyava mu bujulizi bw'Abakwaka byalabika ng'ebitaggwaawo, kubanga buli muntu yabivvuunula ng'okutegeera kwe okw'obuvunaanyizibwa bwe bwe kwali. Abo abaalina emitima egy'obukwatampola ennyo emirundi mingi baayongeranga ku biragiro okutuusa obulamu bwennyini lwe bwafuuka okubonaabona. Mukwano gwange omu, eyazitoowererwa omutima ng'ogwo, yanzikiririza oluvannyuma mu bulamu nti enkya ze ng'akyali muwala nga tezaagumiikirizika. Yali tasobola kwambala nga takwatiddwa kubuusabuusa ku buli kyambalo. Oluusi, engeri yokka gye yasobolanga okusirisa eddoboozi ery'omunda eryasabanga ssaddaaka empya kwali kwe kutteeka pamba mu matu ge n'ayogera ebitontome mangu nnyo nga bw'asobola, ng'asaanyaawo okulabula okutakoowa.

Ekitabo eky'ebyafaayo ekikadde jjajja wange omukulu kye yawandiika wakati wa 1760 ne 1762 kituwa endabika ennungi ey'ebiziyiza eby'omu kiseera kye. Yawandiika n'obukakafu obw'amaanyi nti okuseka kwali ddalu, essanyu nga bwerere, era nti yayagala okunywera bw'atyo obutaddayo kumwenya. Awalala, yakungubagira empisa eziyingirira mu Bannyinaffe — abavubuka nga basiba enviiri zaabwe n'obutambaala, abawala nga beeyonja ensingo zaabwe n'obuwero obw'enzirugavu. Gy'ali, bino byali bintu ebinakuwaza, obukakafu nti abakadde baali balemereddwa obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe. Yakaabira okwenyigira mu taaba, caayi, ne kaliko, ng'alangirira nti byonna byenkanankana mu kwonoona, “ebibi nga bwe kiri eri abaddugavu,” bwe yawandiika, ng'akuŋŋaanya empisa ez'ensi wamu ng'ekintu ekimu eky'omuzizo. Ebigambo bye biraga engeri buli mulembe gwe gwafunanga ensonga empya ez'omutima, naye bulijjo mu mwoyo gwe gumu ogw'okwefiiriza.

Okumpi n'ekiseera kyange, jjajja wange omulala yagaana okwambala amannyo ag'obukumpanya. Newankubadde nga teyalina mannyo era ng'alwanirira okulya, yawulira “okuziyizibwa” mu mwoyo gwe, ng'akkiriza nti gali mpisa ya bwereere. Gateekebwa mu kabada okumpi n'essaali lye erya siliiki erisinga obulungi, obutaddayo kwambalibwa. Ffe, abaana, twasiima obutukuvu bwe, ne bwe twali tumulaba ng'alwanirira n'emmere. Omukwano gwaffe omubuulizi, oluvannyuma lw'okwaliira kapeti empya, yatya nti yali agonze eri amalala. Okwetoowaza, yalagira ebbaali z'amayinja amakalubo okuyiibwa okwo, ng'aggyawo obuggya bwakyo. Ffe, abaana, twawulira olugero luno n'entiisa, era okubuulira kwe okuva mu kiseera ekyo kwatulabika ng'eddoboozi lya malayika.

Oluvannyuma lw'emyaka, nange nnayolekera okugezesebwa kwange ku kapeti empya eya Brussels, eyalina ebifaananyi by'ebimuli ebirungi. Baze yateekateeka abasajja abakozi ab'ebikolwa eby'amaanyi okukuŋŋaananga mu kisenge ekyo kyennyini buli Ssande olw'essomo lya Bayibuli. Nnakyawa engatto zaabwe enzito ku kapeti yange gye nnali ngulumiza, wadde nga nnamanya nti saali nsaanidde kuwulira bwe ntyo.

Bwe nnali nsaba ku nsonga eno, olunyiriri lwa Bayibuli ne lunjijira: “Mwaniriza okunyagibwa kw'ebintu byammwe n'essanyu.” Nnalunyweza ng'ekyokulwanyisa ky'Omwoyo, era okuva mu kaseera ako nnaaniriza abasajja abo ku kapeti yange. Ekyewuunyisa, kyalabika ng'ekitakaddiwa, ne kimala ebbanga okutuusa lwe nnakoowa okukiraba. Sisobola butalowooza nti engeri yange yali nnungi okusinga amayinja amakalubo aga Mukwano wange omukadde omwagalwa.

Nga nnamaze okuzuula ekkubo ery'okukkiriza, mukwano gwange eyali amaze ebbanga ng'abonaabona wansi w'“ebiziyiza” by'Abakwaka yampa ekifaananyi ekyewuunyisa eky'enkola ez'enjawulo ez'okutambuza obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo. Yagamba nti, “Ntegedde amakubo asatu ag'okutuuka ku ludda olulala olw'olusozi olw'omwoyo. Abamu balitulula okuyita wakati olw'entuuyo z'ekyenyi kyabwe — eyo ye ngeri y'Abakwaka, era okumala ebbanga eyo ye yali eyange. Abalala batambulatambula okwetooloola entobo yalwo, nga badda eno n'eri, naye olw'okuba nga bakuuma amaaso gaabwe nga gatunuulidde ekiruubirirwa, mpolampola basembera okumpi. Eyo ye yali engeri yange bwe nnakoowa okutulula. Naye kaakano ontegeeza nti waliwo engeri ey'okusatu — engeri ey'okukkiriza. Ogamba nti Abakristaayo abamu bayize okukuba ebiwaawaatiro by'okukkiriza ne babuuka ne basala ku lusozi. Nteekwa okukkiriza nti abo abakwata engeri yo balabika okutuuka ku ludda olulala mangu era n'obwangu okusinga ababimba n'abatambulatambula. Nsazeewo okulekera awo okutulula n'okutambulatambula, era nange nkube ebiwaawaatiro byange.”

Naye abatukuvu abaagalwa ab'omu buto bwange n'obuvubuka bwange tebaamanya kubuuka. Mu bungi bwabwe, baamala obulamu bwabwe nga batulula n'obunyiikivu obukooya. Obwesigwa bwabwe n'okwewaayo kwabwe, wadde oluusi nga kwali kukyamu, kyandabikira mu kiseera ekyo — era kikyandabikira ne kaakano — nga kisaanira ekitiibwa kyonna. Ekintu ekimu eky'amaanyi ekyasigala ku mutima gwange omuto kyali kino kyokka: mu ngeri yonna eyinzika, nteekwa okuba omulungi. Kyonna ekirala ekyabulanga mu njigiriza y'Abakwaka, tewaali kubulwa kunyweza ku bulungi. Obwetaavu obw'okuba omulungi ddala, mu bwesimbu, mu mazima, bwali mu mpewo yennyini gye twassa.

Oluusi, nnanyiigira wansi w'embeera eno. Obuzaale bwange obw'okwagala okugezaako ebintu bwayaayaanira omukisa ogw'okuba omukyamu, okujeemera ebyasuubirwanga, naye ensalo z'obulamu bwange zaakkiriza obukyamu obutono ennyo obutaliimu bbi. Bwe ntunula emabega, sisobola butasiima engabo ey'ekitalo ey'obulungi eyanneetooloola, nga enkuuma okuva mu kukemebwa okwandiŋŋambizza omwoyo gwange ogw'eddembe.

Kubanga obanga waliwo emmeeme eyali ezaaliddwa ng'ey'eddembe, yali yange. Okukaaba kw'omutima gwange bulijjo kwabanga lwa ddembe.

Amateeka n'empisa ezifuula omuntu omuddu oba eziziyiza bibadde bya muzizo gye ndi obulamu bwange bwonna. Singa abazadde bange baateeka amateeka mangi, nnandijeemye. Naye embeera ey'obulungi eyabuna gye baabeeranga yankwata n'amaanyi agataategeerekeka, olwo nga simanyi nti nnali nnuŋŋamizibwa. Nnawulira n'essanyu ng'ekiri nti kumpi bulijjo nnakolanga nga bwe njagala.

Tewali muntu ataabeeramu asobola okulowooza ku bufunda bw'obulamu bwe nnamanya okutuusa mu myaka kkumi na munaana. Sirina gwe nnasisinkana eyava mu ekyo ekyayitibwanga “ensi ey'amasanyu.” Banne bange baali Bannyinaffe abateefu bokka ab'omu kibiina kyaffe, n'abaana baabwe abaakuumibwanga n'obwegendereza. Ebitabo eby'enfumo byali bikugirwa, era saafuna mukisa gwa kumanya obulamu kye bwategeeza ebweru w'ekisibo kyaffe eky'Abakwaka. Ku by'ebibi by'ensi, saalina n'akatono kutegeera. Ne ku ssomero, singa waliwo ekyayogerwanga mu kaama, nnali mutuukirivu nnyo okutegeera. Nnyinza okugamba nti leero kyandibadde kitasoboka omuwala ow'emyaka kkumi na munaana okubeera mu nsi ng'eyo ey'obutamanya obutaliimu, oba okuyingira mu buvunaanyizibwa bw'obulamu nga teyeeteeseteese n'akatono.

Obulamu bwange obw'omunda okutuusa mu myaka kkumi n'omukaaga bwali bwangu. Nnakkiriza ebitono bye nnabuulirwa era ssaba wo mutima ku bikwekwe by'ensi yonna. Ebirowoozo byange eby'eddiini byokka byali kutya kwa muliro gwa ggeyeena okwabangawo, okwabuubuukanga mu biseera by'endwadde eziswaza oba eby'akabi. Engeri gye nnaafunamu okutya kuno sikijjukira, kubanga Abakwaka baayogeranga bumu ku ggulu oba ku ggeyeena. Ekyabafaako kyali bulamu bwa Katonda mu mmeeme kaakano, nga beesigamya ebiseera eby'omu maaso ku kulabirira kwa Katonda. Naye oluusi nnakwatibwanga entiisa ey'amangu, ne nsalawo obusalawo obw'amaanyi “okuba omulungi,” ne ngezaako essaawa ntono okutereeza obukyamu bwange — naye ne nziira mu makubo gange aga edda. Wabula, embeera ey'obulungi eyanneetooloola yafuula nga kizibu n'okulowooza ku kukola ebibi, okusingako okubikola. Mu bujjuvu, nnali mulungi nga ekitonde ekiramu, eky'obulamu obulungi bwe kisobola okuba. Naye okutuusa mu myaka kkumi n'omukaaga, nnali busa nsolo nnungi. Obuzaale bwange obw'omwoyo bwali tebunnazuukusibwa; nnali sinnategeera mmeeme yange mu bwegendereza.

Enkyukakyuka yali eri kumpi, wadde nga saagimanyi. Emmeeme yange yali etandika okuva mu tulo twayo, ng'elwanirira ng'ekiwojjolo mu kisenge kyakyo okumenya ebisiba ebyagikwatanga. Okunoonya kwange okuwanvu okunoonya Katonda kwali kunaatera okutandika.

fields.title: Ekiseera Ekisooka Mu Bulamu Bwange Obw'Eddiini (Okuzuukuka)
fields.body_html:
Mu byafaayo by'obulamu bwange obw'eddiini, ebiseera bina bifuluma bulungi mu maaso gange. Ekisooka kyatandika, nga bwe njogedde, bwe nnali nga nnina emyaka kkumi na mukaaga. Mu ngeri enzibu era ey'ekyama, natandika okuwulira okwegomba okutali kwatuufu okw'ekintu ekyandimazizza obuntu bwange obw'omunda. Mu kitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo eky'omu biseera by'ekyengera okwa 1848, nsangamu ebiwandiiko by'okwegomba kuno — okugolola engalo obutalaba nga nnoonya ekintu ekyandijjuzizza kye nnayita, mu lulimi olw'ennaku olw'obuvubuka, “obwereere obulumya mu mutima gwange.”

Mu biro bino, nagwa mu kwagala okungi ennyo eri omu ku bayigiriza abato mu ssomero lye nnali nsomamu, era obuyinza bwe bwakyusa obulamu bwange. Nawandiika mu kitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo buli mutendera ogw'okumanyagana kwaffe — okwegomba kwange okwogera naye, okumwegayirira ankwagale, n'okulwawo kwange olw'okutya okumuteganya. Nawandiika bwe nti: “1848. Nnina emyaka kkumi na mukaaga. Kino kiseera kikulu gye ndi. Kaakano kye kiseera eky'okukola empisa zange. Mpulira nga bwe ssaawuliranga edda. Emirimu emikulu era emizito egy'obulamu, omulundi ogusooka, gizze mu maaso gange. Saazaalibwa kuba mugayaavu; kubanga mpulira ekintu munda yange ekimbuulira nti: Obulamu bulina amakulu agasikiriza Okusinga ebirowoozo eby'obuvubuka bwo; Bulina essuubi eriwanvu ng'eggulu, Bulina emirimu, bulina amazima.

Bulina obukyamu obuyinza okugololwa, Ebikolwa ebisiimibwa ebiyinza okukolebwa.

Entalo zaabwo ennene tezinnalwanibwa, Obuwanguzi bwabwo obukulu tebunnafunibwa.

Ekintu ekyoolekeza mu maaso — wala nnyo mu maaso — mu biseera eby'omu maaso, okusukka obulamu buno okutuuka mu nsi ennungi era ey'essanyu, era ekimbuulira ku mpeera ey'ekitiibwa ey'abo abatuukiriza emirimu gyabwe.

Sibadde nnina okuwulira kuno kumala bbanga. Emyezi esatu emabega, nnali mwana atafaayo, ow'essanyu. Nkyali mwana, naye ow'omutima omunyiikivu era alowooza — atakyali atafaayo oba atassaamu mwoyo. Nnyinza ntya okubeera bwe ntyo, ng'ebintu bingi, bingi nnyo, eby'okulowoozaako era n'ebingi eby'okukola? Kiki ekivuddeko enkyukakyuka eno?

Waaliwo obwereere obulumya mu mutima gwange. Nnawulira okwetaaga ekintu — ekintu kye ssaamanya — ekintu ekitannyonyolwa ekyandintuzza nga ntudde mu birowoozo essaawa nnyingi nga ntunuulira eggulu, nga ntunuulira emmunyeenye enafu oba omwezi, okutuusa obulamu bwange lwe bwafaanana ng'obwegasse mu bwabyo. Nnali kumpi okwerabira nti ndi ku nsi, ng'ebirowoozo byange bidda mu bitundu ebitaliimu makubo bye byafuganga, ne nfuba obwereere okuyingira mu byama by'okubaawo kwabyo.

Okusoma, nnalowooza, kwandijjuzizza obwereere obwo, naye nnali nkyamu. Nga ndi mu mbeera eno ey'ebirowoozo, ku ntandikwa y'Omwezi ogw'Omwenda, twava mu maka gaffe amato ag'omwagalwa ne tuddayo mu kibuga. Singa mu kiseera ekyo nnasisinkana omuntu gwe nnandyagadde ng'ateekwa mu misingi mibi, nkankana okulowooza ku ekyo ekyandibaddewo, kubanga nkyusibwa mangu abo be njagala.

Naye Kitange ali mu ggulu yali mwetegefu okundaga akasa katono. Yatuma mu kkubo lyange omuntu gwe nnasanga nga mukwano gwange ow'amazima. Yali muwala muto Miss Maryanna gwe yakozesa okuba omuyigiriza w'okuwandiika, erinnya lye Anna S —. Nnali neetegese okumwagala nga sinnamulaba, kubanga omuntu gwe nnayagala yali antegeezezza ku bulungi bwe. Okumala wiiki bbiri oluvannyuma lw'okujja kwe okusooka mu ssomero, nkkiriza nti nnamwogeranga omulundi gumu gwokka; era ekyo kyali bwe nnamulaba ng'anoonya ekitabo ne mmuwa kimu, nga mmubuuza oba kye kituufu.

Nnalowooza nti tetwandimanyaganye n'akatono. Nnatuulanga ne mmutunuulira nga neegomba singa mba n'obuvumu okwogera naye n'okumunywegera, era okwegomba kuno kwennyini kwandeetera okuswala olw'obuti. Nnamulabanga ng'awamba abawala abalala mu mikono gye, ne nkyuka nga nnina ennaku okulowooza nti tandikoze bwe kimu gye ndi. Ekkomerero, olunaku olumu — nga nkijjukira bulungi — nnali nnyimiridde ku mmeeza yange ng'ajja n'ayogera nange ku A. S. F. Nga nnawulira essanyu! Nga nneegomba okuwamba obulago bwe mu mikono gyange n'okumwegayirira andeke mmwagale! Omutima gwange gwali mu kutabukatabuka, kyokka nnaddamu mpolampola awatali kusiikuuka mu mutima, era mangu n'anvaako. Naye omuzira gwali gumenyese. Twatandika okwogera emirundi mingi, era ku makya agamu yannywegera. Okunywegera okwo kwawandiikibwa ku mutima gwange. Nnawulira nti yannyagala, era ekirowoozo ekyo kyandeetera essanyu.

Okuva mu kiseera ekyo, mmwagadde — weewaawo, kumpi ne mmusinza. Obwereere obulumya mu mutima gwange kaakano bujjuddwa kitundu, kubanga mpulirizza ebirowoozo bye, nnalaba ekitiibwa ky'ebikolwa bye, era nnayiga nti “obulamu bwa nnamaddala, obulamu bwa munyiikivu,” era tebusaanira kuyisibwa mu kuloota okw'obwereere oba okwonoonebwa mu masanyu ag'obusirusiru. Yanjigirizza — si mu bigambo bingi, naye mu kasirise ng'ayita mu buyinza bwe — nti nnina omulimu ogw'okutuukiriza ku nsi, era nti nteekwa okugutandika okugukola mangu. Obuyinza bwe bunzuukusizza okuva mu kiroota kyange eky'obwana. Mu mwezi gumu ogumpi, mfuuse omukazi. Ayi, ng'omukwano gwe bwe gumbeddemu omukisa! Kino kiseera kikulu nnyo mu bulamu bwange. Nkankana bwe ndowooza ku buvunaanyizibwa obw'entiisa obuteese ku nze. Empisa zange zikolebwa, era nnina obuyinza okufuuka kye neeroboza. Nnyinza okuba nga nteekeddwa omulimu omukulu. Mpulira ekintu munda yange ekimbuulira nti nnandisobodde okugutuukiriza. Ky'okuba kyonna, ndikola obulungi obungi oba obubi obungi. Ndironda okukola obulungi.

Ayi, Kitange ali mu ggulu, tolinnyamba kugenda mu maaso mu kkubo ery'okwewangula, eriteekwa okuba olutalo lwange olukulu olusooka? Nga buliba buwanguzi bwa kitiibwa singa mpangula!”

Okusinziira ku kitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo, buli lunaku kaakano lwafaananga ng'oluzuukusa obulamu bwange obw'omwoyo okweyongera n'okweyongera, okutuusa ku nkomerero we waatuuka ekiseera eky'entikko. Ku lunaku olw'amakumi abiri mu munaana olw'Omwezi ogw'ekkumi n'ogumu, 1848, nawandiika nti: “Olunaku olw'ebikulu! Olw'ebikulu, njogera, mu bulamu bwange obw'omwoyo. Leero mpulidde era nnalowoozezza ekimala omwaka. Mukwano gwange Anna yatusomera mu kibiina ekitabo ekiyitibwa Other Worlds, era ne Future Existence okuva mu School Boy ekya Abbott. Nga mpuliriza ebyafaayo eby'ensi ezo ez'amaanyi ezisaasaanye buli wamu okwetooloola — endala nga za wala nnyo ne bibaawo nti ebimyanso by'ekitangaala ebiyingira mu maaso gaffe byava mu mmunyeenye ezo emyaka kakadde mukaaga emabega! — era nga ndowooza nti ensi zino zonna zitambula bulijjo, awatali kutawaanya munne, naye zonna nga ziwulira Omutonzi omu ow'amaanyi, obukulu bw'ekirowoozo ekyo bwansukkirira. Okumala eddakiika ntono, nnawulira ng'essanyu lyennyini ery'okuzaalibwa mu nsi etaliiko kkomo, ey'ekitiibwa ennyo, ey'ekitalo ennyo, lyali kumpi okusukka bye nnandigumiikiriza.

Era nga mpulira ku kubaawo kwaffe okw'omu maaso, ku ssanyu ery'ekitiibwa eritalowoozeka erituterekeddwa, ku ssanyu erituukiridde eriterekeddwa abalungi n'abatukuvu, munda yange nnebaza Omutonzi wange olw'okunteeka mu bitonde ebisuubira ebintu ebiweereddwa omukisa. Naye olwo ne wajja ekirowoozo eky'entiisa, ekisukkirira, nti obwomu buno obutaggwaawo obw'essanyu bwali bwa balungi bokka — n'okutegeera nti sandifunye mugabo mu bwo okuggyako ng'omutima gwange gukyusiddwa. Ayi, siyinza kunnyonnyola nnaku ey'akaseera ako! Yali kumpi okusukka bye nnandigumiikiriza. Era ebirowoozo bino binywerera nange. Lwaki?”

Ekikoloboze ekyanteekebwako olw'okulengera kuno mu bukulu bw'ensi tekinnaava ku nze n'okutuusa leero. Wansi mu bibuuzo byange byonna ebikwata ku Katonda, bulijjo waabangawo obukakafu obw'amaanyi ge agatalina kkomo — ekintu ekyo tewali kintu kyandisobodde kugaana. Naye okumala ekiseera ekiwanvu, nga bwe kiraba, nnalowooza obuyinza buno ng'obw'omululu, obutali ku ludda lwange naye obunwakanya. Era ekibuuzo kyange ekimu okumala emyaka mingi kyali nga bwe nnandiwangudde Katonda eyalina obuyinza obwenkana awo n'okumuleeta ku ludda lwange.

fields.title: Okunoonya Kwange
fields.body_html:
Okuzuukuka kwange kwali kutuuse mu mazima. Mu kiseera ekyo nnali nga ndi n'emyaka kkumi na mukaaga n'ekitundu, era okuva mu kiseera ekyo n'okweyongerayo, emmeeme yange yalumwa ennyonta okwefuula asaanira omugaso gw'ekitiibwa gwe nnali njolesereza. Naye n'okusinga kuno okwali okwegomba okunene okumanya Katonda eyatonda ebyewuunyo ebitategeereka bye nnali nsomako. Sijjukira kweraliikirira kwonna okw'enjawulo ku bibi byange; ekitiibwa kya Katonda kye kyampamba. Nnawulira nti ekintu ekisinga obukulu mu bulamu kwe kumumanya. Bwe kityo, awo n'awo, okunoonya kwange ne kutandika. Naye, zisanze — okunoonya okwo mu kutandika kwali kwa muzibe era okutamanya.

Munnange gwe nnabuulira ebyama byange yekka yali mukwano gwange Ana. Sandiyinzizza kwogera kigambo kyonna ku nsonga eno eri bazadde bange. Empisa zaffe ez'Ekikwaka (Quaker) ez'okusirika ku nsonga zonna ez'eddiini zaakifuula ekitasoboka. Naye eri mukwano gwange, oluvannyuma lw'olunaku olwo olw'okuzuukuka, nnafuka omutima gwange mu bbaluwa empanvu ejjudde okwegomba n'okulumwa ennyonta. Mu kitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo, nninamu ekyokulabirako ky'okuddamu kwe, wamu n'ebigambo bino: “Ana yampandiikira akabaluwa akatono ng'addamu ku bbaluwa yange. Tewali kabaluwa ke nnafuna akansanyusa okusinga ako! Yaneegayirira okuweerayo byonna eri Omulokozi wange, okusaba amaanyi, n'okufuba nnyo okunoonya obutukuvu, ka kimbeere ki ky'oleeteedde. ‘Ayi Hannah omwagalwa ennyo,’ bwe yagamba, ‘ka tugezeeko. Ka tunoonye okutambulira wamu nga tugenda mu bwakabaka bwe obw'ekitiibwa! Ka tulwanenga okufuna ekitundu ku mwoyo gwe.’

“Ayi, singa nnyinza okugoberera amagezi ge! Nnatuula wano nzekka mu kifo kyange eky'okusomera ne ngezaako okuwulira nga nnyinza okuweerayo byonna. Naye ne sisobola. Ne sisobola na kuwulira kwejjusa olw'ebibi ebingi ennyo bye nkoze, era n'ekisinga obubi ku byonna, ne sisobola kuwulira nga njagala Katonda mu mazima. Kya ntiisa.

Nkole ntya? Kiiŋŋwanira okwejjusa; kiiŋŋwanira okwagala Kitange ali mu ggulu, oba ndizikirira emirembe n'emirembe.

Naye sisobola kukikola nzekka. Katonda yekka y'ayinza okunnyamba, so simanyi ngeri gye nsabamu. Ayi, nkole ntya? Ŋŋende wa? Kigambibwa nti, ‘Musabe, muliweebwa.’ Naye siyinza kufuuka mutuukirivu mu mazima okutuusa lwe nnaakwejjusa, so sisobola kwejjusa.”

Okuva mu kiseera kino n'okweyongerayo, ekitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo eby'eddiini kifuuka lukalala lumu olw'okumeguuka n'okubonaabona, nga temuli n'akatangaala n'akatono. Mukwano gwange yakola kyonna kye yasobola okunnyamba, naye ye, nga nange, yalowooza nti ekkubo lyokka ery'okuzuula Katonda kwe kumunoonya munda mu ffe. Okuyigirizibwa kwaffe okw'Ekikwaka kwatuyigiriza bulijjo okukyukira “ekitangaala eky'omunda” okufuna okuyigirizibwa n'okuluŋŋamizibwa, era twakkiriza nti Katonda bwe yandyeraze eyo yokka lwe twandimumanyi mu mazima. Mu katabo ak'Ekikwaka ak'edda akali mu byawandiikibwa byange akayitibwa Tunaakola ki Tulyoke Tulokolebwe?, mulimu ekitundu ekyeyoleka bulungi engeri y'okuyigiriza kwe twakulira. Kigamba nti: “Siyinza kulagirira oyo anoonya amazima, ali mu kwebuuza mu kunakuwala nti anaakola ki alyoke alokolebwe, kudda eri obuweereza bw'omuntu yenna; naye nnandisinze okumusendasenda adde eri okuyigiriza okw'amangu ok'ekigambo ekiri okumpi mu mutima, ye Mwoyo wa Katonda. Ono ye musomesa yekka atalimba era y'etteeka erisookerwako erituukiridde ery'okukkiriza n'obulamu. Kinaaluŋŋamya abo abassaayo omwoyo eri ebiragiro byakyo ne kibatwala mu makubo ag'emirembe ag'obukuumi n'amazima. ‘Temwetaaga,’ Omutume bwe yagamba Ekkanisa mu biro eby'edda, ‘muntu yenna kubayigiriza, wabula nga okufukibwako amafuta kuno bwe kubayigiriza, nga bwe kuli amazima so si bulimba.’”

Ekivaamu ekya bulijjo eky'okuyigiriza kuno kwali kukyusa ebirowoozo byaffe ne bidda munda, ku nneewulira zaffe n'okuwulira kw'emitima gyaffe, ne kutuleetera okusala omusango ku nkolagana yaffe ne Katonda nga twesigamye ku ebyo byokka bye twazuula munda mu ffe.

Ebyo Katonda bye yayogera mu Baibuli byatulabikira ng'ebitalina buyinza bungi ng'ebyo bye yandyogedde naffe mu mitima gyaffe. Sijjukira n'akaseera kamu we nnakyukira Ebyawandiikibwa okufuna okuyigirizibwa. “Eddoboozi ery'omunda” lye lyali liba omusomesa waffe yekka — era gye ndi mu kiseera ekyo, eddoboozi ery'omunda lyali litegeeza nneewulira zange n'okuwulira kw'omutima gwange byokka. Nga bwe watali kintu na kimu ekisinga obutali kya kwesiga oba ekitafugika okusinga enneewulira z'omuntu ez'omunda, si kya kwewuunya nti nnasuulibwa mu kulwana okutalina ssuubi.

Nnagezaako awatali kugasa okwesitula okutuuka ku ebyo bye nnalowooza nti ye nneewulira Katonda z'anaakkiriza. Endowooza y'obulokozi mu ngeri endala yonna teyali nnyita mu birowoozo. Nnayogera ku “Mulokozi wange,” nga bwe nnamuyita, naye saalowooza n'akaseera nti asobola — oba anaayagala — okundokola nga sinneefuula asaanira okulokolebwa. Era nga obusaanizi buno nnali nkkiriza nti bwesigamye ku nneewulira ez'okutya Katonda ez'omunda, nnalowooza kwokka ku kugezaako okuwaliriza nneewulira zino okubaawo. Buli eyali agezezzaako okukola kino amanyi engeri eyo omulimu bwe gukooya era bwe gutalina ssuubi. Ebyawandiikibwa mu kitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo eby'obulamu bwange obw'eddiini okuva mu myaka kkumi na mukaaga n'okweyongerayo bye byokulabirako eby'ennaku eby'enkola z'eddiini ez'obulimba ze nnamanya zokka. Nga bwe mbisoma kaakano, sisobola butasaasira emmeeme eyali eyaayaana n'ennyonta nga yeekaanya awatali kugasa okunoonya ekitangaala naye ng'ezuula obuzibe n'ekizikiza byokka.

Kyokka, ekintu kimu kimbudaabuda bwe ndaba ennyuma: temuli na kimu ku kulwana kuno okw'eddiini, nga bwe nzijukira, ekyayonoona eggulu ery'essanyu lyange ery'oku ngulu. Ebiseera bye nnateekawo okulabirira obulamu bwange obw'eddiini byali mu nkuŋŋaana zaffe ez'Ekikwaka, oba bwe nnabanga nzekka mu kifo kyange eky'okusomera mu kawungeezi, oba ekiro nga buli muntu omulala agenze okwebaka — era ebyo byonna eby'ennaku bye nnawandiika mu kitabo kyange nnabiwandiika mu biseera ebyo. Ku misana gyonna, awamu nnabanga musanyufu era nga nzijjudde ebintu eby'ebweru n'okutuusa ne sisobola kweraliikirira ebyaliwo mu biseera byange eby'eddiini. Nnawulira nti kino kyali nsonga nnene ey'okwebaza, kubanga singa okulwana kwe nnayitamu mu nkuŋŋaana zaffe eza kasirise oba mu biseera byange eby'okufumiitiriza kwabuna n'emisana, siyagala kulowooza ku ebyo ebyandivuddemu.

Nkkiriza nti ekitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo kye kyali ekiddukiro kyange, kubanga nzijukira bulungi nti oluvannyuma lw'okuwandiikamu ebigambo ebisinga okuba eby'ennaku n'okuggwaamu essuubi, mu ngeri emu nnawuliranga ng'emirimu gyange egy'eddiini giwedde, ne ŋŋenda mu kitanda nga ndi musanyufu, ne neebaka otulo otw'omutuukirivu awatali kaseera na kamu ak'okutunula oba okweraliikirira, ne nzuukuka enkeera nga nzijjudde essanyu ery'olunaku olupya, nga nneerabidde ennaku zonna ze nnali mpandiise ekiro ekyayise nga sirina ssuubi. Nzijukira okwewuunya oluusi olw'okukyuka kuno okwangu, era nsanga bino wansi mu kitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo okuva mu kiseera kino: “Sisobola kutegeera nneewulira zange. Okuyala n'okulumwa ennyonta y'obutuukirivu okwenkana awo, ate era, okuggyako mu buseera obutono obw'okwesulika (lwe mpandiika mu kitabo kyange), obwangu, essanyu, n'obutafaayo. Kirabika ng'ekikyamu okuseka, ate naye nkikola bulijjo... Simanyi Katonda engeri gy'ayinza okuntunuuliramu, ne mu kusaasira; ndi mubi nnyo. Emirundi mingi nnyingidde mu ndagaano okumuweereza mu bujjuvu n'omutima gwange gwonna, nga nnyiikadde mu mwoyo; naye ekifaananyi ky'ebiseera byange eby'okwesulika bwe kiggwaamu, era okukemebwa kw'ensi bwe kunnumba, mmenyeka, ne neerabira okuyitibwa kwange okw'ekitiibwa era okutukuvu olw'okutya okusekererwa kw'ensi okw'entiisa, era olw'okwagala ekibi. Ayi singa nnyinza okukola obulala! Ekisa kya Katonda lulituuka luggwaawo — kale ndyoke mbeere wa? Sinnyinza kukirowoozaako.”

Kaakano nsobola okulaba nti kyali, nga bwe njogedde, bwe bulokozi bwange okuva mu ddiini ey'omutindo ogw'obulwadde omutimba era ogw'obulimba, nti empisa yange ey'obuzaaliranwa ey'essanyu n'okusanyuka bulijjo yannunulanga okuva mu mitego gyayo — wadde nga mu kiseera ekyo kino kyandabikanga ng'ekibi. Endowooza zange z'eddiini bwe zaali ez'obulwadde n'ez'obulimba mu kiseera kino, ebyawandiikibwa ebirala ebitono okuva mu kitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo bijja kubyoleka.

Ekitabo eky'ebyafaayo: “Ayi, kya nnaku okulowooza nti obulokozi bw'emmeeme yange buli ku nze nzekka, ate nga sisobola kukola na kamu! Buli gye nkyuka, byonna birabika nga bikwafu era nga bijjudde ekizikiza. Ayi, nteekwa okuzza obuggya okufuba kwange... Ayi, singa nnyinza okwejjusa! Naye sisobola. Mmanyi nti kibi; ntya obusungu bwa Katonda; naye sisobola kuwulira ekyo kye mmanyi okuba okwejjusa okw'amazima. Ayi, singa nnyinza! Njagala nga saali nfaayo nga bwe nnali edda — nga nnyinza okwerabira byonna bye nnawulira — kubanga kirabika nga kitasoboka nze okuba Omukristaayo... Olweggulo luno mu nkuŋŋaana, nnasaasirwa okuwulira, oboolyawo okusinga edda yonna, omwoyo ogw'okwegayirira. Okwesulika kwange kwali kunene nnyo n'okutuusa ne siyinza kutuula butengerera. Omutwe gwange gwanuma nnyo, era omutima gwange nga guwulira nga gujja kwatika olw'ennaku. Ayi, nga kya ntiisa okuwulira nti sirina buyinza bwange nze na kulowooza kirowoozo kitukuvu, ate nga nteekwa okufuna obulokozi bw'emmeeme yange! Sisobola kwejjusa; sisobola kwagala Mulokozi wange; era sikkiriza nti nnaakikola. Ki — ki kye nnaakola?”

Emyezi esatu oluvannyuma lw'okuzuukuka kwange nnawandiika nti: Ekitabo eky'ebyafaayo: “Wayiseewo emyezi egisukka mu esatu okuva lwe nnatandika mu mazima okunoonya obulokozi bw'emmeeme yange, ate nga sirina ntambudde kigere na kimu. Singa nnasobola okulaba mu kiseera ekyo byonna ebyali mu maaso gange, nnandiweddemu essuubi. Nnandirowoozezza nti tekisoboka okulinda, n'okusaba, n'okulwana okumala emyezi esatu — ne sifuna kantu. Kaakano ntunuulira emyezi mingi nnyo egy'okusaba n'okulwana n'okulinda mu maaso, nga nninao okutya — okumpi n'okukakasa — nti byonna ebyo, nabyo, biriba bya bwereere.

“Singa waliwo omulimu ogw'ebweru gwokka, ogw'enjawulo ddala ku nkyukakyuka ey'omunda eyeetaagisa — ekintu eky'okukola, so si kintu kya kusabira busabizi — okutema omukono oba ekigere, oba okwebonyaabonya okumu — kale oboolyawo nnandifuuse Omukristaayo, kubanga ebintu ng'ebyo nnandibikoze. Naye enkyukakyuka ey'omunda sisobola kugireeta, ate nga mbaliriddwa omusango bwe teerekole. Okubalirirwa omusango olw'obutakola kye sisobola kukola! Kya ntiisa okulowooza.

“Mpulira ng'atudde, nga ndi mulwadde era nga nkooye, ku ntobo y'olusozi oluwanvu era olutalinnyika olwaka olw'oku ntikko lye nteekwa okutuukako — nzekka, era mu kizikiza eky'ekiro. Ayi Kitange ali mu ggulu, tojja kunsobozesa kubeera mwesigwa, okufuba nnyo, n'okugumira okutuuka ku nkomerero?... Ndi mujjajjavu era omutamanyi n'okutuuka we ntiira okukola ekintu kyonna. Waliwo ebintu bingi nnyo bye njagala okwebuuza, naye ani gwe nnaabuuza? Sisobola kwogera na bazadde bange okutuusa lwe nnaamanya awatali kubuusabuusa nti nzikirizibwa; mbaagala nnyo n'okutuusa ne siyagala kubaleetera ennaku ey'okundaba nga mpweddemu essuubi. Mukwano gwange omwagalwa Ana agamba nti si Mukristaayo, era tayinza kumpa magezi oba kummbudaabuda. So tewali n'omu. Nzekka, nteekwa okwetikka emigugu gyange gyonna! Nzekka, nteekwa okunoonya omulyango ogw'ekkubo eggolokofu era ery'obufunda! Nzekka, nteekwa okukola obulokozi bw'emmeeme yange. Ate nga nze kennyini sisobola kukola kantu. Ayi, nkole ntya?”

Ng'ekyokulabirako ky'engeri y'okuyigirizibwa kwe nnali nfuna mu kiseera kino, ebigambo bino biriko omugaso: Ekitabo eky'ebyafaayo: “Nnagenze mu Nkuŋŋaana ey'oku Luguudo olw'Ekkumi n'Ebbiri ku makya gano, gye nnasaasirwa okubeera n'obuseera obutono obw'okusaba okw'amazima. Naye okuggwaamu essuubi kwange kwali kunene nnyo, n'okutuusa ne siyinza kwewala kukaaba n'eddoboozi ery'omwanguka nga nsaba obuyambi; era mu kuggwaamu essuubi kwange, nneegayirira Kitange ali mu ggulu, singa kimusanyusa, okuteeka ebigambo ebitono eby'okugumya mu kamwa k'omu ku baweereza be.

“Okusaba kwange kwaddibwamu. Awatali kulwawo Samwiri Bettle n'ayimirira n'ayogera mu ngeri eyakwatagana nnyo ne nze, ng'agamba abaavu n'abeetaaga — wadde nga kaakano bandirabise ng'abali mu buziba obw'ennaku, mu kizikiza nga tebalaba kitangaala, era nga balumwa ennyonta ate nga tebazuula mazzi — okwesiga Mukama Yesu n'okulindirira n'obugumiikiriza ekiseera kye; era balijjuzibwa ekitangaala eky'Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, era enzizi z'amazzi amalamu ne zikulukuta okuva mu bo awatali kuziyizibwa.”

Kye kyali kitegeeza okwesiga Yesu, saalina n'endowooza n'entono, era sijjukira kukiteekako na kaseera. Naye okulindirira n'obugumiikiriza ekiseera kya Katonda kyali kirabika nga kye nnyinza okutegeera, era nnava mu nkuŋŋaana olunaku olwo nga nzudde ekiwuubaalo eky'okulindirira okutaggwaawo ekitangaala eky'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okwaka mu mutima gwange n'okumpa essanyu n'emirembe bye nnali njaayaanira.

Bwe kityo olunaku olw'oluvannyuma lw'olunaku ne luyitawo mu kutunuulira okutalina ssuubi nneewulira zange n'okuwulira kw'omutima gwange, bye nnali sisobola kutuusa ku mutindo ogutuufu ogw'obunyiikivu; era obutabeera na mirembe n'ekizikiza eky'omwoyo gwange byeyongera bwongezi okuggwaamu essuubi.

Ekigambo kimu ekisembayo okuva mu kitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo kirimala: Ekitabo eky'ebyafaayo: “Omwezi ogw'Okusatu 1, 1849. Nnakuwadde nnyo. Okutya nti okwegomba kuno okw'obulokozi kuyinza okuba nga kwonna kubuzabuze kumperekera bulijjo, era buli kimu kibisiddwa ddala mu kizikiza n'okutuusa ne sisobola kutambula na kigere kimu. Kirabika gye ndi nti sisobola kugumira mbeera eno okumala ebbanga ddene. Naye ayi Kitange! By'oyagala, so si bye njagala nze, bikolebwe.”

Mu kiseera ekyo nnali nga ndi n'emyaka kkumi na mukaaga n'ekitundu, era okuva mu kiseera ekyo n'okweyongerayo, emmeeme yange yalumwa ennyonta okwefuula asaanira omugaso gw'ekitiibwa gwe nnali njolesereza. Naye n'okusinga kuno okwali okwegomba okunene okumanya Katonda eyatonda ebyewuunyo ebitategeereka bye nnali nsomako. Sijjukira kweraliikirira kwonna okw'enjawulo ku bibi byange; ekitiibwa kya Katonda kye kyampamba. Nnawulira nti ekintu ekisinga obukulu mu bulamu kwe kumumanya. Bwe kityo, awo n'awo, okunoonya kwange ne kutandika. Naye, zisanze — okunoonya okwo mu kutandika kwali kwa muzibe era okutamanya. Munnange gwe nnabuulira ebyama byange yekka yali mukwano gwange Ana. Sandiyinzizza kwogera kigambo kyonna ku nsonga eno eri bazadde bange. Empisa zaffe ez'Ekikwaka (Quaker) ez'okusirika ku nsonga zonna ez'eddiini zaakifuula ekitasoboka. Naye eri mukwano gwange, oluvannyuma lw'olunaku olwo olw'okuzuukuka, nnafuka omutima gwange mu bbaluwa empanvu ejjudde okwegomba n'okulumwa ennyonta. Tewali kabaluwa ke nnafuna akansanyusa okusinga ako! Yaneegayirira okuweerayo byonna eri Omulokozi wange, okusaba amaanyi, n'okufuba nnyo okunoonya obutukuvu, ka kimbeere ki ky'oleeteedde. ‘Ayi Hannah omwagalwa ennyo,’ bwe yagamba, ‘ka tugezeeko. Ka tunoonye okutambulira wamu nga tugenda mu bwakabaka bwe obw'ekitiibwa! Ka tulwanenga okufuna ekitundu ku mwoyo gwe.’ “Ayi, singa nnyinza okugoberera amagezi ge! Nnatuula wano nzekka mu kifo kyange eky'okusomera ne ngezaako okuwulira nga nnyinza okuweerayo byonna. Naye ne sisobola. Kiiŋŋwanira okwejjusa; kiiŋŋwanira okwagala Kitange ali mu ggulu, oba ndizikirira emirembe n'emirembe. Naye sisobola kukikola nzekka. Katonda yekka y'ayinza okunnyamba, so simanyi ngeri gye nsabamu. Ayi, nkole ntya? Ŋŋende wa?
