Okuyala n'okulumwa ennyonta y'obutuukirivu okwenkana awo, ate era, okuggyako mu buseera obutono obw'okwesulika (lwe mpandiika mu kitabo kyange), obwangu, essanyu, n'obutafaayo. Kirabika ng'ekikyamu okuseka, ate naye nkikola bulijjo... Simanyi Katonda engeri gy'ayinza okuntunuuliramu, ne mu kusaasira; ndi mubi nnyo. Emirundi mingi nnyingidde mu ndagaano okumuweereza mu bujjuvu n'omutima gwange gwonna, nga nnyiikadde mu mwoyo; naye ekifaananyi ky'ebiseera byange eby'okwesulika bwe kiggwaamu, era okukemebwa kw'ensi bwe kunnumba, mmenyeka, ne neerabira okuyitibwa kwange okw'ekitiibwa era okutukuvu olw'okutya okusekererwa kw'ensi okw'entiisa, era olw'okwagala ekibi. Ayi singa nnyinza okukola obulala! Ekisa kya Katonda lulituuka luggwaawo — kale ndyoke mbeere wa? Sinnyinza kukirowoozaako.” Kaakano nsobola okulaba nti kyali, nga bwe njogedde, bwe bulokozi bwange okuva mu ddiini ey'omutindo ogw'obulwadde omutimba era ogw'obulimba, nti empisa yange ey'obuzaaliranwa ey'essanyu n'okusanyuka bulijjo yannunulanga okuva mu mitego gyayo — wadde nga mu kiseera ekyo kino kyandabikanga ng'ekibi. Endowooza zange z'eddiini bwe zaali ez'obulwadde n'ez'obulimba mu kiseera kino, ebyawandiikibwa ebirala ebitono okuva mu kitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo bijja kubyoleka. Ekitabo eky'ebyafaayo: “Ayi, kya nnaku okulowooza nti obulokozi bw'emmeeme yange buli ku nze nzekka, ate nga sisobola kukola na kamu! Buli gye nkyuka, byonna birabika nga bikwafu era nga bijjudde ekizikiza. Ayi, nteekwa okuzza obuggya okufuba kwange... Ayi, singa nnyinza okwejjusa! Naye sisobola. Mmanyi nti kibi; ntya obusungu bwa Katonda; naye sisobola kuwulira ekyo kye mmanyi okuba okwejjusa okw'amazima. Ayi, singa nnyinza! Njagala nga saali nfaayo nga bwe nnali edda — nga nnyinza okwerabira byonna bye nnawulira — kubanga kirabika nga kitasoboka nze okuba Omukristaayo... Olweggulo luno mu nkuŋŋaana, nnasaasirwa okuwulira, oboolyawo okusinga edda yonna, omwoyo ogw'okwegayirira. Okwesulika kwange kwali kunene nnyo n'okutuusa ne siyinza kutuula butengerera. Omutwe gwange gwanuma nnyo, era omutima gwange nga guwulira nga gujja kwatika olw'ennaku. Ayi, nga kya ntiisa okuwulira nti sirina buyinza bwange nze na kulowooza kirowoozo kitukuvu, ate nga nteekwa okufuna obulokozi bw'emmeeme yange! Sisobola kwejjusa; sisobola kwagala Mulokozi wange; era sikkiriza nti nnaakikola. Ki — ki kye nnaakola?” Emyezi esatu oluvannyuma lw'okuzuukuka kwange nnawandiika nti: Ekitabo eky'ebyafaayo: “Wayiseewo emyezi egisukka mu esatu okuva lwe nnatandika mu mazima okunoonya obulokozi bw'emmeeme yange, ate nga sirina ntambudde kigere na kimu. Singa nnasobola okulaba mu kiseera ekyo byonna ebyali mu maaso gange, nnandiweddemu essuubi. Nnandirowoozezza nti tekisoboka okulinda, n'okusaba, n'okulwana okumala emyezi esatu — ne sifuna kantu. Kaakano ntunuulira emyezi mingi nnyo egy'okusaba n'okulwana n'okulinda mu maaso, nga nninao okutya — okumpi n'okukakasa — nti byonna ebyo, nabyo, biriba bya bwereere. “Singa waliwo omulimu ogw'ebweru gwokka, ogw'enjawulo ddala ku nkyukakyuka ey'omunda eyeetaagisa — ekintu eky'okukola, so si kintu kya kusabira busabizi — okutema omukono oba ekigere, oba okwebonyaabonya okumu — kale oboolyawo nnandifuuse Omukristaayo, kubanga ebintu ng'ebyo nnandibikoze. Naye enkyukakyuka ey'omunda sisobola kugireeta, ate nga mbaliriddwa omusango bwe teerekole. Okubalirirwa omusango olw'obutakola kye sisobola kukola! Kya ntiisa okulowooza. “Mpulira ng'atudde, nga ndi mulwadde era nga nkooye, ku ntobo y'olusozi oluwanvu era olutalinnyika olwaka olw'oku ntikko lye nteekwa okutuukako — nzekka, era mu kizikiza eky'ekiro. Ayi Kitange ali mu ggulu, tojja kunsobozesa kubeera mwesigwa, okufuba nnyo, n'okugumira okutuuka ku nkomerero?... Ndi mujjajjavu era omutamanyi n'okutuuka we ntiira okukola ekintu kyonna. Waliwo ebintu bingi nnyo bye njagala okwebuuza, naye ani gwe nnaabuuza? Sisobola kwogera na bazadde bange okutuusa lwe nnaamanya awatali kubuusabuusa nti nzikirizibwa; mbaagala nnyo n'okutuusa ne siyagala kubaleetera ennaku ey'okundaba nga mpweddemu essuubi. Mukwano gwange omwagalwa Ana agamba nti si Mukristaayo, era tayinza kumpa magezi oba kummbudaabuda. So tewali n'omu. Nzekka, nteekwa okwetikka emigugu gyange gyonna! Nzekka, nteekwa okunoonya omulyango ogw'ekkubo eggolokofu era ery'obufunda! Nzekka, nteekwa okukola obulokozi bw'emmeeme yange. Ate nga nze kennyini sisobola kukola kantu. Ayi, nkole ntya?” Ng'ekyokulabirako ky'engeri y'okuyigirizibwa kwe nnali nfuna mu kiseera kino, ebigambo bino biriko omugaso: Ekitabo eky'ebyafaayo: “Nnagenze mu Nkuŋŋaana ey'oku Luguudo olw'Ekkumi n'Ebbiri ku makya gano, gye nnasaasirwa okubeera n'obuseera obutono obw'okusaba okw'amazima. Naye okuggwaamu essuubi kwange kwali kunene nnyo, n'okutuusa ne siyinza kwewala kukaaba n'eddoboozi ery'omwanguka nga nsaba obuyambi; era mu kuggwaamu essuubi kwange, nneegayirira Kitange ali mu ggulu, singa kimusanyusa, okuteeka ebigambo ebitono eby'okugumya mu kamwa k'omu ku baweereza be. “Okusaba kwange kwaddibwamu. Awatali kulwawo Samwiri Bettle n'ayimirira n'ayogera mu ngeri eyakwatagana nnyo ne nze, ng'agamba abaavu n'abeetaaga — wadde nga kaakano bandirabise ng'abali mu buziba obw'ennaku, mu kizikiza nga tebalaba kitangaala, era nga balumwa ennyonta ate nga tebazuula mazzi — okwesiga Mukama Yesu n'okulindirira n'obugumiikiriza ekiseera kye; era balijjuzibwa ekitangaala eky'Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, era enzizi z'amazzi amalamu ne zikulukuta okuva mu bo awatali kuziyizibwa.” Kye kyali kitegeeza okwesiga Yesu, saalina n'endowooza n'entono, era sijjukira kukiteekako na kaseera. Naye okulindirira n'obugumiikiriza ekiseera kya Katonda kyali kirabika nga kye nnyinza okutegeera, era nnava mu nkuŋŋaana olunaku olwo nga nzudde ekiwuubaalo eky'okulindirira okutaggwaawo ekitangaala eky'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okwaka mu mutima gwange n'okumpa essanyu n'emirembe bye nnali njaayaanira. Bwe kityo olunaku olw'oluvannyuma lw'olunaku ne luyitawo mu kutunuulira okutalina ssuubi nneewulira zange n'okuwulira kw'omutima gwange, bye nnali sisobola kutuusa ku mutindo ogutuufu ogw'obunyiikivu; era obutabeera na mirembe n'ekizikiza eky'omwoyo gwange byeyongera bwongezi okuggwaamu essuubi. Ekigambo kimu ekisembayo okuva mu kitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo kirimala: Ekitabo eky'ebyafaayo: “Omwezi ogw'Okusatu 1, 1849. Nnakuwadde nnyo. Okutya nti okwegomba kuno okw'obulokozi kuyinza okuba nga kwonna kubuzabuze kumperekera bulijjo, era buli kimu kibisiddwa ddala mu kizikiza n'okutuusa ne sisobola kutambula na kigere kimu. Kirabika gye ndi nti sisobola kugumira mbeera eno okumala ebbanga ddene. Naye ayi Kitange! By'oyagala, so si bye njagala nze, bikolebwe.”

fields.title: Okuzikira kw'Okukkiriza
fields.body_html:
Okwekeberakebera kuno okw'obulwadde okw'okwerowoozaako nze kennyini kwatwala ebbanga, nga bulijjo kuli kwa maanyi ag'enjawulo, okutuusa mu kiseera ky'obufumbo bwange nga nnina emyaka kkumi n'omwenda. Tewali kimu kye kyavaamu, era mu mbeera y'ebintu, tewali kye kyandivuddemu. Yali ddiini eyeekwatako yokka nga tekwatagana na kintu kyonna ekituufu ekiva eri Katonda. Era kaakano ndaba nti kyali kisa nti obufumbo bwange, n'obulamu obuggya n'ebintu ebisingako obugazi bye nnayingizibwamu, mu ngeri emu oba endala byakyusa ebirowoozo byange ne bidda mu makubo amalala, ne bireetera enneewulira n'okuwulira kwange okw'eddiini okugwa emabega okumala akaseera, olwo omutwe gwange ne guba gwa ddembe mu kiseera ekyaddirira okulaba obulamu obw'eddiini mu ngeri eyawukana ddala.

Naye, nzikiriza nti ebyantuukako mu myaka gino byabaamu omugaso mu ngeri emu, kwe kunjigiriza obutayamba bavubuka be namanya kuba na bulamu bwa munda obwekwatako bo bennyini. Okwekwatako wekka bulijjo kikemo eri abavubuka, era singa eddiini yaabwe eba eya ngeri eyongera ku kwekwatako kuno, mpulira nti kye kisobyo kinene. Singa nnali n'obuyinza, ensonga yonna ey'enneewulira n'okuwulira mu bulamu obw'eddiini yandiragajjaliddwa ddala.

Enneewulira eneebaawo, tewali kubuusabuusa, naye tezisaanidde kwesigamwako n'akatono, so tezisaanidde kutwalibwa ng'ekigezo oba ekipimo ky'eddiini y'omuntu. Zisaanidde okulekebwa ddala ebweru w'okubalirira. Oyinza okuwulira bulungi oba okuwulira bubi, naye enneewulira ennungi n'ennaku byombi tebikwata ku kintu ekituufu kyennyini. Kiyinza okukwata ku kusanyusibwa kwo mu kintu, naye tekirina kye kikola ku butuufu bw'ekintu. Katonda bw'akwagala, tekiraga kintu, okusinziira ku kituufu kyennyini, oba owulira nti akwagala oba tokiwulira; wadde nga, nga bwe ŋŋamba, kikwata nnyo ku kusanyuka kwo. Mazima ddala, bw'oba okkiririza ddala nti akwagala, tosobola butasanyuka olw'ekyo; naye bw'ofuula okukkiriza kwo okwesigama ku nneewulira zo ez'essanyu, oba okyusa entegeka ya Katonda mu ngeri esingira ddala obutaba na ssuubi.

Njagala nnyo olugero luli olwa Luther Setaani bwe yamugamba nti: “Luther, owulira nti oli mwana wa Katonda?” Luther n'addamu nti: “Nedda, sikiwulira n'akatono, naye mmanyi nti bwe kiri. Genda emabega wange, ggwe Setaani.”

Mu myaka gyonna gye nnamala nga nnwanirira enneewulira zange, sirina lwe nnasobola okuzifuula nga bwe nnali ndowooza nti zisaanidde okuba; era olw'ekyo ekitundu eky'eddiini eky'obulamu bwange kyali nnaku gye ndi. Naye bwe nnamala okuyiga nti ebituufu eby'eddiini byali bikulu nnyo okusinga enneewulira zange ku bituufu bino, ne nvaako okutunuulira enneewulira zange, ne nnoonya kwokka okuvumbula ebituufu, ne mba bulijjo musanyufu mu bulamu bwange obw'eddiini, ne mba, awatali kufuba kwonna, n'enneewulira zennyini ez'okwagala Katonda, n'okuwummula n'emirembe n'essanyu mu mmeeme yange bye nnali nnagezaako okwewaliriza obwereere. Tewali bigambo bisobola kunnyonnyola nga ensonga eno bwe ndaba nga nkulu, wadde nga, kasookedde ngizuula nzekka, bwe njagadde okugireetera buli muntu omulala okugiraba.

Emyaka mingi ng'ebyo byonna bimaze okunfuukira ebyeyoleka, omu ku baana bange yajja gye ndi nga kirabika ali mu kubuuzabuuza kunene n'agamba nti: “Maama, Katonda amala bbanga ki okukusonyiwa bw'oba okoze obubi?”

“Tamala na dakiika emu,” nze ne nziramu.

“Oh,” n'agamba, “ekyo sisobola kukikkiriza. Ndowooza nti osooka kuwulira ennaku olw'ebbanga eddene, olwo n'omusaba mu ngeri ennungi ennyo era ennyonjo, olwo oboolyawo n'asobola okukusonyiwa.”

“Naye,” nze ne ŋŋamba, “muwala wange, Baibuli egamba nti bwe twatula ebibi byaffe, ye wa bwesigwa era mutuukirivu okutusonyiwa amangu ago.”

“Kale,” n'agamba, “sandikikkirizza ne bwe Baibuli amakumi ataano zandikigambye, kubanga mmanyi nti oteekwa okuwulira ennaku okumala akabanga akalungi, olwo n'oteekwa okusaba Katonda mu ngeri ennungi ennyo, olwo n'oteekwa okulinda okutuusa lw'anaaba yeeteeseteese okukusonyiwa.”

Nnalaba nti ensonga yali nkulu ddala, kyennava, nga ntadde omwana mu kifuba kyange, nnaggulawo Baibuli ne mmusomesa waggulu olunyiriri lwe nnali njogeddeko, olwo ne mmunnyonnyola nti Katonda yatwagala nnyo nnyini nga n'atuma Omwana we okutufiirira, era nti, olw'okwagala kwe, yali bulijjo mwetegefu okutusonyiwa ekiseera kye tumusaba, nga bwe kiri nga bamaama bulijjo bwe baba beetegese okusonyiwa abaana baabwe amangu ddala ng'abaana baagala okusonyiyibwa.

Ku nkomerero omwana n'akkiriza, era ng'agatta emikono gye emitono awamu n'agamba mu ddoboozi ery'ekitiibwa ery'akatono nti: “Ayi Mukama Yesu omwagalwa, njagala onsonyiwe kaakano kennyini olw'obubi bwange bwonna, era nkakasa nti onookikola, kubanga onjagala.” Olwo n'abuuka okuva mu kifuba kyange n'adduka ng'aleekaana n'essanyu ery'ekiseera ky'obwana.

Omuwala wange omuto yali musanyufu kubanga yali azudde ekituufu ekisanyusa n'akikkiriza. Naye mu ngeri ye ey'olubereberye ey'okutunuulira ensonga yali ayogera bwogezi ekirowoozo eky'obuzaaliranwa eky'omutima gw'omuntu. Ffenna tuwulira, nga bwe yakola, nti tuteekwa okujja eri Katonda n'okubuusabuusa okunene n'okutya, ng'ojja eri Omuntu gwe tumanyiiko katono, era gwe tutya nnyo; era nti okuganja kwe kwesigamira ddala ku bulungi n'okusaana kw'enneewulira zaffe, n'entegeka ey'emikolo egy'okumusemberera.

Okujja “n'obuvumu eri entebe ey'obwakabaka ey'ekisa okufuna okusaasirwa n'okuweebwa obuyambi mu kiseera eky'obwetaavu” kisoboka kwokka eri emmeeme etuusiddwa mu kumanya okwa ddala okw'obulungi bwa Katonda.

Naye mu myaka gyonna gye njogerako, okuva mu myaka kkumi n'omukaaga okutuuka amakumi abiri mu mukaaga, kino sikimanyanga n'akatono. Katonda yali gye ndi Omuntu ali wala, atasemberekeka, gwe, wadde nga mmaze okunoonya n'obunyiikivu n'obulumi bungi, nnalemwa ddala okuzuula. Sirina n'akatego ka kimu ku kye kigambo “Katonda kwe kwagala” kye kyategeeza. Endowooza yange ku ye yali nti yali mukama w'emirimu omukalubo era omwerowoozako yekka, gwe, oboolyawo, singa omuntu asobola okufuna enneewulira n'empisa ebisanyusa, ayinza okukwatibwa okuteekako akaseera akatono ku byetaago by'abaana be, naye ye eyali okusingira ddala amaze okumira mu birowoozo eby'ekitiibwa kye ye, n'okussibwamu ekitiibwa n'okutya ekimusaanira, olwo kyali tekisoboka kumpi, okuggyako olw'omutindo gw'obutuukirivu ogusukka ogw'omuntu, okufuna okuganja kwe.

Yandabikira ng'omufuzi omwekulumbaza asingira ddala okwerowoozaako yekka eyali akutte ekiraga kyange mu mikono gye, naye eyanfaako kwokka okusinziira ku busobozi bwange okwongera ku kitiibwa kye n'ekitiibwa kye.

Ku butakwagala kwe kwennyini okulungi okw'okwagala, kwe nnali nnaavumbula oluvannyuma, mu myaka gino gyonna sirina n'akatego akatonotono. Ate era, ekkubo lyokka lye nnamanya omuntu we yandimanyidde nti Katonda ono atasemberekeka yakkakkana n'awuliriza wadde katono okukaaba kw'abaana be lyali kwe kuba n'enneewulira ya munda ey'ekyo. Olw'ekyo, buli lwe nnabanga n'eddiini yonna, amaanyi gonna ag'omwoyo gwange gaamalibwanga, nga bwe ŋŋambye, mu kufuba okufuna mu ngeri ey'ekyama enneewulira eno ey'omunda eyetaagisa.

Engeri y'okwekeberakebera gye nnali nnyize okuva mu kuyigirizibwa kwange okw'Ekikwakeri yali eteekeddwa okuleeta okwekebera nze kennyini okutasalako okw'engeri esinga okuzibuwala, kubanga kwali kwekebera si kunene mu bikolwa by'omuntu ng'okuli mu nneewulira z'omuntu. Era, bwe tulowooza enneewulira zaffe bwe ziri ebintu ebyangu okusunguwazibwa, n'engeri gye zeesigamira ku mbeera y'obulamu bwaffe, oba embeera y'obudde, oba obuyinza bw'ebirowoozo by'abalala, tewali mulimu gusinga kutta, mu ndowooza yange, ogusobola okwenyigirwamu okusinga engeri eno ey'okwekebera. Tewali kipimo kitasoboka kwesigama okusinga ekyo ekiweebwa enneewulira z'omuntu ez'omunda ku mbeera y'omuntu ey'omwoyo.

Naye eddiini ey'emyaka gyange wakati wa kkumi n'omukaaga n'amakumi abiri mu mukaaga yali teri kintu wabula ddiini ey'okugezaako okuwulira; era, nga bwe nnali omuntu ow'obuzaaliranwa era ow'obulamu obulungi, enneewulira zange tezaali za kusuubirwa kuba za nneewulira nnyingi oba za kutya Katonda. Okufuba okulumya era okw'obwereere kwe mmaze okunnyonnyola okuzitwala ku mutindo omutuufu ogw'eddiini kintu kya kusaasira okulowoozaako.

Emmeeme yange yali eyaayaanira Katonda, naye nnali sisobola kumuzuula. N'okusanyusibwa okw'okusaba nnakugaanibwa, kubanga nnali, nga bwe ŋŋambye, nnyize endowooza nti tosobola kusaba nga kukkirizibwa okuggyako ng'owulira munda enneewulira ey'okuganja kwa Katonda, era nti okusaba kwonna okuweebwayo awatali nneewulira eno kwali kya kunyooma, era oboolyawo n'ekibi. Era, olwokubanga enneewulira eno ey'omunda ey'okuganja kwa Katonda ye yali ekintu kyennyini kye nnali nnoonya okufuna, ate nga sisobola kukisabira okutuusa lwe nnaasooka okukiba nakyo, nnafaanana ng'asuuliddwa ebweru nga sirina buyambi era nga nzeemulugunya mu kizikiza eky'ennaku.

Ekyo Baibuli kye yayogera ku kwagala kwa Katonda kyali kya mu kifo eky'okubiri ddala bwe kigeraageranyizibwa n'ekyo kye nnandiwuliddeko; mazima, nga bwe nsobola okujjukira, saafaayo ku Baibuli n'akatono. “Mpulira ntya?”

si “Katonda agamba ki?” kwe kwali okukaaba kwange okwa buli lunaku. Nnali ng'omumenyi w'amateeka mu maaso g'omulamuzi, ye, mu kifo ky'okweraliikirira engeri omulamuzi gy'amuwuliramu, yandimaze amaanyi ge gonna mu kugezaako okulaba engeri ye gy'awulira ku mulamuzi.

Embeera y'emmeeme esinga okusekererwa era esinga okusaasira omuntu talowooza. Ate era tewali n'omu gwe nnasemberera ku nsonga eno eyali amanyi obulungi; ne nneeyongera okwesamba mu ngeri ey'okuggwaamu essuubi, nga ntya okuleka okulwana kwange okw'omwoyo nneme okubonerezebwa emirembe n'emirembe, ate nga ntegeera nti tekwaleeta buyambi bwonna; era nga nkemebwa obutasalako okuvuma Katonda olw'okuziba amatu eri okukaaba kwange.

Nnali ng'omuntu afukamidde mu kisenge ekiddugavu ng'asaba n'okuggwaamu essuubi ekitangaala, nga tamanyi nti ebweru enjuba yali eyaka, era nti kyali kyetaagisa kwokka okuggulawo amadirisa n'ekitangaala kiyiike munda. Mu mbeera y'ebintu yennyini, ekitangaala, oba mu nsi eno erabika oba mu nsi ey'omwoyo, tekisobola kwevaamu kyokka. Nnali ntandise omulimu mu ngeri embi ddala. Nnali ngezaako okuwulira nga sinnamanya, era, mu kifo ky'okussa enneewulira zange ku kutegeera kwange, nnali nnoonya okussa okutegeera kwange ku nneewulira zange.

Kyali nga omuntu, ayagala okutambula okugenda mu kifo ekimu, ayingira mu kifo ky'eggaali y'omukka ekisooka ky'ayinza okusanga, era, awatali kubuuza buuzo bwonna, atuula ku ntebe mu ggaali y'omukka esooka gy'asanga, olwo n'aggalawo amaaso ge n'agezaako okuwulira oba ali mu ggaali entuufu oba nedda. Tewali muntu alina amagezi ayinza okukola ekintu eky'obusiru bwe kityo. Ate kino kyennyini kye nnali nkola mu bulamu bwange obw'eddiini. Tekyayingira mu mutwe gwange kugezaako kuzuula bituufu bya ddiini. Saamanya nti waaliwo ebituufu byonna eby'okuzuula. Enkolagana yange ne Katonda yandabikira ng'ensonga ey'enneewulira zange ku ye zokka, so nga si ku nneewulira ze ku nze n'akatono; era buli maanyi ga ddiini ge nnalina olwo gaali gakoloozeddwa okufuna enneewulira zino ezyetaagisa.

Mazima ddala, gwali mulimu ogutasoboka, era, ekiseera bwe kyagenda mu maaso, nga tewali nneewulira ntuufu ejja wadde nga nfuba, ne nneeyongera okuggwaamu amaanyi. Ku nkomerero, bwe nnali wakati w'amakumi abiri mu asatu n'amakumi abiri mu ana, ne neesanga nga nkulumbibwa okuyingira mu butakkiriza obw'olubatu. Kinzeeko bwe kiti. Ekisa mazima ddala kye kimu ku ngeri ezeetaagisa ez'Oyo Ayinzabyonna. Okwagala kwe, tugambibwa, kusukka okwagala kw'omuzadde ow'oku nsi okusingira ddala bwe tuyinza okulowooza. Naye tekikwatagana n'ekyo n'akatono okulowooza nti asobola okuba n'okumanya kwonna okw'olubereberye ku kigenderere ky'abantu b'atonda. Kale nno tayinza kuba nga w'okwagala kwonna era ate nga w'obuyinza bwonna. Awatali kimu ku bino ye taba Katonda. Naye kyandibadde eky'obutali bwenkanya ddala ffe kaakano okuba nga tuwulira ebivaamu mu kugwa kwa Adamu, ka tugambe nga waaliwo ekintu ekyo. Kale nno tugobebwa okuva ku busoboka bw'Omutonzi ow'obwenkanya okufuula abantu abeetongodde okubonaabona emirembe n'emirembe olw'ebibi bya bannaabwe. Ate ku luuyi olulala ekisa tekyandikkirizza kutonda buntu bubi obw'obuzaaliranwa, ate obwenkanya tebwandyegasseeko kubibonereza.

Tewali kudduka! Ebibuuzo lukumi biyingira okuva ku njuyi zonna. Ndi omubuusabuusa!”*
fields.body_text: Okwekeberakebera kuno okw'obulwadde okw'okwerowoozaako nze kennyini kwatwala ebbanga, nga bulijjo kuli kwa maanyi ag'enjawulo, okutuusa mu kiseera ky'obufumbo bwange nga nnina emyaka kkumi n'omwenda. Tewali kimu kye kyavaamu, era mu mbeera y'ebintu, tewali kye kyandivuddemu. Yali ddiini eyeekwatako yokka nga tekwatagana na kintu kyonna ekituufu ekiva eri Katonda. Era kaakano ndaba nti kyali kisa nti obufumbo bwange, n'obulamu obuggya n'ebintu ebisingako obugazi bye nnayingizibwamu, mu ngeri emu oba endala byakyusa ebirowoozo byange ne bidda mu makubo amalala, ne bireetera enneewulira n'okuwulira kwange okw'eddiini okugwa emabega okumala akaseera, olwo omutwe gwange ne guba gwa ddembe mu kiseera ekyaddirira okulaba obulamu obw'eddiini mu ngeri eyawukana ddala. Naye, nzikiriza nti ebyantuukako mu myaka gino byabaamu omugaso mu ngeri emu, kwe kunjigiriza obutayamba bavubuka be namanya kuba na bulamu bwa munda obwekwatako bo bennyini. Okwekwatako wekka bulijjo kikemo eri abavubuka, era singa eddiini yaabwe eba eya ngeri eyongera ku kwekwatako kuno, mpulira nti kye kisobyo kinene. Singa nnali n'obuyinza, ensonga yonna ey'enneewulira n'okuwulira mu bulamu obw'eddiini yandiragajjaliddwa ddala. Enneewulira eneebaawo, tewali kubuusabuusa, naye tezisaanidde kwesigamwako n'akatono, so tezisaanidde kutwalibwa ng'ekigezo oba ekipimo ky'eddiini y'omuntu. Zisaanidde okulekebwa ddala ebweru w'okubalirira. Oyinza okuwulira bulungi oba okuwulira bubi, naye enneewulira ennungi n'ennaku byombi tebikwata ku kintu ekituufu kyennyini. Kiyinza okukwata ku kusanyusibwa kwo mu kintu, naye tekirina kye kikola ku butuufu bw'ekintu. Katonda bw'akwagala, tekiraga kintu, okusinziira ku kituufu kyennyini, oba owulira nti akwagala oba tokiwulira; wadde nga, nga bwe ŋŋamba, kikwata nnyo ku kusanyuka kwo. Mazima ddala, bw'oba okkiririza ddala nti akwagala, tosobola butasanyuka olw'ekyo; naye bw'ofuula okukkiriza kwo okwesigama ku nneewulira zo ez'essanyu, oba okyusa entegeka ya Katonda mu ngeri esingira ddala obutaba na ssuubi. Njagala nnyo olugero luli olwa Luther Setaani bwe yamugamba nti: “Luther, owulira nti oli mwana wa Katonda?” Luther n'addamu nti: “Nedda, sikiwulira n'akatono, naye mmanyi nti bwe kiri. Genda emabega wange, ggwe Setaani.” Mu myaka gyonna gye nnamala nga nnwanirira enneewulira zange, sirina lwe nnasobola okuzifuula nga bwe nnali ndowooza nti zisaanidde okuba; era olw'ekyo ekitundu eky'eddiini eky'obulamu bwange kyali nnaku gye ndi. Naye bwe nnamala okuyiga nti ebituufu eby'eddiini byali bikulu nnyo okusinga enneewulira zange ku bituufu bino, ne nvaako okutunuulira enneewulira zange, ne nnoonya kwokka okuvumbula ebituufu, ne mba bulijjo musanyufu mu bulamu bwange obw'eddiini, ne mba, awatali kufuba kwonna, n'enneewulira zennyini ez'okwagala Katonda, n'okuwummula n'emirembe n'essanyu mu mmeeme yange bye nnali nnagezaako okwewaliriza obwereere. Tewali bigambo bisobola kunnyonnyola nga ensonga eno bwe ndaba nga nkulu, wadde nga, kasookedde ngizuula nzekka, bwe njagadde okugireetera buli muntu omulala okugiraba. Emyaka mingi ng'ebyo byonna bimaze okunfuukira ebyeyoleka, omu ku baana bange yajja gye ndi nga kirabika ali mu kubuuzabuuza kunene n'agamba nti: “Maama, Katonda amala bbanga ki okukusonyiwa bw'oba okoze obubi?” “Tamala na dakiika emu,” nze ne nziramu. “Oh,” n'agamba, “ekyo sisobola kukikkiriza. Ndowooza nti osooka kuwulira ennaku olw'ebbanga eddene, olwo n'omusaba mu ngeri ennungi ennyo era ennyonjo, olwo oboolyawo n'asobola okukusonyiwa.” “Naye,” nze ne ŋŋamba, “muwala wange, Baibuli egamba nti bwe twatula ebibi byaffe, ye wa bwesigwa era mutuukirivu okutusonyiwa amangu ago.” “Kale,” n'agamba, “sandikikkirizza ne bwe Baibuli amakumi ataano zandikigambye, kubanga mmanyi nti oteekwa okuwulira ennaku okumala akabanga akalungi, olwo n'oteekwa okusaba Katonda mu ngeri ennungi ennyo, olwo n'oteekwa okulinda okutuusa lw'anaaba yeeteeseteese okukusonyiwa.” Nnalaba nti ensonga yali nkulu ddala, kyennava, nga ntadde omwana mu kifuba kyange, nnaggulawo Baibuli ne mmusomesa waggulu olunyiriri lwe nnali njogeddeko, olwo ne mmunnyonnyola nti Katonda yatwagala nnyo nnyini nga n'atuma Omwana we okutufiirira, era nti, olw'okwagala kwe, yali bulijjo mwetegefu okutusonyiwa ekiseera kye tumusaba, nga bwe kiri nga bamaama bulijjo bwe baba beetegese okusonyiwa abaana baabwe amangu ddala ng'abaana baagala okusonyiyibwa. Ku nkomerero omwana n'akkiriza, era ng'agatta emikono gye emitono awamu n'agamba mu ddoboozi ery'ekitiibwa ery'akatono nti: “Ayi Mukama Yesu omwagalwa, njagala onsonyiwe kaakano kennyini olw'obubi bwange bwonna, era nkakasa nti onookikola, kubanga onjagala.” Olwo n'abuuka okuva mu kifuba kyange n'adduka ng'aleekaana n'essanyu ery'ekiseera ky'obwana. Omuwala wange omuto yali musanyufu kubanga yali azudde ekituufu ekisanyusa n'akikkiriza. Naye mu ngeri ye ey'olubereberye ey'okutunuulira ensonga yali ayogera bwogezi ekirowoozo eky'obuzaaliranwa eky'omutima gw'omuntu. Ffenna tuwulira, nga bwe yakola, nti tuteekwa okujja eri Katonda n'okubuusabuusa okunene n'okutya, ng'ojja eri Omuntu gwe tumanyiiko katono, era gwe tutya nnyo; era nti okuganja kwe kwesigamira ddala ku bulungi n'okusaana kw'enneewulira zaffe, n'entegeka ey'emikolo egy'okumusemberera. Okujja “n'obuvumu eri entebe ey'obwakabaka ey'ekisa okufuna okusaasirwa n'okuweebwa obuyambi mu kiseera eky'obwetaavu” kisoboka kwokka eri emmeeme etuusiddwa mu kumanya okwa ddala okw'obulungi bwa Katonda. Naye mu myaka gyonna gye njogerako, okuva mu myaka kkumi n'omukaaga okutuuka amakumi abiri mu mukaaga, kino sikimanyanga n'akatono. Katonda yali gye ndi Omuntu ali wala, atasemberekeka, gwe, wadde nga mmaze okunoonya n'obunyiikivu n'obulumi bungi, nnalemwa ddala okuzuula. Sirina n'akatego ka kimu ku kye kigambo “Katonda kwe kwagala” kye kyategeeza. Endowooza yange ku ye yali nti yali mukama w'emirimu omukalubo era omwerowoozako yekka, gwe, oboolyawo, singa omuntu asobola okufuna enneewulira n'empisa ebisanyusa, ayinza okukwatibwa okuteekako akaseera akatono ku byetaago by'abaana be, naye ye eyali okusingira ddala amaze okumira mu birowoozo eby'ekitiibwa kye ye, n'okussibwamu ekitiibwa n'okutya ekimusaanira, olwo kyali tekisoboka kumpi, okuggyako olw'omutindo gw'obutuukirivu ogusukka ogw'omuntu, okufuna okuganja kwe. Yandabikira ng'omufuzi omwekulumbaza asingira ddala okwerowoozaako yekka eyali akutte ekiraga kyange mu mikono gye, naye eyanfaako kwokka okusinziira ku busobozi bwange okwongera ku kitiibwa kye n'ekitiibwa kye. Ku butakwagala kwe kwennyini okulungi okw'okwagala, kwe nnali nnaavumbula oluvannyuma, mu myaka gino gyonna sirina n'akatego akatonotono. Olw'ekyo, buli lwe nnabanga n'eddiini yonna, amaanyi gonna ag'omwoyo gwange gaamalibwanga, nga bwe ŋŋambye, mu kufuba okufuna mu ngeri ey'ekyama enneewulira eno ey'omunda eyetaagisa. Engeri y'okwekeberakebera gye nnali nnyize okuva mu kuyigirizibwa kwange okw'Ekikwakeri yali eteekeddwa okuleeta okwekebera nze kennyini okutasalako okw'engeri esinga okuzibuwala, kubanga kwali kwekebera si kunene mu bikolwa by'omuntu ng'okuli mu nneewulira z'omuntu. Era, bwe tulowooza enneewulira zaffe bwe ziri ebintu ebyangu okusunguwazibwa, n'engeri gye zeesigamira ku mbeera y'obulamu bwaffe, oba embeera y'obudde, oba obuyinza bw'ebirowoozo by'abalala, tewali mulimu gusinga kutta, mu ndowooza yange, ogusobola okwenyigirwamu okusinga engeri eno ey'okwekebera. Tewali kipimo kitasoboka kwesigama okusinga ekyo ekiweebwa enneewulira z'omuntu ez'omunda ku mbeera y'omuntu ey'omwoyo. Naye kyandibadde eky'obutali bwenkanya ddala ffe kaakano okuba nga tuwulira ebivaamu mu kugwa kwa Adamu, ka tugambe nga waaliwo ekintu ekyo. Kale nno tugobebwa okuva ku busoboka bw'Omutonzi ow'obwenkanya okufuula abantu abeetongodde okubonaabona emirembe n'emirembe olw'ebibi bya bannaabwe. Ate ku luuyi olulala ekisa tekyandikkirizza kutonda buntu bubi obw'obuzaaliranwa, ate obwenkanya tebwandyegasseeko kubibonereza. Tewali kudduka! Ebibuuzo lukumi biyingira okuva ku njuyi zonna. Ndi omubuusabuusa!”*

fields.title: Okunoonya Okuppya
fields.body_html:
Okubuusabuusa kuno kweyongerayo okumala emyaka egisukka ebiri, era nnali mmaze okutereera mu kwo, nga nkutwala ng’embeera eya bulijjo eri buli muntu alowooza era ategeera. Naye omwaka gwa 1858 gwali guteekeddwa okukyusa buli kimu.

Ku ntandikwa y’omwaka ogwo, nategeeragana n’Abakristaayo abamu abanywerera ennyo ku nzikiriza entongole, abaali bajjudde enjigiriza n’enkalakkalira z’Obukristaayo. Nga bwe nnayogeddeko emabega, saalina kye nnamanya n’akatono ku njigiriza; tezaali zibaddeeko mu ndowooza yange ku ddiini n’akatono. N’olwekyo, nnasanyukira nnyo okuwulira ebikwata ku zo, era ne ntandika okwebuuza oba obutakkiriza bwange bwali buvudde ku butamanya kwange okutuufu okw’enjigiriza zino zennyini.

Ku lunaku olw’omwezi ogwa 25 Apuli 1858, nawandiika mu kitabo kyange eky’ebyafaayo: Ebyafaayo: “Bayibuli eyogera ku kyetaagisa eky’okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri. Kitegeeza ki? Mazima ddala waliwo ekintu ekifaanana bwe kityo ekiyinza okufunibwa mu bulamu? Era okukkiriza Yesu ow’e Nazaaleesi ng’Omulokozi w’ensi kyetaagisa mu kino? Ayi, nga bwe njayaanira nnyo okutereera mu mutima… Kiyinzika okuba nti okulemererwa kwange kwonna okuzuula n’okutambulira mu kkubo ettuufu kuva ku kugaana kwange Kristo mu ngeri Abakristaayo abasinga obungi gye balabika okumusembezaamu; naye mazima siyinza kumusembeza bwe kityo. Ate era, oba ekkubo lyabwe bwe liba lye mazima, nteekwa okulinda okutuusa Omukulembeze wange ow’Obwakatonda lw’alinnyingiza mu lyo; era mazima tanjingiza mu lyo kaakano, wabula, nga bwe kindabikira, ampeeka wala n’okusingawo… “Emmeeme yange yonna n’amagezi gange biraga ng’bewewula okuva ku ndowooza entongole ey’ebyomubiri egy’Enjiri. Kirabika nga tekisoboka gye ndi okukkiriza obusobozi obutangirira obw’okufa kwa Kristo. Amagezi gange gajeemera buli kintu eky’ebyomubiri ng’endowooza nti okufa kw’omubiri gwe okw’ebweru (nga ate mazima kwali kuteekwa okubaawo mu ngeri emu olw’obuntu bwe) kuyinza okuba nga kwalina obusobozi obutangirira. Kirabika bulungi nnyo nti, singa okutangirira kwali kwetaagisa n’akatono, obulamu bwe bwe bwali ssaddaaka. Okwambala obuntu ku Bwakatonda kyali kutoowaza kwa kyewuunyo era n’okubonaabona okukaawa; okubwambulamu, ka kibe mu ngeri yonna, tekyandibaddeko kutangirira n’akatono.

“Naye nnyinza okuba nga nkyamu mu ndowooza zange. Mukama yekka y’ayinza okunjigiriza.”

Nate, ku lunaku olw’omwezi ogwa 18 Maayi 1858, nawandiika nti: Ebyafaayo: “Sisobola kwewala ndowooza nti ntuuse ku ngeri ya Mazima ey’ekitiibwa okusinga eyo abatume gye baalina, era n’olwekyo siyinza kusaba nti, ‘Mukama, nzikiriza; nnyamba obutakkiriza bwange,’ kubanga sirina kikakasa nti ndi mu butakkiriza. Kyokka, siwummudde mu kukkiriza kwange oba mu butakkiriza bwange — ekiba kyonna — ate era siraba kkubo lya kudduka.

“Ekiro ekyayita mu kibiina kyaffe eky’okusoma Bayibuli, natandika okwogera ku nsonga eno, nga nsuubira nti mikwano gyange egy’enzikiriza entongole banaawakana n’obumalirivu ku luuyi lwabwe okutuuka okumpaliriza okukkiriza mu ngeri entongole ey’okukkiriza. Naye ku nkomerero, nawulira nti tewali kuwakana kuyinza kugasa kintu kyonna. Okukkiriza kwange bwe kunaakyusibwa, kinaava mu maanyi ag’Obwakatonda, era ddala kinaaba kwe ‘kuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri.’ Naye kirabika gye ndi nga tekisoboka.”

Nate, ku lunaku olw’omwezi ogwa 25 Juuni 1858, nawandiika nti: Ebyafaayo: “Nkutte era nfudde nate, era njjudde amalala! Olunaku lulituuka mazima ku nkomerero, lwe balinjogerako, nga bwe kyayogerwa ku Efulayimu ow’edda nti, ‘Yeegasse ne bakatonda be abalala; mumuleke!’ ‘Ekifaananyi kyange’ kaakano, nga ntya, kwe kwemanya kw’amagezi g’abantu, okugaana okwetoowaza ne kufuuka ng’omwana omuto nga tekinnaba kuyingira mu Bwakabaka obw’omu Ggulu… “Kaakano ndi mu buzibu bungi olw’enzikiriza yange ey’eddiini. Njayaanira okugoberera enzikiriza entongole, naye siyinza; ate ku luuyi olumu kirabika ng’ekibi obutasobola, mu kiseera kye kimu kirabika ng’ekibi gye ndi okugezaako okukikola nga ekitangaala ekitegeerekeka obulungi kirabise okumpeebwa.

“Amazima bwe gaba nga ge ago Abayuniteriya ge bakkiririza, ntya okugamanya. Ntya ebiribivaamu. Nnetta ku kunyoomebwa n’okuvumibwa kwe kyandindeetedde. Ate era mu kiseera kye kimu, oboolyawo waliwo ekintu ekisanyusa katono amalala g’obuntu n’obuzira mu ndowooza ey’okuyitibwa okuyimirira nzekka ku ekyo kye ntwala ng’amazima ag’ekitiibwa okusingawo. Ate era saagala kuba nzekka nga njawukanye ku abo be njagala. Ndi mu mbeera ey’okusoberwa okunakuwaza.”

Okusoberwa kuno ne kweyongera n’okukwata ennyo, era ku nkomerero natandika okuwulira nti kyali bukuusa obutakyogerako eri mikwano gyange. Nnali nnaakamaliriza okusalawo okukikola, olunaku olumu, ekintu we kyabaawo ekyakyusa entambula yonna ey’obulamu bwange.

Era kino kintuusa ku kiseera ekyokubiri mu byafaayo by’emmeeme yange.
