fields.title: Ekiseera Ekyokusatu Mu Bulamu Bwange Obw’eddiini (Okuzzibwawo Kw’ebintu Byonna)
fields.body_html:
Nga bwe nnayogera mu ssuula eyayita, oluvannyuma lw’emyaka mitono egy’essanyu erisukkiridde mu mawulire amalungi ag’obulokozi obuyita mu Kristo — ku lwange n’okw’abo abaakkiriza nga nze — omutima gwange gwatandika okugolokokera ebweru eri abo abaakkiriza mu ngeri endala, era naddala eri abo abaali, olw’embeera z’okuzaalibwa kwabwe n’ebibaali bibetoolodde, abatafunanga mukisa mulungi mu bulamu. Saayinza kwewala kulaba nti obutamanya Katonda, era n’olwekyo obulamu obw’ekibi, kyalabika ng’enkomerero etaddibwaŋŋanwa ey’abantu bannange bangi ennyo. Era saayinza kukitabaganya n’obwenkanya bwa Katonda nti emmeeme ng’ezo ez’ennaku zandisaliddwa okubonaabona okutaggwaawo olw’embeera ze zaali zitavunaanyizibwako era ze zaali zitayinza kudduka mu bibalo ebisinga obungi.

Ekyo nti nze, atakisaanira okusinga bo, nnaleetebwa mu kumanya amazima nga bo balekeddwa ebweru mu mpewo, kyanzitoowerera nnyo nti emirundi mingi nnawulira nti nnandiwaddeyo n’essanyu obulokozi bwange nzennyini singa, mu ngeri eyo, nnandisobozza okubuwa abo abaateekebwa mu mbeera embi okusinga eyange.

Natandika okuwulira nti obulokozi bwe nnali njagalidde bwali, mu butuufu, bulokozi bufunda era obw’okwefaako, obutasaanira Mutonzi eyalangirira mu bukalabakalaba nti “okusaasira kwe okuwooma kuli ku mirimu gye gyonna,” era n’obutasingako okusaanira Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, eyajja mu nsi olw’ekigendererwa kimu kyokka eky’okulokola ensi. Saayinza kukkiriza nti obulamu bwe n’okufa kwe ku lwaffe byali biteekeddwa okulemererwa ennyo bwe kityo okutereeza ekibi kyennyini kye yajjira okutereeza. Nnawulira nti kiteekwa okuba nga tekisoboka nti wandibaddewo obulemu bwonna mu bulokozi bwe yali awaddeyo.

Nnakakasibwa nti obuzibu bwange bwali buvudde kwokka mu kutategeera nteekateeka za Katonda, era ne neemalirira n’obunyiikivu okuzuula ensobi yange. Nga bwe njogedde, obuddukiro bwange obusooka bwali kwe kumalibwawo kw’ababi. Naye kino mangwago kyalabika ng’ekitasaanira Mutonzi ow’amagezi era omulungi — mazima, kwatula kwa nnaku okw’okulemererwa ku luuyi lwe — era saayinza kukitabaganya n’obuyinzabwonna bwe oba okumanyabyonna kwe. Natandika okutya nti nnali ŋŋenda kunakuwazibwa mu Katonda.

Naye olunaku olumu okubikkulirwa ne kujja okwamulwanirira ne kugonjoola ekibuuzo kyonna emirembe gyonna.

Bulijjo twabeeranga n’ababuulizi ab’okuzuukusa mu maka gaffe, kubanga twanoonyanga buli kakisa okuyamba okutuusa mu maaso ekyo kye twayita “omulimu gw’enjiri.” Mu bo ne wajja omu eyali akwatiddwa nnyo endowooza nti kyali nkizo era buvunaanyizibwa bwa Bakristaayo okugabana, mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, mu kubonaabona kwa Kristo awamu n’essanyu lye. Kirabika yali alowooza nti okukola bwe kityo mu ngeri emu kwandiyambye abo abaali batamanyi kintu ku bulokozi obuli mu Kristo; era yali akwasizza empisa ey’okwegayirira n’amaanyi ku nsonga eno mu nkuŋŋaana ze. Yasabanga Abakristaayo abaali beetegefu, ku lw’abalala, okwetwalira ekitundu ku kubonaabona kwa Kristo, “okusembera mu maaso” ku ntebe ey’omu maaso mu nkuŋŋaana ne basaba nti enkizo ng’eyo bagiweebwe.

Mu ngeri emu byonna byawulikika nga bikulu nnyo era eby’obuzira, era byakwatagana ddala n’okwegomba kwange okuyamba bannange abantu abatalina mukisa nti, wadde nga saagenda mu maaso okusaba mu nkuŋŋaana ze yonna, mazima natandika kyama okusaba — mu buzibe ne mu butamanya — nti nnyingire mu bumanyirivu obwo, ka bube bwonna bwe bwali.

Ekyavaamu kyali kya njawulo nnyo ku ekyo kye nnali nsuubidde, era eky’amaanyi ennyo okusingawo.

Nnali nsuubidde okuyingira mu kuwulira okw’okubonaabona kwa Kristo kwennyini mu bulamu n’okufa kwe yatwetikkira. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, kyandabikira nga mfuna okubikkulirwa, si okw’okubonaabona kwe olw’ekibi, wabula okwaffe. Kyandabikira ng’endaba ennaku n’obuyinike obwaleetebwa ku bantu olw’okuyingira kw’ekibi mu nsi, n’ennaku ya Kristo — si olw’okubonaabona kwe yennyini olw’ekyo, wabula olw’okubonaabona kw’abantu abaavu abaali bakolimiddwa nakyo.

Kyandabikira nga ntegeera ekintu ku buyinike bwe bwe buteekwa okuba nga bw’ali ku kulaba enkomerero ey’entiisa eyakkirizibwa okutuuka ku bantu, n’essanyu lye nti yali asobola okukola ekintu okukukendeeza. Nnalaba nti okwaffe kwe kwali okubonaabona, n’okwe kwe kwali essanyu ery’okwewaayo Ye yennyini okutulokola. Nnawulira nti singa nnali Mutonzi ow’Obwakatonda ne nkkiriza enkomerero ey’entiisa bwe etyo okutuuka ku bitonde bye nnakola, nnandijjuddwa obuyinike era nnanditegedde nti obwenkanya obwangu — wadde nga si kwagala — bwandinsabye okuzuula eddagala erimu. Era nnamanya nti saayinza kuba wa bwenkanya okusinga Katonda.

Emirundi n’emirundi, neesanga nga nziramu mu mutima gwange ennyiriri George MacDonald z’ateeka ku jjinja ery’oku ntaana mu lumu ku ngero ze: “Ai Ggwe eyakola omusota, Otuwe okusonyiyibwa, era okkirize okusonyiyibwa.”

Nnali mpulidde bingi ku bubi bw’ebibi byaffe eri Katonda; naye kaakano neesanga nga neebuuza: Naye ate obubi bw’enkomerero yaffe olw’okufuulibwa aboonoonyi? Sandisinze nnyo okwagala nti omuntu ansobezaako ekibi okusinga nze okusobya ku muntu omulala yenna? Tekyali kya ntiisa nnyo okufuulibwa omwonoonyi okusinga okusobezebwako?

Era natandika okulaba nti, olw’okuba Katonda yakkiriza ekibi okuyingira mu nsi, kiteekwa okugoberera nti, mu bwenkanya obwa bulijjo, yandiwalirizibbwa okuwaayo eddagala erienkana n’obulwadde. Nzijukira ba maama be nnamanya abaana baabwe abaalwala endwadde ezaasikirwa, abaali beebaza nnyo okuwaayo obulamu bwabwe mu kwewaayo singa, mu ngeri yonna, baasobola okuzzaawo obulabe bwe baaleeta olw’okuleeta abaana bano mu nsi wansi w’embeera embi bwe zityo. Era neebuuza: Katonda yandikoze ekitono?

Nnalaba nti bwe kipimibwa ku minzaani ey’obukyamu obugumiikirizibwa, ffe, abaatondebwa nga tuli boonoonyi, twalina bingi ennyo okusonyiwa okusinga omuntu yenna gwe ffe tuyinza okuba nga twasobyako.

Obweyu bino byonna bwe byanjijira tebuyinza kwogerwa. Saabirowooza, oba okubisiima, oba okubiteebereza. Nnabiraba. Kwali kubikkulirwa kw’engeri y’ebintu ey’amazima — si ng’endowooza ez’oku ngulu, ez’obulijjo, wabula ng’amazima ag’edda agasoobera wansi — era tekwayinza kugaanibwa. Mu buli maaso g’omuntu ge nnalaba, kyandabikira ng’okusaanukulwa mu maaso gange olugero olw’ennaku n’obuyinike obwali buyingidde mu nsi olw’ekibi. Nnamanya nti Katonda kiteekwa nga akiraba n’amaaso amayonjo okusinga gange, era n’olwekyo okubonaabona kwe olw’okulaba kuteekwa okuba okusingako ennyo — wadde nga okwange kwali kwakawulira nga kumpi n’okuba okutagumiikirizika. Era natandika okutegeera engeri ekisinga obutono kye yandikoze bwe kyandibadde okwaniriza n’essanyu eritayogerekeka ekintu kyonna ekyandiyambye okununula ebitonde bye yali atonze okuva mu nnaku ey’entiisa ng’eyo.

Kwali kutegeera okuteerabirwa okw’obuyinike bw’ensi olw’ekibi.

Kwamala bbanga ki sisobola kujjukira, naye nga kukyaliwo, kwali kumpi okunsesebbula. Era olw’okuba kwaddangamu buli lwe nnalaba amaaso g’omugwira, neesanga nga mpalirizibbwa okwambala akaliba akagumu buli lwe nnafuluma mu nguudo, ndyoke nneewale okutuukibwako okw’entiisa okw’okutegeera okwo.

Olunaku olumu nnali ntambulira mu tulaamu mu luguudo Market Street mu Philadelphia abasajja babiri bwe bajja ne batuula mu maaso gange. Nnabalaba mu kizikizakizika okuyita mu kaliba kange ne mpulira nga mpummudde — ekizikizakizika kyategeeza obukuumi. Konidakita bwe yajja olw’empeera yange, kyansabaawo okuyimusa akaliba nsobole okubala sente. Bwe nakayimusa, ne ndaba obulungi amaaso ago abiri, n’omukoka omungi ogw’obuyinike ne gunkulukuta. Kyandabikira nga mfuna okubikkulirwa okulala — okusinga obweyu era okwa buziba — okw’ennaku ekibi kye kyaleeta ku bantu. Kyali kisukka bwe nnasobola okugumira. Nnanyweza emikono gyange ne nkaabira munda nti, “Ai Katonda, oyinza otya okukugumira? Wandikiziyizza, naye tewakiziyiza. N’okwo kaakano wandikikyusizza, naye tokikyusa. Sirabye engeri gy’oyinza okweyongera okuba omulamu n’ogumira endaba ng’eyo.”

Nnanenya Katonda. Era nnawulira nti nnali ntuufu okukola bwe ntyo.

Awo, amangwago, Katonda kyandabikira ng’anziramu. Eddoboozi ery’omunda ne lyogera mu ddoboozi ery’okwagala okutaliiko kkomo n’obuwombeefu: “Aliraba ku kutegana kw’emmeeme ye, n’akkuta.”

“N’akkuta!” ne nkaabira munda yange. “Kristo alina okukkuta! Aliraba ennaku y’ensi, n’oluvannyuma n’aleeta okutegana kwe yagumira olw’ekyo, era alikkuta n’ekyavaamu! Singa nnali Kristo, tewaali kintu kyandinkkusizza okuggyako nga buli muntu ku nkomerero alokoddwa. N’olwekyo, tewali kisingako obutono kiyinza kumukkusa.”

N’ekyo, akaliba kyandabikira nga kaggibwako ku nteekateeka z’obutonde bwonna. Nnalaba nti kyali kya mazima, nga Bayibuli bw’alangirira, nti “Nga mu Adamu bonna bwe bafa, era bwe batyo mu Kristo bonna balifuulibwa balamu.” Nga bwe kyali eky’olubereberye, bwe kityo n’eky’okubiri kyali. “Bonna” mu nsonga emu tekyayinza mu bwenkanya kutegeeza kisingako butono ku “bonna” mu ndala. N’olwekyo, nnalaba nti eddagala liteekwa okwenkana n’obulwadde — nti obulokozi buteekwa okuba obwa buli muntu nga bwe kwali okugwa.

Nnabiraba byonna bino ku lunaku olwo mu tulaamu mu Market Street — si okubirowooza kwokka, oba okubisuubira, oba okubikkiriza, wabula okubimanya. Kwali kwa mazima kwa Bwakatonda. Era okuva mu kaseera ako, sirinnaba kubuusabuusa ku nkomerero ey’abantu. Katonda ye Mutonzi wa buli muntu; n’olwekyo ye Kitaawe wa buli omu, era bonna baana be. Era Kristo yafiirira buli omu, eyalangirirwa okuba “ekitangirira, si eky’ebibi byaffe byokka, naye n’eky’ebibi eby’ensi yonna” (1 Yokaana 2:2).

Ka bube nga obutamanya bwenkana wa, ka kibe nga ekibi kya nnaku ekimeeka, ekisuubizo eky’obulokozi kya lwatu era tekiriiko kkomo.

Bwe kiba nga kya mazima nti “olw’ekyonoono eky’omu okusalirwa omusango kwajjira abantu bonna eri okuzikirira,” kale mu ngeri y’emu kya mazima nti “olw’obutuukirivu obw’omu ekirabo eky’obuwa kyajjira abantu bonna eri obutuukirivu obw’obulamu.” Okukoma “abantu bonna” abasembayo kwe kukoma n’abasooka. Obulokozi bwenkanankana ddala n’okugwa. Wagenda kubaawo “okuzzibwawo kw’ebintu byonna” okusembayo, nga “mu linnya lya Yesu buli vviivi ligwa — eby’omu ggulu, n’eby’oku nsi, n’eby’omu ttaka wansi — era buli lulimi lwatula nti Yesu Kristo ye Mukama, olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda Kitaawe.” Buli vviivi, buli lulimi — tewaali kya kubuuka kirala kyandibadde ekizingiramu byonna okusingawo.

Engeri n’ekiseera saabiraba. Naye amazima ag’omugaso ge gaali gonna bye nnayagala: mu kifo kimu, mu ngeri emu, Katonda yali agenda kutereeza buli kimu eri ebitonde byonna bye yatonda. Omutima gwange gwawummulira mu kino emirembe gyonna.

Nayanguwa okudda eka nga njayaanira okutuuka ku Bayibuli yange, okulaba oba amazima gano ag’ekitalo ge nnali nzudde gaali gayinza okuba nga gaaliwo bulijjo nga sigatageze. Amangu ddala bwe nnayingira mu nnyumba, saggyeeko na nkuufiira yange, wabula nadduka eri emmeeza Bayibuli yange ne Concordance we byabeeranga bulijjo nga biteekeddwa. Natandika okunoonya — era amangwago Ekitabo kyonna kyandabikira nga kimasamasa. Ku buli lupapula amazima agakwata ku “biseera eby’okuzzibwawo kw’ebintu byonna,” Omutume Peetero g’ayogerako nti “Katonda kye yayogerera mu kamwa ka bannabbi be abatukuvu bonna okuva ensi lwe yatondebwa,” gaamasamasa, nga tegaleka bbanga lya kubuusabuusa.

Nakyusa n’obwesunge okuva ku lupapula okudda ku lulala, nga nseka waggulu olw’essanyu olw’ekitangaala ekyakijjuza. Ne kifuuka kitabo kiggya. Kyali ng’eriba eddala liggiddwako ku buli kyawandiikibwa, era buli lunyiriri lwamasamasa n’amakulu amaggya — si makulu ga njawulo, kubanga amaggya tegaawakanya makadde, wabula amakulu ag’obuziba, amakulu ag’amazima agaali gakwekeddwa mu nzikiriza ey’ebweru ey’ebigambo. Tewaali kya mu byawandiikibwa kyeetaaga kukyusibwa; okutegeera kwange kwokka kwe kwali kwetaaga okuggulwawo. Era kaakano, ku nkomerero, kwaggulwawo.

Nzijukira nga tewannayita bbanga, mu kusoma kwange Bayibuli okwa buli lunaku, ne ntuuka ku Zabbuli ne nneewuunya ekitangaala ekiggya ekyateekebwa ku kunenya kwazo okusinga obukambwe — okwafaanana n’okwegomba omusaayi. Nnalaba nti, bwe zisomebwa mu mwoyo so si mu nnukuta, zaali zijjudde obuwanguzi obw’ekirungi ku kibi obwasuubizibwa era obusembayo, era zaali kulwanirira kwa kitalo okw’obulungi n’obwenkanya bwa Katonda, atalirwummula — era atasaanira, era atasobola — okutuusa abalabe be bonna, n’abaffe, nga bateekeddwa wansi w’ebigere bye.

Nnalaba nti obwakabaka bwe buteekwa okuba obw’omunda nga tebunnaba kuba bwa kungulu; nti bwakabaka bwa ndowooza, so si bwa maanyi ga nkambwe; nti okufuga kwe kuli ku mitima, so si ku bitundu by’ensi; nti obuwanguzi bwe buteekwa okubaawo munda nga tebunnabikkulwa bweru. Anoonya kufuga myoyo okusinga mibiri. Tewaali buwanguzi bwandimukkusizza okuggyako obuwanguzi obuwangula omutima — okwewaayo kw’emmeeme ey’eddembe era ekakasibbwa, so si kwewaayo kwokka kw’omuddu awanguddwa. Nga Milton bw’agamba, “Awangula n’amaanyi awangudde kitundu kyokka ky’omulabe we,” era nnalaba nti kino kyali kya mazima.

Bwe gasomebwa mu kitangaala kino, ebigambo byennyini ebyali binjijuzza entiisa kaakano byasanyusa emmeeme yange n’ettendo: “Katonda agolokoke, abalabe be basaasaane; n’abo abamukyawa badduke mu maaso ge.

Ng’omukka bwe guggibwawo, bw’otyo obagobe; ng’ebisenge bwe bisaanuuka mu maaso g’omuliro, bw’atyo ababi bazikiririre mu maaso ga Katonda.”

Obusungu bwa Katonda bulwanyisa ekibi, so si omwonoonyi; era abalabe be bwe basaasaanyizibwa, ababaffe basaasaanyizibwa nabo. Ekitala kye bwe butuukirivu, ekitta ekibi omwonoonyi alyoke abe omulamu. Omuliro ogw’obusungu bwe gwe muliro ogw’omuweesi alongoosa; tatuula ng’omuzikiriza w’emmeeme wabula ng’omulongoosa waayo, okugitukuza nga zaabu ne ffeeza bwe zitukuzibwa.

“Okwagala tekukkakkana.

Abalabe bayinza okugulwa oba okusendebwasendebwa Okubaggya ku kigendererwa kyabwe ekibi; Naye agenda nga takkakkanyiziddwa Oyo eyeemalidde ku kisa.”

Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli agamba nti, “Wali Katonda eyabasonyiwa, newakubadde nga wawalana eggwanga ku bikolwa byabwe”; era n’ekisumuluzo kino mu ngalo, okunenya kwonna okw’obusungu bwa Katonda — okwali edda nga kwa bukambwe era nga tekwa bwenkanya eri amatu gange — kwafuulibwa ebirango eby’obumalirivu bwe obw’okwagala okutufuula abalungi abasaanira okubeera naye mu Ggulu emirembe gyonna.

Nnandisobodde okwongera ebyokulabirako awatali kkomo eby’ekitangaala kino ekiggya ekyamasamasa mu bulungi obusikiriza ku buli lupapula lw’Ebyawandiikibwa, naye bino bimala. Ku nkomerero natandika okutegeera Omutume Pawulo kye yali ategeeza bwe yagamba nti yafuulibwa omuweereza w’endagaano empya, “si ya nnukuta, naye ya mwoyo; kubanga ennukuta etta, naye omwoyo guwa obulamu.” Ebintu bye nnali nsomye edda mu nnukuta ne bikankana, kaakano — nga mbisoma mu mwoyo — byanjijuza essanyu

Mu buli maaso g’omuntu ge nnalaba, kyandabikira ng’okusaanukulwa mu maaso gange olugero olw’ennaku n’obuyinike obwali buyingidde mu nsi olw’ekibi. Nnamanya nti Katonda kiteekwa nga akiraba n’amaaso amayonjo okusinga gange, era n’olwekyo okubonaabona kwe olw’okulaba kuteekwa okuba okusingako ennyo — wadde nga okwange kwali kwakawulira nga kumpi n’okuba okutagumiikirizika. Era natandika okutegeera engeri ekisinga obutono kye yandikoze bwe kyandibadde okwaniriza n’essanyu eritayogerekeka ekintu kyonna ekyandiyambye okununula ebitonde bye yali atonze okuva mu nnaku ey’entiisa ng’eyo. Kwali kutegeera okuteerabirwa okw’obuyinike bw’ensi olw’ekibi. Kwamala bbanga ki sisobola kujjukira, naye nga kukyaliwo, kwali kumpi okunsesebbula. Era olw’okuba kwaddangamu buli lwe nnalaba amaaso g’omugwira, neesanga nga mpalirizibbwa okwambala akaliba akagumu buli lwe nnafuluma mu nguudo, ndyoke nneewale okutuukibwako okw’entiisa okw’okutegeera okwo. Olunaku olumu nnali ntambulira mu tulaamu mu luguudo Market Street mu Philadelphia abasajja babiri bwe bajja ne batuula mu maaso gange. Nnabalaba mu kizikizakizika okuyita mu kaliba kange ne mpulira nga mpummudde — ekizikizakizika kyategeeza obukuumi. Konidakita bwe yajja olw’empeera yange, kyansabaawo okuyimusa akaliba nsobole okubala sente. Bwe nakayimusa, ne ndaba obulungi amaaso ago abiri, n’omukoka omungi ogw’obuyinike ne gunkulukuta. Kyandabikira nga mfuna okubikkulirwa okulala — okusinga obweyu era okwa buziba — okw’ennaku ekibi kye kyaleeta ku bantu. Kyali kisukka bwe nnasobola okugumira. Nnanyweza emikono gyange ne nkaabira munda nti, “Ai Katonda, oyinza otya okukugumira? Wandikiziyizza, naye tewakiziyiza. N’okwo kaakano wandikikyusizza, naye tokikyusa. Sirabye engeri gy’oyinza okweyongera okuba omulamu n’ogumira endaba ng’eyo.” Nnanenya Katonda. Era nnawulira nti nnali ntuufu okukola bwe ntyo. Awo, amangwago, Katonda kyandabikira ng’anziramu. Eddoboozi ery’omunda ne lyogera mu ddoboozi ery’okwagala okutaliiko kkomo n’obuwombeefu: “Aliraba ku kutegana kw’emmeeme ye, n’akkuta.” “N’akkuta!” ne nkaabira munda yange. “Kristo alina okukkuta! Aliraba ennaku y’ensi, n’oluvannyuma n’aleeta okutegana kwe yagumira olw’ekyo, era alikkuta n’ekyavaamu! Singa nnali Kristo, tewaali kintu kyandinkkusizza okuggyako nga buli muntu ku nkomerero alokoddwa. N’olwekyo, tewali kisingako obutono kiyinza kumukkusa.” N’ekyo, akaliba kyandabikira nga kaggibwako ku nteekateeka z’obutonde bwonna. Nnalaba nti kyali kya mazima, nga Bayibuli bw’alangirira, nti “Nga mu Adamu bonna bwe bafa, era bwe batyo mu Kristo bonna balifuulibwa balamu.” Nga bwe kyali eky’olubereberye, bwe kityo n’eky’okubiri kyali. “Bonna” mu nsonga emu tekyayinza mu bwenkanya kutegeeza kisingako butono ku “bonna” mu ndala. N’olwekyo, nnalaba nti eddagala liteekwa okwenkana n’obulwadde — nti obulokozi buteekwa okuba obwa buli muntu nga bwe kwali okugwa. Nnabiraba byonna bino ku lunaku olwo mu tulaamu mu Market Street — si okubirowooza kwokka, oba okubisuubira, oba okubikkiriza, wabula okubimanya. Kwali kwa mazima kwa Bwakatonda. Era okuva mu kaseera ako, sirinnaba kubuusabuusa ku nkomerero ey’abantu. Katonda ye Mutonzi wa buli muntu; n’olwekyo ye Kitaawe wa buli omu, era bonna baana be. Era Kristo yafiirira buli omu, eyalangirirwa okuba “ekitangirira, si eky’ebibi byaffe byokka, naye n’eky’ebibi eby’ensi yonna” (1 Yokaana 2:2). Ka bube nga obutamanya bwenkana wa, ka kibe nga ekibi kya nnaku ekimeeka, ekisuubizo eky’obulokozi kya lwatu era tekiriiko kkomo. Bwe kiba nga kya mazima nti “olw’ekyonoono eky’omu okusalirwa omusango kwajjira abantu bonna eri okuzikirira,” kale mu ngeri y’emu kya mazima nti “olw’obutuukirivu obw’omu ekirabo eky’obuwa kyajjira abantu bonna eri obutuukirivu obw’obulamu.” Okukoma “abantu bonna” abasembayo kwe kukoma n’abasooka. Obulokozi bwenkanankana ddala n’okugwa. Wagenda kubaawo “okuzzibwawo kw’ebintu byonna” okusembayo, nga “mu linnya lya Yesu buli vviivi ligwa — eby’omu ggulu, n’eby’oku nsi, n’eby’omu ttaka wansi — era buli lulimi lwatula nti Yesu Kristo ye Mukama, olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda Kitaawe.” Buli vviivi, buli lulimi — tewaali kya kubuuka kirala kyandibadde ekizingiramu byonna okusingawo. Engeri n’ekiseera saabiraba. Naye amazima ag’omugaso ge gaali gonna bye nnayagala: mu kifo kimu, mu ngeri emu, Katonda yali agenda kutereeza buli kimu eri ebitonde byonna bye yatonda. Omutima gwange gwawummulira mu kino emirembe gyonna. Nayanguwa okudda eka nga njayaanira okutuuka ku Bayibuli yange, okulaba oba amazima gano ag’ekitalo ge nnali nzudde gaali gayinza okuba nga gaaliwo bulijjo nga sigatageze. Amangu ddala bwe nnayingira mu nnyumba, saggyeeko na nkuufiira yange, wabula nadduka eri emmeeza Bayibuli yange ne Concordance we byabeeranga bulijjo nga biteekeddwa. Natandika okunoonya — era amangwago Ekitabo kyonna kyandabikira nga kimasamasa. Ku buli lupapula amazima agakwata ku “biseera eby’okuzzibwawo kw’ebintu byonna,” Omutume Peetero g’ayogerako nti “Katonda kye yayogerera mu kamwa ka bannabbi be abatukuvu bonna okuva ensi lwe yatondebwa,” gaamasamasa, nga tegaleka bbanga lya kubuusabuusa. Nakyusa n’obwesunge okuva ku lupapula okudda ku lulala, nga nseka waggulu olw’essanyu olw’ekitangaala ekyakijjuza. Ne kifuuka kitabo kiggya. Kyali ng’eriba eddala liggiddwako ku buli kyawandiikibwa, era buli lunyiriri lwamasamasa n’amakulu amaggya — si makulu ga njawulo, kubanga amaggya tegaawakanya makadde, wabula amakulu ag’obuziba, amakulu ag’amazima agaali gakwekeddwa mu nzikiriza ey’ebweru ey’ebigambo. Tewaali kya mu byawandiikibwa kyeetaaga kukyusibwa; okutegeera kwange kwokka kwe kwali kwetaaga okuggulwawo. Era kaakano, ku nkomerero, kwaggulwawo. Nzijukira nga tewannayita bbanga, mu kusoma kwange Bayibuli okwa buli lunaku, ne ntuuka ku Zabbuli ne nneewuunya ekitangaala ekiggya ekyateekebwa ku kunenya kwazo okusinga obukambwe — okwafaanana n’okwegomba omusaayi. Nnalaba nti, bwe zisomebwa mu mwoyo so si mu nnukuta, zaali zijjudde obuwanguzi obw’ekirungi ku kibi obwasuubizibwa era obusembayo, era zaali kulwanirira kwa kitalo okw’obulungi n’obwenkanya bwa Katonda, atalirwummula — era atasaanira, era atasobola — okutuusa abalabe be bonna, n’abaffe, nga bateekeddwa wansi w’ebigere bye. Nnalaba nti obwakabaka bwe buteekwa okuba obw’omunda nga tebunnaba kuba bwa kungulu; nti bwakabaka bwa ndowooza, so si bwa maanyi ga nkambwe; nti okufuga kwe kuli ku mitima, so si ku bitundu by’ensi; nti obuwanguzi bwe buteekwa okubaawo munda nga tebunnabikkulwa bweru. Anoonya kufuga myoyo okusinga mibiri. Tewaali buwanguzi bwandimukkusizza okuggyako obuwanguzi obuwangula omutima — okwewaayo kw’emmeeme ey’eddembe era ekakasibbwa, so si kwewaayo kwokka kw’omuddu awanguddwa. Nga Milton bw’agamba, “Awangula n’amaanyi awangudde kitundu kyokka ky’omulabe we,” era nnalaba nti kino kyali kya mazima. Bwe gasomebwa mu kitangaala kino, ebigambo byennyini ebyali binjijuzza entiisa kaakano byasanyusa emmeeme yange n’ettendo: “Katonda agolokoke, abalabe be basaasaane; n’abo abamukyawa badduke mu maaso ge. Ng’omukka bwe guggibwawo, bw’otyo obagobe; ng’ebisenge bwe bisaanuuka mu maaso g’omuliro, bw’atyo ababi bazikiririre mu maaso ga Katonda.” Obusungu bwa Katonda bulwanyisa ekibi, so si omwonoonyi; era abalabe be bwe basaasaanyizibwa, ababaffe basaasaanyizibwa nabo. Ekitala kye bwe butuukirivu, ekitta ekibi omwonoonyi alyoke abe omulamu. Omuliro ogw’obusungu bwe gwe muliro ogw’omuweesi alongoosa; tatuula ng’omuzikiriza w’emmeeme wabula ng’omulongoosa waayo, okugitukuza nga zaabu ne ffeeza bwe zitukuzibwa. “Okwagala tekukkakkana. Abalabe bayinza okugulwa oba okusendebwasendebwa Okubaggya ku kigendererwa kyabwe ekibi; Naye agenda nga takkakkanyiziddwa Oyo eyeemalidde ku kisa.” Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli agamba nti, “Wali Katonda eyabasonyiwa, newakubadde nga wawalana eggwanga ku bikolwa byabwe”; era n’ekisumuluzo kino mu ngalo, okunenya kwonna okw’obusungu bwa Katonda — okwali edda nga kwa bukambwe era nga tekwa bwenkanya eri amatu gange — kwafuulibwa ebirango eby’obumalirivu bwe obw’okwagala okutufuula abalungi abasaanira okubeera naye mu Ggulu emirembe gyonna. Nnandisobodde okwongera ebyokulabirako awatali kkomo eby’ekitangaala kino ekiggya ekyamasamasa mu bulungi obusikiriza ku buli lupapula lw’Ebyawandiikibwa, naye bino bimala. Ku nkomerero natandika okutegeera Omutume Pawulo kye yali ategeeza bwe yagamba nti yafuulibwa omuweereza w’endagaano empya, “si ya nnukuta, naye ya mwoyo; kubanga ennukuta etta, naye omwoyo guwa obulamu.” Ebintu bye nnali nsomye edda mu nnukuta ne bikankana, kaakano — nga mbisoma mu mwoyo — byanjijuza essanyu

fields.title: Obuteefaako bwa Katonda
fields.body_html:
Bulijjo nnawuliranga nti kino kye kiseera lwe nazuula ddala obuteefaako bwa Katonda.

Okutuusa mu kiseera ekyo, wadde nga nnasanyukira obulokozi bwe nnali mfunye, nnali nkyabonaabona olw'okubuusabuusa okwekusifu era okunnuma, nti ku nkomerero, bwali bulokozi obw'okwefaako — eri Katonda n'eri nze.

Katonda omulungi ayinza atya okwesanyusa mu ggulu ng'amanyi nti ekitundu ekinene eky'ebitonde bye ye yennyini bye yatonda byali biweereddwa okubonaabona okutaggwaawo — okuggyako nga, mu ngeri emu, yali Katonda omwefaako? Nnamanya nti Baibuli yagamba nti yali Katonda ow'okwagala, era nnalowooza nti kirina okuba nga kya mazima. Naye mu buziba bw'omutima gwange mwasigalamu okuwulira okwekusifu nti okwagala kwe tekwandiyinzizza kugeraageranyizibwa n'okwagala okutuukiridde kwe nnawuliranga mu mutima gwange.

Nnamanya nti, wadde ng'okwagala kwange kwali tekutuukiridde, sandisobodde kusanyukira ggulu ng'omwana wange n'omu — ka abe nga ajeemu atya — asibiddwa ebweru. N'endowooza nti Katonda yandisobodde, era ddala yasanyukira, eggulu nga enkumi n'enkumi ez'abaana be zisibiddwa ebweru, kyalabika ng'ekiraga obulemu mu kitundu ekisinga obukulu eky'okwagala. Kale, wadde nga nnali neebaza olw'okusonyiyibwa n'essuubi ery'amazima ery'eggulu eri nze, emirundi mingi nnawuliranga nti Katonda gwe nnasinza ateekwa okuba Katonda omwefaako, afaayo ku kwewummuza kwe n'ekitiibwa kye okusinga ku bitonde ebibonaabona bye yatonda.

Naye kaakano nnatandika okulaba nti obugazi bw'okwagala kwa Katonda bwali busukkiridde ennyo kyonna kye nnali nnaddiŋŋanyizza. Singa nkuŋŋaanyizza okwagala kwonna okuteefaako okuli mu mutima gwa buli maama mu nsi yonna, ne nkukubisaamu obukadde, ne nkunyigiriza mu kifo kimu, nandibadde nkyalina ekisiikirize ekitangaavu eky'obuteefaako bwa Katonda kyokka.

Bulijjo nnamulowoozaako ng'ayagala. Naye kaakano nnazuula ekintu ekikkakkanya ennyo: teyalina kwagala kwokka — ye yennyini yali kwagala, okwagala okwafuuse ekitundu kye era okwalukibwa mu buzaaliranwa bwe obwennyini.

Nnalaba nti Katonda yali, ng'oyinza okugamba, akolebwa mu kwagala, ne kiba nti mu butonde bw'ebintu byennyini teyayinza kukola kintu kikontana n'okwagala. Si nti yalonda obutakikola — wabula teyasobola, kubanga okwagala kwe kwali ntobo ennyini ey'obuzaaliranwa bwe. Etteeka ery'okwagala, ng'etteeka ery'okusika kw'ensi, terisobola kwewalibwa mu nkola yaalyo.

Katonda, oba nsobola okukyogera, ali wansi w'etteeka lino era tasobola butaligondera. Era bwe nnamala okutegeera kino, okwesiga Katonda ow'okwagala ne kufuuka kya buzaaliranwa nga bwe kiri okussa omukka. Buli kubuusabuusa ne kubula, ne njjula essanyu eritakoma olw'endowooza nti nnatondebwa Katonda omuteefaako bw'atyo.

Nnalaba nti omulimu gwe ng'Omutonzi gwali, mu bwagwo, kakalu atakyukakyuka nti yand'itufaako era n'akozesa ebintu byonna okukolera awamu olw'obulungi bwaffe. Ebivunaanyizibwa eby'okuba nannyini kintu ne byaka n'obulungerevu obumalamu omukka. Si buyinza obw'okuba nannyini kintu — nga bwe nnalowoozanga bulijjo — wabula emirimu gyabwo, ebivunaanyizibwa nannyini kintu by'aweebwa.

Nga bwe kiri, mu bantu abagunjufu, nti abantu bavunaanyizibwa — endowooza y'abantu bonna oba n'amateeka — okulabirira obulungi ebintu bye balina, bwe kityo Omutonzi waffe asibiddwa awatali kya bujja, olw'etteeka ery'empisa ery'obuzaaliranwa bwe bwennyini, okulabirira obulungi ebitonde bye yatonda. Ateekwa okuvunaanyizibwa olw'obulamu bwaffe obulungi.

Byonna byali bya kitiibwa nnyo ne bifaananyizibwa ng'ekisukkiridde obulungi okuba nga kya mazima — nti mazima ddala twali ba Katonda omuteefaako bw'atyo. Emirundi mingi, okutegeera okuggya ku bulungi bwe bwe kwannyweza, nnaddiranga Baibuli yange, ne ngiggula ku bitundu ebyalangirira nti tuli babe, ne nteeka engalo zange ku nnyiriri, ne nzisoma waggulu okwekakasa nti ddala zagamba — awatali kusalako era awatali kukoma — nti mazima ddala ye yali Nannyini nze.

Ebigambo, “Jjukira Omutonzi wo,” amangwago ne bifuna endabika eyawukanako ddala. Bulijjo nnabirowoozaako ng'okulabula okwagenderezebwa okututiisa tukole obulungi. Kaakano ne byaka n'okubudaabudibwa — kakalu ak'essanyu nti byonna biteekwa okuba birungi eri ebitonde bya Omutonzi omuteefaako bw'atyo.

Nnalaba nti Katonda yali mulungi si mu ngeri ey'eddiini yokka, wabula mu makulu ag'ekigambo agasinga amazima era agasinga okukola. Era Omutonzi omulungi yali kya lwatu asibiddwa okukola byonna okugenda obulungi n'ebitonde bye. Ekituufu nti tewali kyakwekebwa mu maaso ge — ekyali kityisa ennyo — ne kifuuka amazima agasinga okubudaabudibwa mu bwengula bwonna, kubanga kyategeeza nti yamanya byonna ebitufaako era n'olw'ekyo yandisobodde okutukolera obulungi bwe.

Obumanyirivu bwange nga maama — edda ensibuko y'obutakkaanya n'enzikiriza yange ku Katonda — kaakano ne bujja mu ndagganya entuukirivu. Abaana bange babadde ssanyu ery'obulamu bwange. Sisobola kulowooza ssanyu lisinga obulungi okusinga ebiseera abaana bange lwe baabanga mu mikono gyange. Ebiseera ebyo byalabikanga nga bisemberera essanyu ery'eggulu okusinga ekintu kyonna ekirala ku nsi. Era ndowooza essanyu lino lyanjigiriza ku nneewulira za Katonda eri abaana be okusinga ekintu kyonna ekirala.

Obanga nze, omuntu eyeekomako ow'obusobozi obukoma, nnasobola okufuna essanyu bwe lityo mu baana bange, Katonda — ow'omutima ogutakoma — awulira atya ku babe? Ekisinga ku kutegeera kwange okw'okwagala kwa Katonda kwava mu bumanyirivu buno bwennyini. Saasobola kukkiriza nti Katonda yantonda n'obusobozi obw'okwagala okuteefaako n'okweweerayo obusingako bw'alina ye yennyini. Okuva lwe nnazuula omutima gwa maama ogwa Katonda, nziramu buli kubuusabuusa ku kwagala kwa Katonda nga ntunuulira butunuulizi omutima gwange nga ogwa maama.

Gye ndi, tekisoboka nti maama ow'amazima ayinza okuba omwefaako eri abaana be. Maama ateeka okwewummuza kwe n'obulungi bwe mu maaso g'abaana be, mu ndowooza yange, maama atali wa buzaaliranwa, eyalemererwa okuyita kwe okusinga obukulu. Era omuntu bw'atunuulira kye tuyita ebitonde eby'ewansi, n'ebisolo byennyini bitusomesa omulimu ogusingira ddala ogw'okweweerayo kwa maama. Engo enkazi eneekufa nga tennaaganya kabi kutuuka ku baana baayo. Erirumwa enjala abaana baayo balyoke balye. Katonda yandikoze ekisingako obutono?

Njogera ku kweweerayo, naye mu mazima siyinza kukuyita ssaddaaka. Tewali maama wa mazima — oyo amanyi ekituufu eky'obwa maama — ayinza okutwala okulabirira kwe abaana be nga ssaddaaka. Kuyinza okuba n'okukoowa oba okuzibuwalirwa, naye si ssaddaaka mu makulu aga bulijjo. Ssaddaaka ey'amazima yandibadde singa taganyizibwa kubalabirira.

Olw'ensonga eno, nzikiriza nti bamaama bangi abanyiiga — abatafuna kwebazibwa kwe baagala — balina kwennenyeza bokka, kubanga baalagira okwebazibwa mu kifo ky'okukukubiriza.

Okutegeera kuno kunnyolesezza enneewulira za Katonda gye tuli: nti kye tuyita “okweweerayo” kwa Kristo kwali kwoleka kwa buzaaliranwa era okwetaagisa okw'okwagala kwe; era nti ekyewuunyisa si nti yakikola, wabula nti teyandisobodde kukola bulala.

Okuva lwe nnazuula omutima gwa maama ogwa Katonda, sisobodde kuwulira wadde akatiisa akatono ku omu ku baana be — era abaana be, sitegeeza balungi bokka, wabula n'ababi mu ngeri y'emu. Yesu teyatugamba nti Omusumba Omulungi aleka endiga ekyenda mu mwenda ez'emirembe n'agenda okunoonya emu ebuze, era teyeewummula okutuusa lw'agiraba?

Bwe kitunuulirwa mu kitangaala eky'obwa maama, ekigambo “okubula” kifuuka eky'okubudaabudibwa ennyo. Tewali kiyinza “kubula” wabula nga kya muntu. Okuba nga wabuze kitegeeza kyokka nti, “tonnalabika.” Essente ebuze ekyali ya zaabu, eyambadde ekifaananyi kya kabaka. Endiga ebuze ekyali ndiga, si musege. Omwana omulenzi eyabula akyali mwana, ng'omusaayi gwa kitaawe guli mu misuwa gye.

Kale omuntu bw'aba “omwonoonyi eyabula,” kitegeeza kyokka nti wa Musumba Omulungi, era nti Omusumba, olw'emirimu gyennyini egy'okuba nannyini, ateekwa okugoberera ekyo ekyabula — era n'agenda mu maaso okutuusa lw'akiraba.

Gye ndi, ekigambo “okubula” kirimu obukakafu obusinga amaanyi obusoboka obw'okuba nannyini.

Ani ayinza okulowooza maama alina omwana eyabula ng'aba n'akaseera k'okuwummula kamu okutuusa omwana lw'alabika?

Era ani ayinza okulowooza nti Katonda afaayo obutono okusinga maama?

Nzikiriza nti ebizibu byonna eby'obulamu obw'omwoyo, ebitera okunakuwaza emmeeme ez'omwoyo omutuufu, byandibulidde ng'olufu olw'oku makya mu maaso g'enjuba eyaka singa okwaka okujjuvu okw'omutima gwa maama ogwa Katonda kwaganyizibwa okubyakako.

Nnajja okulaba nti, olw'okuba Ebyawandiikibwa bigamba nti twatondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda, tuwalirizibwa okukkiriza nti ekisinga obulungi mu ffe — si ekisinga obubi — kye kiraga ekifaananyi ekyo. Kyonna ekyo ekirabika ng'eky'okwefaako, ekitali kya kisa, ekitali kya bwenkanya, oba eky'okwenoonyeza mu biseera byaffe ebisingira ddala waggulu era ebisinga obuteefaako, tekisaana kuwaayo eri Katonda, ka byonna “bibe” bitya. Katonda bw'aba omuteefaako, kale ateekwa okuba omuteefaako obutasinga endowooza esingira ddala okuba ennungi gye tusobola okulowooza — era mazima okusingako awatali kukoma.

Ebiwandiiko byonna eby'omu Baibuli ebikwata ku bulungi bwa Katonda amangwago ne byaka n'amakulu amaggya. Nnategeera nti obulungi bwe si kisa kya kwetoowaza wabula bulungi obw'amazima, obw'omutima gwonna — obuli n'obuteefaako obw'amazima, okulowoozako okw'ekifuba, era okusinga byonna, obwenkanya. Obwenkanya bulijjo bunnabikira ng'ekimu ku bikulu ebisooka eby'obulungi; sisobola kulowooza kuyita muntu yenna “mulungi” atali wa bwenkanya, ka endabika ye ey'ebweru ey'empisa ennungi ebe ng'esikiriza etya. Mu bufunze, nnalina okubikkulirwa okwannyweza ennyo okw'obulungi bwa Katonda obwomunda era obw'obuzaaliranwa n'obuteefaako bwe ne kiba nti tewali kintu kyasobodde kukinyeenya kasookedde. Ebintu bingi eby'enkolagana ye n'ensi byabadde, era bikyali, bya kyama gye ndi; naye nkakasibwa nti buli kimu ku byo kyandinnyonnyoddwa nga ntunula mu ndabirwamu ey'okwagala kwe n'obwenkanya bwe, singa nsobola okulaba mu buziba obumala. Era nzikiriza nti olunaku olumu ndiraba bulungi kye nkwata kaakano mu kukkiriza: nti ekisa kye eky'okwagala mazima kituuka ku mirimu gye gyonna.

Sitegeeza nti okutegeera kuno kwonna kwanjijira mu kiseera kimu. Naye ntegeeza nti ku lunaku olwo, nga nvuga ttaamu mu Philadelphia, ekitangaala kyabalukuka ku mpisa za Katonda — ekitangaala ekitakendeeranga wadde katono era ekyeyongedde okwakaayakana buli mwaka nga guyita.

Gye ndi, kimala okugamba nti, “Katonda gyali,” era eky'okuddamu eri buli kizibu kiba kirimu dda. Ekinneewuunyisa kiri nti nze, wamu n'Abakristaayo abalala bangi, twali twalemererwa okulaba kino, wadde nga Baibuli eyanjuluddwa eri mu maaso gaffe — era nti engeri ez'enjawulo ez'okwonoona empisa za Katonda, ne n'okuwaayiriza okw'olwatu okulwanyisa obulungi bwe, biyinza okusanyusibwa mu mitima gy'Abakristaayo. Gye ndi, okukyusakyusa kwabyo ne kufuuka okumpi n'okutasoboka kugumiikiriza. Nnasobola okuwuliriza n'obugumiikiriza — ne n'okwagala — endowooza yonna ey'enjawulo oba etakkiriziganya n'enjigiriza etaali eyonoona mpisa za Katonda. Naye ekintu kimu kye ssaasobola kugumiikiriza, ekintu kimu kye ssaasobola kutuulira mu kasirise, kyali kyonna ekintu — ne wansi w'olugoye olw'okutya Katonda — ekyalaga akavume akasinga obutono eri okwagala kwa Katonda oba obuteefaako bwe.

Sirijjerabira ekintu ekijjukirwa mu maka gaffe omubuulizi ow'ekitiibwa okuva e Boston bwe yatukyalira. Ku kyeenkya, emboozi ne yeekyusa okudda ku kwagala kwa Katonda. Yakakata nti tekisaana kukwesiga nnyo, kubanga waaliwo ensalo ku ekyo Katonda kye yandigumiikirizza — nga bwe, yagamba, waaliwo ensalo ku kwagala kwa maama. Yagamba nti muwala ayinza okukola ebibi ebimu maama by'atayinza kusonyiwa, ebibi ebyandiggaddewo omutima gwe n'amaka ge emirembe gyonna, era yawakana nti Katonda yali bw'atyo. Okukkiriza obulala, yagamba, kwali kukwata “eddiini ya jjajja omukazi.”

Sirina kubuusabuusa nti yali agenderera okunafuya endowooza yange ku Kuzzaawo, wadde nga twali tetukubaganya birowoozo ku nsonga eyo. Yali ayagala kunkakasa nti Katonda teyali “muyagazi mu bulaluusi” nga bwe nnakkiririzaamu. Naye okuwulira nga bamaama, ne Katonda eyatonda bamaama, bakyusiddwakyusiddwa bwe batyo kyali kisukka ku kye nnayinza okugumiikiriza. Wadde nga yali mugenyi wange, nnabwatuka mu busungu obungi, ne ŋŋamba nti sandituulidde ku mmeeza n'omuntu yenna alina endowooza ez'okuvvoola bwe zityo ku Katonda, ne mfuluma mu kisenge nga nkaaba. Nnagaana okumulaba nate. Sigamba nti okuddamu kuno kwali kwa mpisa oba nkola nga Kristo, naye kiraga engeri gye nnawuliramu ennyo ku nsonga eyo. Gye ndi, ekitiibwa kya Katonda kyasukka amateeka gonna ag'empisa ez'abantu.

Kaakano ndaba nti nnandisobodde okulwanirira ekitiibwa ekyo n'amaanyi gaag'ago, naye mu ngeri esingira ddala okuba nga Kristo. Naye ne kaakano, ekintu kimu kye nsanga nga kizibu nnyo okugumiikiriza kyonna ekyonoona empisa za Katonda. Tewali kirala kigeraageranyizibwa na kino mu bukulu, kubanga obulokozi bwaffe bwonna bwesigamye ddala ku Katonda gwali. Okuggyako ng'ayinza okulagibwa okuba omulungi ddala, omuteefaako ddala, era ow'obwenkanya ddala, kale ensonga yaffe teriiko ssuubi n'akatono. Katonda yekka bwe bulokozi bwaffe, era bw'atulemererwa — ne mu ngeri esinga obutono — tetulina wandala we tuyinza okukyukira.
fields.body_text: Bulijjo nnawuliranga nti kino kye kiseera lwe nazuula ddala obuteefaako bwa Katonda. Okutuusa mu kiseera ekyo, wadde nga nnasanyukira obulokozi bwe nnali mfunye, nnali nkyabonaabona olw'okubuusabuusa okwekusifu era okunnuma, nti ku nkomerero, bwali bulokozi obw'okwefaako — eri Katonda n'eri nze. Katonda omulungi ayinza atya okwesanyusa mu ggulu ng'amanyi nti ekitundu ekinene eky'ebitonde bye ye yennyini bye yatonda byali biweereddwa okubonaabona okutaggwaawo — okuggyako nga, mu ngeri emu, yali Katonda omwefaako? Nnamanya nti Baibuli yagamba nti yali Katonda ow'okwagala, era nnalowooza nti kirina okuba nga kya mazima. Naye mu buziba bw'omutima gwange mwasigalamu okuwulira okwekusifu nti okwagala kwe tekwandiyinzizza kugeraageranyizibwa n'okwagala okutuukiridde kwe nnawuliranga mu mutima gwange. Nnamanya nti, wadde ng'okwagala kwange kwali tekutuukiridde, sandisobodde kusanyukira ggulu ng'omwana wange n'omu — ka abe nga ajeemu atya — asibiddwa ebweru. N'endowooza nti Katonda yandisobodde, era ddala yasanyukira, eggulu nga enkumi n'enkumi ez'abaana be zisibiddwa ebweru, kyalabika ng'ekiraga obulemu mu kitundu ekisinga obukulu eky'okwagala. Kale, wadde nga nnali neebaza olw'okusonyiyibwa n'essuubi ery'amazima ery'eggulu eri nze, emirundi mingi nnawuliranga nti Katonda gwe nnasinza ateekwa okuba Katonda omwefaako, afaayo ku kwewummuza kwe n'ekitiibwa kye okusinga ku bitonde ebibonaabona bye yatonda. Naye kaakano nnatandika okulaba nti obugazi bw'okwagala kwa Katonda bwali busukkiridde ennyo kyonna kye nnali nnaddiŋŋanyizza. Singa nkuŋŋaanyizza okwagala kwonna okuteefaako okuli mu mutima gwa buli maama mu nsi yonna, ne nkukubisaamu obukadde, ne nkunyigiriza mu kifo kimu, nandibadde nkyalina ekisiikirize ekitangaavu eky'obuteefaako bwa Katonda kyokka. Bulijjo nnamulowoozaako ng'ayagala. Naye kaakano nnazuula ekintu ekikkakkanya ennyo: teyalina kwagala kwokka — ye yennyini yali kwagala, okwagala okwafuuse ekitundu kye era okwalukibwa mu buzaaliranwa bwe obwennyini. Nnalaba nti Katonda yali, ng'oyinza okugamba, akolebwa mu kwagala, ne kiba nti mu butonde bw'ebintu byennyini teyayinza kukola kintu kikontana n'okwagala. Si nti yalonda obutakikola — wabula teyasobola, kubanga okwagala kwe kwali ntobo ennyini ey'obuzaaliranwa bwe. Etteeka ery'okwagala, ng'etteeka ery'okusika kw'ensi, terisobola kwewalibwa mu nkola yaalyo. Katonda, oba nsobola okukyogera, ali wansi w'etteeka lino era tasobola butaligondera. Era bwe nnamala okutegeera kino, okwesiga Katonda ow'okwagala ne kufuuka kya buzaaliranwa nga bwe kiri okussa omukka. Buli kubuusabuusa ne kubula, ne njjula essanyu eritakoma olw'endowooza nti nnatondebwa Katonda omuteefaako bw'atyo. Nnalaba nti omulimu gwe ng'Omutonzi gwali, mu bwagwo, kakalu atakyukakyuka nti yand'itufaako era n'akozesa ebintu byonna okukolera awamu olw'obulungi bwaffe. Ebivunaanyizibwa eby'okuba nannyini kintu ne byaka n'obulungerevu obumalamu omukka. Si buyinza obw'okuba nannyini kintu — nga bwe nnalowoozanga bulijjo — wabula emirimu gyabwo, ebivunaanyizibwa nannyini kintu by'aweebwa. Nga bwe kiri, mu bantu abagunjufu, nti abantu bavunaanyizibwa — endowooza y'abantu bonna oba n'amateeka — okulabirira obulungi ebintu bye balina, bwe kityo Omutonzi waffe asibiddwa awatali kya bujja, olw'etteeka ery'empisa ery'obuzaaliranwa bwe bwennyini, okulabirira obulungi ebitonde bye yatonda. Ateekwa okuvunaanyizibwa olw'obulamu bwaffe obulungi. Byonna byali bya kitiibwa nnyo ne bifaananyizibwa ng'ekisukkiridde obulungi okuba nga kya mazima — nti mazima ddala twali ba Katonda omuteefaako bw'atyo. Emirundi mingi, okutegeera okuggya ku bulungi bwe bwe kwannyweza, nnaddiranga Baibuli yange, ne ngiggula ku bitundu ebyalangirira nti tuli babe, ne nteeka engalo zange ku nnyiriri, ne nzisoma waggulu okwekakasa nti ddala zagamba — awatali kusalako era awatali kukoma — nti mazima ddala ye yali Nannyini nze. Ebigambo, “Jjukira Omutonzi wo,” amangwago ne bifuna endabika eyawukanako ddala. Bulijjo nnabirowoozaako ng'okulabula okwagenderezebwa okututiisa tukole obulungi. Kaakano ne byaka n'okubudaabudibwa — kakalu ak'essanyu nti byonna biteekwa okuba birungi eri ebitonde bya Omutonzi omuteefaako bw'atyo. Nnalaba nti Katonda yali mulungi si mu ngeri ey'eddiini yokka, wabula mu makulu ag'ekigambo agasinga amazima era agasinga okukola. Era Omutonzi omulungi yali kya lwatu asibiddwa okukola byonna okugenda obulungi n'ebitonde bye. Ekituufu nti tewali kyakwekebwa mu maaso ge — ekyali kityisa ennyo — ne kifuuka amazima agasinga okubudaabudibwa mu bwengula bwonna, kubanga kyategeeza nti yamanya byonna ebitufaako era n'olw'ekyo yandisobodde okutukolera obulungi bwe. Obumanyirivu bwange nga maama — edda ensibuko y'obutakkaanya n'enzikiriza yange ku Katonda — kaakano ne bujja mu ndagganya entuukirivu. Abaana bange babadde ssanyu ery'obulamu bwange. Sisobola kulowooza ssanyu lisinga obulungi okusinga ebiseera abaana bange lwe baabanga mu mikono gyange. Ebiseera ebyo byalabikanga nga bisemberera essanyu ery'eggulu okusinga ekintu kyonna ekirala ku nsi. Era ndowooza essanyu lino lyanjigiriza ku nneewulira za Katonda eri abaana be okusinga ekintu kyonna ekirala. Obanga nze, omuntu eyeekomako ow'obusobozi obukoma, nnasobola okufuna essanyu bwe lityo mu baana bange, Katonda — ow'omutima ogutakoma — awulira atya ku babe? Ekisinga ku kutegeera kwange okw'okwagala kwa Katonda kwava mu bumanyirivu buno bwennyini. Saasobola kukkiriza nti Katonda yantonda n'obusobozi obw'okwagala okuteefaako n'okweweerayo obusingako bw'alina ye yennyini. Okuva lwe nnazuula omutima gwa maama ogwa Katonda, nziramu buli kubuusabuusa ku kwagala kwa Katonda nga ntunuulira butunuulizi omutima gwange nga ogwa maama. Gye ndi, tekisoboka nti maama ow'amazima ayinza okuba omwefaako eri abaana be. Maama ateeka okwewummuza kwe n'obulungi bwe mu maaso g'abaana be, mu ndowooza yange, maama atali wa buzaaliranwa, eyalemererwa okuyita kwe okusinga obukulu. Era omuntu bw'atunuulira kye tuyita ebitonde eby'ewansi, n'ebisolo byennyini bitusomesa omulimu ogusingira ddala ogw'okweweerayo kwa maama. Engo enkazi eneekufa nga tennaaganya kabi kutuuka ku baana baayo. Erirumwa enjala abaana baayo balyoke balye. Katonda yandikoze ekisingako obutono? Njogera ku kweweerayo, naye mu mazima siyinza kukuyita ssaddaaka. Tewali maama wa mazima — oyo amanyi ekituufu eky'obwa maama — ayinza okutwala okulabirira kwe abaana be nga ssaddaaka. Kuyinza okuba n'okukoowa oba okuzibuwalirwa, naye si ssaddaaka mu makulu aga bulijjo. Ssaddaaka ey'amazima yandibadde singa taganyizibwa kubalabirira. Olw'ensonga eno, nzikiriza nti bamaama bangi abanyiiga — abatafuna kwebazibwa kwe baagala — balina kwennenyeza bokka, kubanga baalagira okwebazibwa mu kifo ky'okukukubiriza. Okutegeera kuno kunnyolesezza enneewulira za Katonda gye tuli: nti kye tuyita “okweweerayo” kwa Kristo kwali kwoleka kwa buzaaliranwa era okwetaagisa okw'okwagala kwe; era nti ekyewuunyisa si nti yakikola, wabula nti teyandisobodde kukola bulala. Okuva lwe nnazuula omutima gwa maama ogwa Katonda, sisobodde kuwulira wadde akatiisa akatono ku omu ku baana be — era abaana be, sitegeeza balungi bokka, wabula n'ababi mu ngeri y'emu. Yesu teyatugamba nti Omusumba Omulungi aleka endiga ekyenda mu mwenda ez'emirembe n'agenda okunoonya emu ebuze, era teyeewummula okutuusa lw'agiraba? Bwe kitunuulirwa mu kitangaala eky'obwa maama, ekigambo “okubula” kifuuka eky'okubudaabudibwa ennyo. Tewali kiyinza “kubula” wabula nga kya muntu. Okuba nga wabuze kitegeeza kyokka nti, “tonnalabika.” Essente ebuze ekyali ya zaabu, eyambadde ekifaananyi kya kabaka. Endiga ebuze ekyali ndiga, si musege. Omwana omulenzi eyabula akyali mwana, ng'omusaayi gwa kitaawe guli mu misuwa gye. Kale omuntu bw'aba “omwonoonyi eyabula,” kitegeeza kyokka nti wa Musumba Omulungi, era nti Omusumba, olw'emirimu gyennyini egy'okuba nannyini, ateekwa okugoberera ekyo ekyabula — era n'agenda mu maaso okutuusa lw'akiraba. Gye ndi, ekigambo “okubula” kirimu obukakafu obusinga amaanyi obusoboka obw'okuba nannyini. Ani ayinza okulowooza maama alina omwana eyabula ng'aba n'akaseera k'okuwummula kamu okutuusa omwana lw'alabika? Era ani ayinza okulowooza nti Katonda afaayo obutono okusinga maama? Nzikiriza nti ebizibu byonna eby'obulamu obw'omwoyo, ebitera okunakuwaza emmeeme ez'omwoyo omutuufu, byandibulidde ng'olufu olw'oku makya mu maaso g'enjuba eyaka singa okwaka okujjuvu okw'omutima gwa maama ogwa Katonda kwaganyizibwa okubyakako. Nnajja okulaba nti, olw'okuba Ebyawandiikibwa bigamba nti twatondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda, tuwalirizibwa okukkiriza nti ekisinga obulungi mu ffe — si ekisinga obubi — kye kiraga ekifaananyi ekyo. Kyonna ekyo ekirabika ng'eky'okwefaako, ekitali kya kisa, ekitali kya bwenkanya, oba eky'okwenoonyeza mu biseera byaffe ebisingira ddala waggulu era ebisinga obuteefaako, tekisaana kuwaayo eri Katonda, ka byonna “bibe” bitya. Katonda bw'aba omuteefaako, kale ateekwa okuba omuteefaako obutasinga endowooza esingira ddala okuba ennungi gye tusobola okulowooza — era mazima okusingako awatali kukoma. fields.title: Engeri Endowooza Zange gye Zaakwatako ku Mulimu Gwange ogw'Olukale
fields.body_html:
Nga bwe kyandisuubirwa mu nnaku ezo, endowooza yange ku Kuzzaawo — endowooza gye nnalangirira mangu ddala — yasisinkana okutakkirizibwa okunene okuva ku Plymouth Brethren n'ab'emikwano gyange abalala bangi abakkiriza enzikiriza entuufu. Nnalina okugumiikiriza ekigero ekituufu eky'ekyo ekiyinza okuyitibwa okuyigganyizibwa, wadde nga mu mazima nnafunamu obumativu obumu, kubanga nnawulira nti kyali kikulu okumanya Katonda ennyo obusingako abo abaali bampakanya.

Emirundi mingi nnageraageranyanga enneewulira zange n'ez'omutambuze omugunjufu agezaako okunnyonnyola eby'ekitalo eby'ensi ye eri abantu ab'omu nsi ey'ewala, “enkambwe” — abantu abatasobola kutegeera oba okukkiriza kye yali annyonnyola. Okuwulira kwe okw'okumanya okusingako kwandifudde obutakkiriza bwabwe n'obuwakanyi bwabwe nsonga yokka ey'okusaasira obutamanya bwabwe n'okubugumiikiriza n'obukwatampola. Ku musingi gwe gumu ogwo, kaabula katono okusanyukira okutwalibwa ng'omuwaŋŋanguse mu nzikiriza, era saayagalanga kusiimibwa muntu yenna. Okusiimibwa kyawulikika, gye ndi, ng'okusibibwa; era nnasinga okwagala okuba omuweereza ow'eddembe, ataziyiziddwa mu ddembe lyange ery'ebirowoozo n'ery'omwoyo eritakoma.

Mu kiseera ekyo okuzuula kwe nnali nkoze tekwali kumanyiddwa nnyo nga bwe kuli kaakano, era kyalabika ng'ekisoboka nti okukwata ku ekyo abantu bangi kye baalowooza ng'okuwaŋŋanguka okunene kuyinza okuziyiza omulimu gwange ogwa Kikristaayo. Era oboolyawo kyakola bwe kityo mu bitundu ebimu. Naye olwokubanga bulijjo nnalina okuyitibwa okwogera okusinga obungi kwe nnayinza okukkiriza, tewaaliwo kizibu kyonna kye nnabonaabonamu ddala. Nnagezaako okuba ow'empisa okumala obutateeka ku balala — naddala abo abaayita endowooza yange ng'ekyenyinyalwa — omugugu ogw'okunsiima. Wabula okubikkulirwa kwe nnali nfunye kwali kwa kitiibwa nnyo okukukweka buli mulyango bwe gwaggulwanga. Era olwokubanga nnagaana okuvuga wansi w'ebbendera ey'obulimba, era ne nkakata nti buli kifo we nnaayogeranga kirina okumanya olubereberye kaakati ndi “muwaŋŋanguse” atya, awo nga bulijjo nnasanyukira eddembe lyonna lye nnaayagala.

Mu butuufu, endowooza zino zennyini — n'okuziyatula kwange olwatu mu mbeera enzibu ddala — kye kyaggulawo ekkubo eri ogumu ku mirimu gyaffe egisinga obukulu era egyabala ebibala. Kyaliwo bwe kiti.

Mu 1873, baze wange bajja mu Bungereza okukuba enkuŋŋaana ku nsonga ez'Obulamu Obwawaggulu, oba kye nsinga okwagala okuyita Obulamu obw'Okukkiriza. Nnabaddirira mangu, era bwe nnatuuka mu London, nnayitibwa okusisinkana ekibiina ky'abakyala abakulembeze mu by'Enjiri abaali baakusalawo obanga kyandibadde kya bukuumi gye bali okumpagira n'okuwaayo obuyinza bwabwe eri omulimu.

Lady Mount Temple, omu ku bakyala abaaliwo, oluvannyuma yannyonnyola olukuŋŋaana olwo mu kitabo kye eky'obulamu bwa Lord Mount Temple: “Ndowooza kyali mu 1873 nga Mr. Pearsall Smith bwe yajja mu Bungereza okuva mu Amerika, n'addirirwa emyezi mitono oluvannyuma mukyala we omwagalwa era omulungi. Kyali kiseera eky'okujjukirwa ebbanga eddene. Bajja, oyinza okugamba, nga bajjudde omwenge omuggya ogw'Omwoyo, nga baagala okuyamba abalala okugenda mu maaso mu bulamu obwa Katonda. Mukwano gwaffe yatuyita ku kya mu ttuntu okusisinkana bo. Sirijjerabira lwe nnasooka okulaba Hannah Smith. Twamuyita 'malayika w'Ekkanisa,' era yafaanana ng'omu ku bo, n'enviiri ze eza zaabu n'amaaso amayonjo, amaaso amasale obulungi, mu kyambalo kye ekyennyini, wabula ekyangu nga eky'Abamikwano gye yakuzibwa.

“Ekyansikiriza naddala gye yali ku lunaku olwo kye kino. Nteekwa okwatula nti nnali munoonyi wa mazima kyokka. Hannah yali atudde mu kabiina akatono ak'ab'emikwano abalungi ennyo abakkiriza enzikiriza entuufu, abaakuŋŋaana okuwulira ebintu ebirungi bye yalina okugabana, era mu butuufu, yali awoozesebwa. Yali alabye olujjulungu lw'okuziika mu luguudo, era bwe yakyogerako, ffenna ne tukozesa enneeyisa eya bulijjo ey'ennaku.

'Ayi,' yagamba, 'bwe ndaba okuziika bulijjo neebaza olw'owooluganda oba mwannyinaze eyawonyeddwa okuva mu bikemo n'obulumi obw'embeera eno ey'okufa.' Nnalowooza nti, Nga kya kitalo! Era saasobola butabuuza nti, 'Ekyo kisoboka? Owulira bw'otyo ku buli muntu?' Mazima nnali mwana wa kabi.

“Yasirika akaseera n'atunuulira enjuuyi zonna. Yali mu bantu ab'Enjiri, mu kiseera essuubi ery'abantu bonna lwe lyatwalibwa ng'okuwaŋŋanguka, era kuno kwe kwali okwoozesebwa kwe. Oluvannyuma yagamba nti yafuna okulwanagana okumu okw'omunda okw'akaseera. Naye amazima ne gawangula, era n'endabika ye eyaka etatya yagamba, 'Yee — ku buli muntu. Kubanga nneesiga okwagala kwa Katonda.' Nnawaayo omutima gwange amangwago eri okwesiga kuno, okwagala, n'obwesimbu.”

Nzijjukira omukolo ogwo bulungi ddala, n'ebirowoozo ebyali bikulukuta mu birowoozo byange. Nnamanya nti nnali ngezesebwa, era nnateebereza nti okuddamu kwange kuyinza okwewuunyisa ekibiina kyonna. Naye nnawulira nti obwesigwa eri Katonda bwannetaagisa okwogera ekyamugulumiza, n'okuleka ebivaamu mu mikono gye.

Amangwago lwe nnamaliriza okwogera, Lady Mount Temple — mu kiseera ekyo eyayitibwanga Mrs. Cowper Temple — yasituka okuva mu ntebe ye, n'ajja butereevu gye ndi, era, wadde nga nnali mugwira, n'annywegera okunywegera okw'okwagala okw'ekibubi.

“Oteekwa okujja okukuba enkuŋŋaana ezimu e Broadlands,” yagamba amangwago. Simanyi abalala kye baawulira, naye tewaali kigambo na kimu eky'obutakkiriza ekyayogerwa, era oluvannyuma ne bafuuka ab'emikwano bange abasinga okwagalwa.

Ekyavaamu kwe kuba nti, mu wiiki ntono, Broadlands — ennyumba y'ekyalo eya Lord ne Lady Mount Temple mu Hampshire — yatuggulirwawo olw'olukuŋŋaana lwaffe olusooka. Kyali kiseera ky'omukisa ogw'ekitalo, era ne kifuuka omulyango eri enkuŋŋaana zonna ez'oluvannyuma n'eri omulimu gwaffe gwonna ogwaddirira mu Bungereza n'okusukka.

Olukuŋŋaana bwe lwateekebwateekebwa e Brighton mu 1874, abamu ku bakuŋŋaana mu kakiiko akaali kalitegeka ne beeraliikirira “okuwaŋŋanguka” kwange, nga batya nti kuyinza okuziyiza omulimu. Ne bakubiriza baze wange — eyali atuuse mu Bungereza nga nze sinnatuuka — okumpandiikira mu Amerika n'okuntegeeza nti okuggyako nga nsuubiza okusirisa endowooza yange, bandiwakanyizza nnyo okwetaba kwange mu nkuŋŋaana. Nga bunakyawakyaya, nga nnyoola mu kinywa ky'ebbaluwa enkadde, nnazuula okuddamu kwange, okwoleka bulungi ddala engeri gye nnawuliramu mu kiseera ekyo: “Philadelphia, Apuli 6, 1874.

Ebbaluwa zo okuva e London zituuse. Tosaana kulowooza nti nnandinakuwadde olw'obutaganyibwa kwogera mu nkuŋŋaana, kubanga tewali kirala kyandinsanyusizza okusingawo. Sindiiko kwagala kubuulira n'akatono. Mazima, nkitwala ng'ekisa kinene ku lwange okuba omwetegefu okukikola n'akatono, era ng'ekisa kya kifaanana ku lw'abalala okumpuliriza. Singa akakiiko kammwe kagamba nti, 'Tetwagala kukuwulira ng'oyogera e Brighton,' nandibeebazizza n'omutima gwonna. Tewali n'omu asaana kuwulira kizibu kyonna ku kino. Naye kiteekwa okutegeerekera ddala nti sijja kukola kya nkwenkweto olw'omuntu yenna, era nti nzikiririza mu Kuzzaawo obusingawo bwe nnali kasooka. Sirowooza nti nnandiyinzizza okugumiikiriza obulumi bwe ndaba mu nsi eno enaku, ey'ennaku, ekubiddwa ekibi, awatali kwo. Omulimu gwaffe ogw'okwegendereza mu kunywa gututuusa amaaso n'amaaso n'okubonaabona okutaliiko buyambi ne kiba nti omutima gwange gwandimenyese singa saamanyi nti Katonda ayagala ebitonde bye byonna era alina ekintu eky'ekisa ekitereke eri buli muntu.”

Olwokubanga saakola kya nkwenkweto — era olwokubanga kyakyali kitwalibwa nga kikulu okumba mu nkuŋŋaana — akakiiko ne kaleka ensonga eyo ne kasalawo okuntwala nga bwe nnali, obuwaŋŋanguse bwonna nga bwe buli.

Baze wange bwe yampandiikira okuntegeeza kino, nnaddamu nti: “Philadelphia.

Nsanyuse nnyo nti owonye ekizibu kyo ekikwata ku mukyala wo omuwaŋŋanguse abuulira n'obuzibu obutono bwe butyo. Naye endowooza eya B —, n'endowooza ze enjeejeema, okwetikka okunkuŋŋaanya! Sirowooza nti kya bwesimbu. Sijja kuvuga wansi w'ebbendera ey'obulimba, era obukakafu bwange ku Kuzzaawo bweyongera amaanyi buli lunaku. Bwe banreka nga siriiko ky'ekola mu Bungereza, oboolyawo nnaayogerako katono; naye bwe wanaabaawo n'akabonero akasinga obutono ak'enkwenkweto oba obwama ku lwange, nnaabwatuka ne mfuuka omuliro ogwaka ddala. Sisobola kugumiikiriza kintu kyonna eky'ekika ekyo. Kale mujjukire kino, mmwe Bakama b'Obutonde.

Mu bukakafu, wabula, sindiiko kusikirizibwa kubuulira oba kuyigiriza ku Kuzzaawo eyo, era ab'emikwano abakkiriza enzikiriza entuufu abaagalwa abatiitiira bwe bataleeta kalulu ku kyo, tekirabika nga nnaakikola. Okweraliikirira kwabwe ku lwange tekunnyiiza n'akatono. Nzikiriza nti mu butuufu nsanyukira okuba ekiruubirirwa eky'obukyayi obw'eby'okutya Katonda.

Ndowooza waliwo ekintu eky'embalaasi ey'olutalo mu buzaaliranwa bwange.”

Obanga entiisa y'akakiiko yali ya nsonga oba nedda, siyinza kugamba; kye mmanyi kyokka nti wadde omulundi gumu, mu mulimu gwange gwonna mu Bungereza, saawuliranga nti endowooza yange ku Kuzzaawo yaziyiza okwanirizibwa kw'obubaka bwange oba n'okuggalawo omulyango n'ogumu. Mu butuufu, nzikiriza nti gyaggulawo emiryango egyandisigadde nga miggale. Amazima agasingako obuziba gaali nti enzikiriza yange ey'omusingi mu bwenkanya n'okwagala kwa Katonda okutakoma ddala kwannyamba okwogera n'okukkiriza okuvumu okusingira ddala kwe nnandisobodde awatali kwo. Nkakasibwa nti awatali obukakafu buno nnandinyagiddwako ekitundu eky'amaanyi gange.

Ka abalala balowooze kyonna kye baagala, enkyukakyuka okuzuula kuno kwe kwaleeta mu bumanyirivu bwange yali nnene — esukka ebigambo. Okwagala okw'omwoyo okw'obulamu bwange kwafuuka okusikiriza okusingako.

Buli lunaku lwaleeta okutegeera okumu okusingako obuziba n'okwakaayakana ku bulungi n'obuteefaako bwa Katonda obutalowoozeka. Nnawulira ku nkomerero nti nnali ntandika okuyingira mu makulu ag'okusaba kw'Omutume ku lw'Abaefeso: nti tuyinze okutegeera, wamu n'abatukuvu bonna, obugazi n'obuwanvu n'obuziba n'obugulumivu bw'okwagala kwa Kristo, n'okumanya — ne bwe kyandibadde katono kwokka — okwagala okusukka okumanya.

Okwagala okwenkana awo mazima kusukka okumanya; kwandivudde mu mutima gwa Katonda omuteefaako ddala kyokka. Nnayimirira mu kutya mu maaso g'obugazi bwako n'obuwanvu n'obuziba n'obugulumivu, era ne nneewuunya — awatali kukoma — nti nnandisobodde okulowooza okwagala kwa Katonda okuliko ensalo.

Okumala ebbanga eddene essanyu lya byonna lyali lya kitalo nnyo ne ndowooza nti tewandibaddewo kirala kya kuzuula ku Katonda — nti nnali ntuuse ku kubikkulirwa okw'enkomerero.

Naye okubikkulirwa okulala kwali kunnindiridde, era omulembe ogwokuna ogw'obulamu bw'emmeeme yange — essuula yaagwo esinga okusikiriza — gwali gunaatera okutandika.

Mu bukakafu, wabula, sindiiko kusikirizibwa kubuulira oba kuyigiriza ku Kuzzaawo eyo, era ab'emikwano abakkiriza enzikiriza entuufu abaagalwa abatiitiira bwe bataleeta kalulu ku kyo, tekirabika nga nnaakikola. Okweraliikirira kwabwe ku lwange tekunnyiiza n'akatono. Nzikiriza nti mu butuufu nsanyukira okuba ekiruubirirwa eky'obukyayi obw'eby'okutya Katonda. Ndowooza waliwo ekintu eky'embalaasi ey'olutalo mu buzaaliranwa bwange.” Obanga entiisa y'akakiiko yali ya nsonga oba nedda, siyinza kugamba; kye mmanyi kyokka nti wadde omulundi gumu, mu mulimu gwange gwonna mu Bungereza, saawuliranga nti endowooza yange ku Kuzzaawo yaziyiza okwanirizibwa kw'obubaka bwange oba n'okuggalawo omulyango n'ogumu. Mu butuufu, nzikiriza nti gyaggulawo emiryango egyandisigadde nga miggale. Amazima agasingako obuziba gaali nti enzikiriza yange ey'omusingi mu bwenkanya n'okwagala kwa Katonda okutakoma ddala kwannyamba okwogera n'okukkiriza okuvumu okusingira ddala kwe nnandisobodde awatali kwo. Nkakasibwa nti awatali obukakafu buno nnandinyagiddwako ekitundu eky'amaanyi gange. Ka abalala balowooze kyonna kye baagala, enkyukakyuka okuzuula kuno kwe kwaleeta mu bumanyirivu bwange yali nnene — esukka ebigambo. Okwagala okw'omwoyo okw'obulamu bwange kwafuuka okusikiriza okusingako. Buli lunaku lwaleeta okutegeera okumu okusingako obuziba n'okwakaayakana ku bulungi n'obuteefaako bwa Katonda obutalowoozeka. Nnawulira ku nkomerero nti nnali ntandika okuyingira mu makulu ag'okusaba kw'Omutume ku lw'Abaefeso: nti tuyinze okutegeera, wamu n'abatukuvu bonna, obugazi n'obuwanvu n'obuziba n'obugulumivu bw'okwagala kwa Kristo, n'okumanya — ne bwe kyandibadde katono kwokka — okwagala okusukka okumanya. Okwagala okwenkana awo mazima kusukka okumanya; kwandivudde mu mutima gwa Katonda omuteefaako ddala kyokka. Nnayimirira mu kutya mu maaso g'obugazi bwako n'obuwanvu n'obuziba n'obugulumivu, era ne nneewuunya — awatali kukoma — nti nnandisobodde okulowooza okwagala kwa Katonda okuliko ensalo. Okumala ebbanga eddene essanyu lya byonna lyali lya kitalo nnyo ne ndowooza nti tewandibaddewo kirala kya kuzuula ku Katonda — nti nnali ntuuse ku kubikkulirwa okw'enkomerero. Naye okubikkulirwa okulala kwali kunnindiridde, era omulembe ogwokuna ogw'obulamu bw'emmeeme yange — essuula yaagwo esinga okusikiriza — gwali gunaatera okutandika.

fields.title: Omulembe ogwOkuna mu Bulamu Bwange obw'Eddiini (Obulamu obw'Okukkiriza)
fields.body_html:
Kyali mu 1865 nga omulembe ogwokuna, era ogusinga ddala okusikiriza, ogw'olugendo lwange olw'omwoyo bwe gwamulisiza emmeeme yange. Nnali mmaze emyaka mwenda nga Mukristaayo — emyaka egyajjula essanyu n'okusikirizibwa — naye ekyanjijira kaakano kyali kisukkiridde nnyo byonna ebyakisooka ne kiba nti kyawulikika ng'ensi empya ddala era ey'ekyewuunyo eyaggulwa mu maaso gange.

Mu myaka egyo egyasooka, okukkiriza kwange kwali kunkkusa ddala mu buli kintu ekikwata ku Katonda.

Buli kuzuula kwe nnakola ku mpisa ze n'amakubo ge kwandeetera essanyu lyokka. Naye bwe kyatuuka ku mugabo gwange mu bulamu obwa Kikristaayo, obumativu bwali si butuukiridde nnyo. Nnali musanyufu, weewaawo, naye saali muntu gwe nnayaayaanira okuba.

Nnali nzudde eddiini eyasuubiza okununulibwa okutuukiridde eri ebiseera eby'omu maaso, naye teyalabika ng'ewaayo okununulibwa kaakano. Nnali nzudde Katonda omuteefaako era ow'obwenkanya gwe nnayinza okusinza awatali kutya kunyiiga — naye nnali nnyiiga bulijjo mu nze nnyini. Nnamanya nti saali kye nnasaanira okuba. Obulamu bwange bwawulika ng'obujjudde okulemererwa — si nnyo ekibi eky'ebweru, wabula ebibi eby'omunda: obunnyogovu, okufa kw'omwoyo, obutaba na kwagala kwa Kikristaayo, emirandira egy'obukyayi, obulemu obwo bwonna obwekusifu abaana ba Katonda kwe batera okunakuwalira. Bwe nnayagalanga okukola obulungi, ekibi kyabangawo. Obulungi bwe nnayaayaaniranga, ssaabukolanga; n'ekibi kye nnakyawanga, nnakyeyongera okukikola. Nneesanga nga njooneka era nga nneenenya obutasalako, nga nkola ensala ne nzimenya, nga nkyawa ekyo ekyali ekibi naye nga nkifuukira, nga neegomba obuwanguzi naye ng'emirundi mingi nsinga kulemererwa okusinga okuwangula.

Naye Ebyawandiikibwa byalabika ng'ebiyigiriza nti Kristo yajja okuleeta obuwanguzi obw'amazima era obwa kaakano eri abagoberezi be. Kyategeeza nti Abakristaayo baali basaanidde okuba nga tebalina kweraliikirira na ntiisa, era n'okusanyukira ne kaakano emirembe egisukka okutegeera. Naye nnamanya bitono nnyo eby'ekyo mu bulumi. Omutima gwange gwali guwummudde ku by'omu maaso, naye kaakano kwange kwali kutaaguddwataaguddwa okweraliikirira n'okweraliikirira olukumi olwa buli lunaku. Ebibala byennyini eby'Omwoyo — bye nnakkiririza nti nnali mfunye — byali kwagala, ssanyu, mirembe, kugumiikiriza, bukkakkamu, buwombeefu, bulungi; naye bino byennyini bye byali empisa mwe nnawulira nga nsinga okubulwa.

Kino si kye nnali nsuubidde bwe nnasooka okufuuka Omukristaayo. Nga nnakuzibwa mu Baquaker — abaali n'obulamu obwaka emirembe — era nga nnayigirizibwa okuva mu buto nti obulungi bwali bwetaagisa nnyo, nnali nteebereza nti okufuuka Omukristaayo kyali kitegeeza ddala okufuuka ow'emirembe era omulungi. Nnasuubira obuwanguzi ku kibi ne ku kweraliikirira mu ngeri ey'obuzaaliranwa nga bwe nnasuubira enjuba okuvaayo. Naye mu buziba obwekusifu obw'emmeeme yange, nnalina okwatula nti nnali nnyiize.

Ku lubereberye, essanyu ery'obulokozi bwange obuggya lyali liyeeyezza buli kintu ekirala. Nnalowooza nti okukemebwa n'okutya n'ekibi byali bigenze emirembe gyonna. Naye okumasamasa okusooka bwe kwaggwaawo, okukemebwa okukadde ne kudda n'amaanyi gaakwo amakadde. Ne kifuuka kyangu nga bulijjo okweraliikirira, okweraliikirira, okuzitoowererwa, okunyiiga mangu, obutaba na kisa, okusalira omusango, n'obukambwe — okukola n'okuba ebintu byonna bye nnakkiririza nti eddiini yandimponyezza. Tewali na kimu ku bino ekyanyeenya obukakafu bwange nti nnali mwana wa Katonda era omusika w'eggulu, naye emirundi mingi kyanneetera okuwulira ensonyi ez'ennaku. Okuba omwana wa Katonda naye nga sisobola kubeera ng'omu kyanneetera okwebuuza obanga waliwo kye nnali mbulwa mu bulamu obwa Kikristaayo — ekintu ekyandindeetedde obuwanguzi.

Nga nsazeewo okuzuula kye kyali ekintu ekibula ekyo, nnabuuza Abakristaayo abakulu abamu. Naye bonna ne bampa eky'okuddamu kye kimu: Nedda, tewali kye wabulwa. Obulamu obw'okwonoona n'okwenenya bwe bwokka bwe tuyinza okusuubira mu nsi eno, olw'obunafu bw'omubiri. Ne bannyonnyola nti Adamu ow'edda, gwe tuzaalibwa nakyo, ne Adamu omuggya, gwe tufuna nga tukyuka, baali balwana buli kaseera — oluusi omu ng'awangula, oluusi omulala — era nti mu kufa mwokka mwe twandizze okununulibwa okw'amazima okuva mu buzaaliranwa obukadde.

Tewali kintu kyandinnyonnyodde mbeera yange obulungi okusinga okukungubaga kwa Pawulo yennyini mu Abaruumi 7:14–23. Kyalabika nga kyampandiikirwa. Emirundi n'emirundi nnakaabira wamu naye nti, “Nange omuntu ali mu nnaku! Ani anandokola okuva mu mubiri guno ogw'okufa?” Naye saasobola kutegeera lwaki Pawulo yali abuuza ekibuuzo ekyo obanga, nga bonna bwe baagamba, tewaali kununulibwa mu bulamu buno. Mazima yamanya nti obuzaaliranwa obukadde bwali bugere okusigalawo okutuusa okufa. Naye si nti yabuuza ekibuuzo kyokka — yakiddamu n'obuwanguzi nti: “Neebaza Katonda ku bwa Yesu Kristo Mukama waffe.”

Yandibadde ategeeza ki? Nnali nnyingidde mu bulokozi ku bwa Yesu Kristo, naye saamanya kintu ku kununulibwa okuwangula bwe kutyo. Nnali nkyasibiddwa “omubiri ogw'okufa” ogw'omunda yange.

Lwaki? Obuzibu bwali ludda wa?

Ebibuuzo bino byeyongera okunyigiriza nga mazuula okwagala kwa Katonda okutakoma. Kyawulikika ng'ekitali kya gabo — okumpi ng'ekitali kya kwebaza — okwanukula obuteefaako bwe obutakoma n'okubulwa ebibala eby'omwoyo bwe kutyo. Olwokubanga yali yeeraze ow'amaanyi mangi okulokola mu biseera eby'omu maaso, yandibadde atya nga talina maanyi mu kaakano?

Obulamu bw'Abaquaker abaali nga banneetoolodde nabwo bwalaga nti waali wateekwa okubaawo okununulibwa, kubanga baagamba nti baali bakufunye — wadde nga tebaayinza kunnyonnyola bulungi kye kyali oba engeri gye kyakolamu.

Ekintu ekirala ekyankwatako kyanyweza obukakafu buno. Nnalina ekitabo ekyayigiriza si kyokka nti abaana ba Katonda baalagirwa okubala ebibala eby'Omwoyo, naye nti baali basobola okukikola — era ekyawa n'obubonero obw'ekkubo ery'ekyama eridda gye kiri. Ekitabo kyali Spiritual Progress, ekikuŋŋaanya eky'ebiwuluddwa okuva ku Fenelon ne Madame Guyon. Kyali kya muwendo naddala kubanga kyali kirabo okuva ku kitange gwe nnayagala ennyo era bulijjo kyabeeranga ku mmeeza yange okuliraana Baibuli yange.

Kitange yali akizudde nga alina emyaka kkumi na munaana yokka. Bwe yali ng'atambula ng'ayita mu Philadelphia ku lugendo lwe okulinnya ekyombo ku lugendo oluwanvu okugenda mu China, yayita ku katale k'ebitabo ebyakozesebwako. Wadde nga yali yaakatandika obulamu obw'omwoyo, yasikirizibwa omutwe Spiritual Progress.

Nga tamanyi kintu ku ebyo ebyalimu, yakigula ng'akwatiddwa akalulu — nga aluŋŋamyibwa awatali kumanya, awatali kubuusabuusa, Mukama gwe yali atandise okwesiga. Yawandiika mu Ebijjukizo bye nti: “Ekitabo kino kyafuuka eky'okubudaabudibwa okusinga gye ndi. Nnakisitulanga mu nsawo yange ne nkisoma mu buseera obw'obwerere, olw'amagoba gange agataggwaawo, nkkiriza. Sisobola butaba na kwebaza Obwavu obw'ekisa olw'okuteeka ekitabo kino ekiweereddwa omukisa mu mikono gyange.”

Kitange yassa ekitabo ekyo ekitiibwa kingi nnyo ne kiba nti amangwago buli omu ku ffe abaana bwe yakula ekimala, yatuwa kkopi yaffe ffennyini n'atusaba okukyekenneenya n'obwegendereza. Olwokubanga twamwagala nnyo ennyo, bulijjo twayagalanga okumusanyusa, era mu myaka egy'okunoonya kwange okusooka okw'enjala n'okuggwaamu essuubi okunoonya Katonda, ekitabo kyafuuka munnange ow'olubeerera.

Naye olwokubanga kyawandiikibwa okusingira okuluŋŋamya emmeeme ezaali zaakugenda mu maaso mu bulamu obw'omwoyo okusinga okuyamba abanoonya okuyingira mu bulamu obwo mu kusooka, tekyampa buyambi bumu bwennyini mu myaka egyo egyasooka, egy'obuzibe egy'okunoonya. Era bwe kyatuuka, mu 1858, ne njja okukkiriza nti nnali nzudde “enteekateeka ey'obulokozi” — enanywezebwa, nga bwe nnaddiŋŋanya, mu nkiiko ez'Eggulu, eyabikkulibwa mu bulamu n'okufa kwa Kristo, era eyakolebwa obulungi Omutume Pawulo — nnajjuza ku mbiriizi za kkopi yange ebyo bye nnalowooza nti bye bigambo eby'okunenya ebimalirira ebyakakasa nti ekitabo tekyali kya mazima.

Naye kyokka, awatali kutegeera, enjigiriza yaakyo yankwatako nnyo. Ne bwe nnali nkinenya, nnawulira enjala ey'omunda ey'oludda olw'ekyama olw'eddiini ekitabo lwe kyayoleka.

Mu myaka gyonna egyaddirira, nnasikibwasikibwa wakati w'ebyo enjigiriza ya Plymouth Brethren bye yateebereza ku ludda olumu n'ebyo eby'ekyama bye byateebereza ku ludda olulala.

Ekitundu eky'obuzaaliranwa bwange eky'okukola era eky'obusuubuzi kyasembeera eri Brethren; okukuzibwa kwange okwa Kiquaker n'obuyinza bw'ekitabo kyange kye nnayagala byansika okudda eri eky'ekyama.

Oluusi, enjigiriza z'ekitiibwa zalabika nga zisinga obukulu era obulamu bw'omuntu obw'amazima ng'obutalina makulu; oluusi endala, enjigiriza zawulikika ng'ezitalina mugaso okuggyako nga zivaamu obulamu obutuukirivu. Oluusi Pawulo yakwata obuyinza mu birowoozo byange — ng'ayigiriza obulokozi olw'okukkiriza — n'oluusi Yakobo, ng'akakata nti okukkiriza awatali bikolwa kufa. Ab'emikwano bange aba Plymouth Brethren baagulumiza Pawulo n'okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'okukkiriza; ab'emikwano bange Abaquaker n'abatukuvu ab'Ekikatuliki mu kitabo kyange baagulumiza Yakobo n'okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'ebikolwa. Ekitundu ekikola mu nze kyasembeera eri ekisooka; oludda olw'ekyama lwasembeera eri ekyokubiri. Ekyavaamu kwe kuba obutewombeefu obw'olubeerera obw'emmeeme, obwo, nga bwegasse ku kunakuwala kwange olw'okulemererwa kwange okw'omwoyo okutasalako, emirundi mingi bwannetera okwebuuza obanga kye nnayiga ku bulokozi bwa Kristo kyandiba ddala olugero lwonna.

Nga sirina ddagala ddala eppakika, nneeyongera okukyukira “enjigiriza entuufu” okusirisa obutewombeefu bwange. Wansi w'obuyinza bwa Plymouth Brethren, enjigiriza zino zaali zifuuse ennyonnyofu ddala, buli emu ng'ekutte akapapula obulungi era ng'eterekeddwa mu bituli by'ebirowoozo byange. Tewandibaddewo kya nteekateeka okusingawo — waakiri ku by'enjigiriza. Nnali nfuuse omuyigiriza ow'obuwanguzi ow'enjigiriza zino, era nnatunuulira wansi n'okusaasira omuntu yenna eyali tayonjo era nga si mumeeme nga nze.

Emirundi mingi nnayagalanga ntuuze abayigiriza b'eddiini bonna be nnamanya ku lunyiriri lw'entebe z'abaana empanvu mu maaso gange, ndyoke mbannyonnyole enjigiriza ze baalabika nga tebategeera bulungi — naddala okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'okukkiriza n'embeera y'omukkiriza mu maaso g'amateeka. Buli kiseera nnalangiriranga nti singa omuntu ategeera bumpi ebintu bino ebibiri n'abikkiririzaamu ddala, kale byonna byali birungi era tewali kirala kyagaza nnyo.

Nzijjukira nga ŋŋamba ekintu ekifaanana kino eri mwannyinaze eyajja gye ndi ng'anakuwadde olw'obulemu bwe mu bulamu obwa Kikristaayo. Yagamba nti, “Naye Hannah, okusinziira ku ky'oyogera, ebibi byaffe byonna — eby'edda, eby'okaakano, n'eby'omu maaso — bisonyiyiddwa singa tukkiriza bumpi. Kifuula enjawulo ntono nnyo kye tukola.”

“Yee,” nnaddamu mu butamanya bwange, “era ekyo kye kirungi kyakyo ddala! Twambala ekyambalo eky'obutuukirivu bwa Kristo, era ekyambalo ekyo kibikka obubi bwonna obuli wansi. Katonda bw'atutunuulira, talaba butali butuukirivu bwaffe wabula obutuukirivu bwa Kristo, era atwaniriza olw'ekyo.”

Omulundi omulala, omubuulizi Omuquaker eyali ampulidde nga nnyonnyola endowooza zino enkambwe yagamba nti, “Kindabikira, Hannah Smith, nti oyogera ng'oyinza okuyingira mu dduuka ery'engoye ezaakolebwako dda, n'ogula engoye ez'obulokozi, n'ozambala amangwago, n'ofuluma ng'oyambadde ddala obutuukirivu era ng'oli mwetegefu olw'eggulu.”

“Yee!” nnaddamu. “Bwe kityo ddala bwe kiri — okuggyako nti sseetaaga kugula ngoye; Kristo azimpa! Weebale olw'ekifaananyi ekirungi bwe kityo; mazima ddala nnaakikozesa mu kubuulira kwange.”

Sirina kubuusabuusa nti nnavvuunula enjigiriza ya Plymouth Brethren mu ngeri ey'olwatu era ey'ebweru esingira ddala bye baali bagenderedde. Naye nnayagalanga okuba na buli kintu ekinnyonnyoddwa n'obulungerevu obutuukiridde, era kino kyalabika ng'ekivaamu eky'amagezi eky'endowooza zaabwe. Mu ngeri ey'ekyewuunyo, nnalemererwa okulaba engeri eyali etakwatagana okukkiriza mu Katonda omutuukirivu eyali abikka obutali butuukirivu bwaffe n'ekyambalo eky'obutuukirivu bwe ye, n'alyoka yeefuula nti twali tusaanira eggulu — songa ddala yamanya nti wansi w'ekyambalo “engoye zaffe enjama” zaali zikyaliwo.

Buli lwe ab'emikwano bange Abaquaker bwe baayogeranga ku butakwatagana buno, nnasirisanga obutewombeefu bwange nga ŋŋamba nze nnyini nti wadde nga baali bantu abaagalwa, abalungi, tebaali ba njigiriza n'akatono era baamanya bitono nnyo ku “nteekateeka ey'obulokozi,” “okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'okukkiriza,” oba “embeera y'omukkiriza mu maaso g'amateeka.” Okuwakanya kwabwe, kale, tekwali kusaanira kulowoozebwako.

Kyokka, oluvannyuma lw'okuzuula kwe nnali nkoze okw'obunene bw'okwagala kwa Katonda, nga bwe nnannyonnyola mu ssuula zange ezaakusooka, nnatandika okuwulira obutewombeefu obweyongera. Kyalabika ng'okwanukula okutasingako kwebaza eri okwagala okutakoma bwe kutyo nti ffe — abaakufuna — twandilemereddwa bulabe bwe kutyo okubeera n'obulamu obw'ekika Katonda kye yali agenderedde ddala ku lwaffe. Gye nneeyongera okulowooza, gye kyeyongera okulabika ng'ekitakwatagana nti obulokozi, obwali ku nkomerero bwakuba obw'ekitiibwa era obutuukiridde, bwandilemereddwa bulabe bwe kutyo kaakano, mu bulamu buno obwa kaakano, okuwa obuwanguzi ku kibi ne ku kweraliikirira Enjiri kw'esuubiza olwatu ng'ekivaamu kyayo eky'amangu.

Lwaki, nneebuuza emirundi n'emirundi, nti Katonda eyali ateeseteese okununulibwa okw'ekitiibwa bwe kutyo ku lwaffe mu biseera eby'omu maaso teyali ateeseteese n'okununulibwa okusingako obulungi ku lwaffe mu kaakano?
