Omutima gwange gwali guwummudde ku by'omu maaso, naye kaakano kwange kwali kutaaguddwataaguddwa okweraliikirira n'okweraliikirira olukumi olwa buli lunaku. Ebibala byennyini eby'Omwoyo — bye nnakkiririza nti nnali mfunye — byali kwagala, ssanyu, mirembe, kugumiikiriza, bukkakkamu, buwombeefu, bulungi; naye bino byennyini bye byali empisa mwe nnawulira nga nsinga okubulwa. Kino si kye nnali nsuubidde bwe nnasooka okufuuka Omukristaayo. Nga nnakuzibwa mu Baquaker — abaali n'obulamu obwaka emirembe — era nga nnayigirizibwa okuva mu buto nti obulungi bwali bwetaagisa nnyo, nnali nteebereza nti okufuuka Omukristaayo kyali kitegeeza ddala okufuuka ow'emirembe era omulungi. Nnasuubira obuwanguzi ku kibi ne ku kweraliikirira mu ngeri ey'obuzaaliranwa nga bwe nnasuubira enjuba okuvaayo. Naye mu buziba obwekusifu obw'emmeeme yange, nnalina okwatula nti nnali nnyiize. Ku lubereberye, essanyu ery'obulokozi bwange obuggya lyali liyeeyezza buli kintu ekirala. Nnalowooza nti okukemebwa n'okutya n'ekibi byali bigenze emirembe gyonna. Naye okumasamasa okusooka bwe kwaggwaawo, okukemebwa okukadde ne kudda n'amaanyi gaakwo amakadde. Ne kifuuka kyangu nga bulijjo okweraliikirira, okweraliikirira, okuzitoowererwa, okunyiiga mangu, obutaba na kisa, okusalira omusango, n'obukambwe — okukola n'okuba ebintu byonna bye nnakkiririza nti eddiini yandimponyezza. Tewali na kimu ku bino ekyanyeenya obukakafu bwange nti nnali mwana wa Katonda era omusika w'eggulu, naye emirundi mingi kyanneetera okuwulira ensonyi ez'ennaku. Okuba omwana wa Katonda naye nga sisobola kubeera ng'omu kyanneetera okwebuuza obanga waliwo kye nnali mbulwa mu bulamu obwa Kikristaayo — ekintu ekyandindeetedde obuwanguzi. Nga nsazeewo okuzuula kye kyali ekintu ekibula ekyo, nnabuuza Abakristaayo abakulu abamu. Naye bonna ne bampa eky'okuddamu kye kimu: Nedda, tewali kye wabulwa. Obulamu obw'okwonoona n'okwenenya bwe bwokka bwe tuyinza okusuubira mu nsi eno, olw'obunafu bw'omubiri. Ne bannyonnyola nti Adamu ow'edda, gwe tuzaalibwa nakyo, ne Adamu omuggya, gwe tufuna nga tukyuka, baali balwana buli kaseera — oluusi omu ng'awangula, oluusi omulala — era nti mu kufa mwokka mwe twandizze okununulibwa okw'amazima okuva mu buzaaliranwa obukadde. Tewali kintu kyandinnyonnyodde mbeera yange obulungi okusinga okukungubaga kwa Pawulo yennyini mu Abaruumi 7:14–23. Kyalabika nga kyampandiikirwa. Emirundi n'emirundi nnakaabira wamu naye nti, “Nange omuntu ali mu nnaku! Ani anandokola okuva mu mubiri guno ogw'okufa?” Naye saasobola kutegeera lwaki Pawulo yali abuuza ekibuuzo ekyo obanga, nga bonna bwe baagamba, tewaali kununulibwa mu bulamu buno. Mazima yamanya nti obuzaaliranwa obukadde bwali bugere okusigalawo okutuusa okufa. Naye si nti yabuuza ekibuuzo kyokka — yakiddamu n'obuwanguzi nti: “Neebaza Katonda ku bwa Yesu Kristo Mukama waffe.” Yandibadde ategeeza ki? Nnali nnyingidde mu bulokozi ku bwa Yesu Kristo, naye saamanya kintu ku kununulibwa okuwangula bwe kutyo. Nnali nkyasibiddwa “omubiri ogw'okufa” ogw'omunda yange. Lwaki? Obuzibu bwali ludda wa? Ebibuuzo bino byeyongera okunyigiriza nga mazuula okwagala kwa Katonda okutakoma. Kyawulikika ng'ekitali kya gabo — okumpi ng'ekitali kya kwebaza — okwanukula obuteefaako bwe obutakoma n'okubulwa ebibala eby'omwoyo bwe kutyo. Olwokubanga yali yeeraze ow'amaanyi mangi okulokola mu biseera eby'omu maaso, yandibadde atya nga talina maanyi mu kaakano? Obulamu bw'Abaquaker abaali nga banneetoolodde nabwo bwalaga nti waali wateekwa okubaawo okununulibwa, kubanga baagamba nti baali bakufunye — wadde nga tebaayinza kunnyonnyola bulungi kye kyali oba engeri gye kyakolamu. Ekintu ekirala ekyankwatako kyanyweza obukakafu buno. Nnalina ekitabo ekyayigiriza si kyokka nti abaana ba Katonda baalagirwa okubala ebibala eby'Omwoyo, naye nti baali basobola okukikola — era ekyawa n'obubonero obw'ekkubo ery'ekyama eridda gye kiri. Ekitabo kyali Spiritual Progress, ekikuŋŋaanya eky'ebiwuluddwa okuva ku Fenelon ne Madame Guyon. Kyali kya muwendo naddala kubanga kyali kirabo okuva ku kitange gwe nnayagala ennyo era bulijjo kyabeeranga ku mmeeza yange okuliraana Baibuli yange. Kitange yali akizudde nga alina emyaka kkumi na munaana yokka. Bwe yali ng'atambula ng'ayita mu Philadelphia ku lugendo lwe okulinnya ekyombo ku lugendo oluwanvu okugenda mu China, yayita ku katale k'ebitabo ebyakozesebwako. Wadde nga yali yaakatandika obulamu obw'omwoyo, yasikirizibwa omutwe Spiritual Progress. Nga tamanyi kintu ku ebyo ebyalimu, yakigula ng'akwatiddwa akalulu — nga aluŋŋamyibwa awatali kumanya, awatali kubuusabuusa, Mukama gwe yali atandise okwesiga. Yawandiika mu Ebijjukizo bye nti: “Ekitabo kino kyafuuka eky'okubudaabudibwa okusinga gye ndi. Nnakisitulanga mu nsawo yange ne nkisoma mu buseera obw'obwerere, olw'amagoba gange agataggwaawo, nkkiriza. Sisobola butaba na kwebaza Obwavu obw'ekisa olw'okuteeka ekitabo kino ekiweereddwa omukisa mu mikono gyange.” Kitange yassa ekitabo ekyo ekitiibwa kingi nnyo ne kiba nti amangwago buli omu ku ffe abaana bwe yakula ekimala, yatuwa kkopi yaffe ffennyini n'atusaba okukyekenneenya n'obwegendereza. Olwokubanga twamwagala nnyo ennyo, bulijjo twayagalanga okumusanyusa, era mu myaka egy'okunoonya kwange okusooka okw'enjala n'okuggwaamu essuubi okunoonya Katonda, ekitabo kyafuuka munnange ow'olubeerera. Naye olwokubanga kyawandiikibwa okusingira okuluŋŋamya emmeeme ezaali zaakugenda mu maaso mu bulamu obw'omwoyo okusinga okuyamba abanoonya okuyingira mu bulamu obwo mu kusooka, tekyampa buyambi bumu bwennyini mu myaka egyo egyasooka, egy'obuzibe egy'okunoonya. Era bwe kyatuuka, mu 1858, ne njja okukkiriza nti nnali nzudde “enteekateeka ey'obulokozi” — enanywezebwa, nga bwe nnaddiŋŋanya, mu nkiiko ez'Eggulu, eyabikkulibwa mu bulamu n'okufa kwa Kristo, era eyakolebwa obulungi Omutume Pawulo — nnajjuza ku mbiriizi za kkopi yange ebyo bye nnalowooza nti bye bigambo eby'okunenya ebimalirira ebyakakasa nti ekitabo tekyali kya mazima. Naye kyokka, awatali kutegeera, enjigiriza yaakyo yankwatako nnyo. Ne bwe nnali nkinenya, nnawulira enjala ey'omunda ey'oludda olw'ekyama olw'eddiini ekitabo lwe kyayoleka. Mu myaka gyonna egyaddirira, nnasikibwasikibwa wakati w'ebyo enjigiriza ya Plymouth Brethren bye yateebereza ku ludda olumu n'ebyo eby'ekyama bye byateebereza ku ludda olulala. Ekitundu eky'obuzaaliranwa bwange eky'okukola era eky'obusuubuzi kyasembeera eri Brethren; okukuzibwa kwange okwa Kiquaker n'obuyinza bw'ekitabo kyange kye nnayagala byansika okudda eri eky'ekyama. Oluusi, enjigiriza z'ekitiibwa zalabika nga zisinga obukulu era obulamu bw'omuntu obw'amazima ng'obutalina makulu; oluusi endala, enjigiriza zawulikika ng'ezitalina mugaso okuggyako nga zivaamu obulamu obutuukirivu. Oluusi Pawulo yakwata obuyinza mu birowoozo byange — ng'ayigiriza obulokozi olw'okukkiriza — n'oluusi Yakobo, ng'akakata nti okukkiriza awatali bikolwa kufa. Ab'emikwano bange aba Plymouth Brethren baagulumiza Pawulo n'okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'okukkiriza; ab'emikwano bange Abaquaker n'abatukuvu ab'Ekikatuliki mu kitabo kyange baagulumiza Yakobo n'okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'ebikolwa. Ekitundu ekikola mu nze kyasembeera eri ekisooka; oludda olw'ekyama lwasembeera eri ekyokubiri. Ekyavaamu kwe kuba obutewombeefu obw'olubeerera obw'emmeeme, obwo, nga bwegasse ku kunakuwala kwange olw'okulemererwa kwange okw'omwoyo okutasalako, emirundi mingi bwannetera okwebuuza obanga kye nnayiga ku bulokozi bwa Kristo kyandiba ddala olugero lwonna. Nga sirina ddagala ddala eppakika, nneeyongera okukyukira “enjigiriza entuufu” okusirisa obutewombeefu bwange. Wansi w'obuyinza bwa Plymouth Brethren, enjigiriza zino zaali zifuuse ennyonnyofu ddala, buli emu ng'ekutte akapapula obulungi era ng'eterekeddwa mu bituli by'ebirowoozo byange. Tewandibaddewo kya nteekateeka okusingawo — waakiri ku by'enjigiriza. Nnali nfuuse omuyigiriza ow'obuwanguzi ow'enjigiriza zino, era nnatunuulira wansi n'okusaasira omuntu yenna eyali tayonjo era nga si mumeeme nga nze. Emirundi mingi nnayagalanga ntuuze abayigiriza b'eddiini bonna be nnamanya ku lunyiriri lw'entebe z'abaana empanvu mu maaso gange, ndyoke mbannyonnyole enjigiriza ze baalabika nga tebategeera bulungi — naddala okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'okukkiriza n'embeera y'omukkiriza mu maaso g'amateeka. Buli kiseera nnalangiriranga nti singa omuntu ategeera bumpi ebintu bino ebibiri n'abikkiririzaamu ddala, kale byonna byali birungi era tewali kirala kyagaza nnyo. Nzijjukira nga ŋŋamba ekintu ekifaanana kino eri mwannyinaze eyajja gye ndi ng'anakuwadde olw'obulemu bwe mu bulamu obwa Kikristaayo. Yagamba nti, “Naye Hannah, okusinziira ku ky'oyogera, ebibi byaffe byonna — eby'edda, eby'okaakano, n'eby'omu maaso — bisonyiyiddwa singa tukkiriza bumpi. Kifuula enjawulo ntono nnyo kye tukola.” “Yee,” nnaddamu mu butamanya bwange, “era ekyo kye kirungi kyakyo ddala! Twambala ekyambalo eky'obutuukirivu bwa Kristo, era ekyambalo ekyo kibikka obubi bwonna obuli wansi. Katonda bw'atutunuulira, talaba butali butuukirivu bwaffe wabula obutuukirivu bwa Kristo, era atwaniriza olw'ekyo.” Omulundi omulala, omubuulizi Omuquaker eyali ampulidde nga nnyonnyola endowooza zino enkambwe yagamba nti, “Kindabikira, Hannah Smith, nti oyogera ng'oyinza okuyingira mu dduuka ery'engoye ezaakolebwako dda, n'ogula engoye ez'obulokozi, n'ozambala amangwago, n'ofuluma ng'oyambadde ddala obutuukirivu era ng'oli mwetegefu olw'eggulu.” “Yee!” nnaddamu. “Bwe kityo ddala bwe kiri — okuggyako nti sseetaaga kugula ngoye; Kristo azimpa! Weebale olw'ekifaananyi ekirungi bwe kityo; mazima ddala nnaakikozesa mu kubuulira kwange.” Sirina kubuusabuusa nti nnavvuunula enjigiriza ya Plymouth Brethren mu ngeri ey'olwatu era ey'ebweru esingira ddala bye baali bagenderedde. Naye nnayagalanga okuba na buli kintu ekinnyonnyoddwa n'obulungerevu obutuukiridde, era kino kyalabika ng'ekivaamu eky'amagezi eky'endowooza zaabwe. Mu ngeri ey'ekyewuunyo, nnalemererwa okulaba engeri eyali etakwatagana okukkiriza mu Katonda omutuukirivu eyali abikka obutali butuukirivu bwaffe n'ekyambalo eky'obutuukirivu bwe ye, n'alyoka yeefuula nti twali tusaanira eggulu — songa ddala yamanya nti wansi w'ekyambalo “engoye zaffe enjama” zaali zikyaliwo. Buli lwe ab'emikwano bange Abaquaker bwe baayogeranga ku butakwatagana buno, nnasirisanga obutewombeefu bwange nga ŋŋamba nze nnyini nti wadde nga baali bantu abaagalwa, abalungi, tebaali ba njigiriza n'akatono era baamanya bitono nnyo ku “nteekateeka ey'obulokozi,” “okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'okukkiriza,” oba “embeera y'omukkiriza mu maaso g'amateeka.” Okuwakanya kwabwe, kale, tekwali kusaanira kulowoozebwako. Kyokka, oluvannyuma lw'okuzuula kwe nnali nkoze okw'obunene bw'okwagala kwa Katonda, nga bwe nnannyonnyola mu ssuula zange ezaakusooka, nnatandika okuwulira obutewombeefu obweyongera. Kyalabika ng'okwanukula okutasingako kwebaza eri okwagala okutakoma bwe kutyo nti ffe — abaakufuna — twandilemereddwa bulabe bwe kutyo okubeera n'obulamu obw'ekika Katonda kye yali agenderedde ddala ku lwaffe. Gye nneeyongera okulowooza, gye kyeyongera okulabika ng'ekitakwatagana nti obulokozi, obwali ku nkomerero bwakuba obw'ekitiibwa era obutuukiridde, bwandilemereddwa bulabe bwe kutyo kaakano, mu bulamu buno obwa kaakano, okuwa obuwanguzi ku kibi ne ku kweraliikirira Enjiri kw'esuubiza olwatu ng'ekivaamu kyayo eky'amangu. Lwaki, nneebuuza emirundi n'emirundi, nti Katonda eyali ateeseteese okununulibwa okw'ekitiibwa bwe kutyo ku lwaffe mu biseera eby'omu maaso teyali ateeseteese n'okununulibwa okusingako obulungi ku lwaffe mu kaakano?

fields.title: Ekkubo ery'Okuwona
fields.body_html:
Obutewombeefu buno n'okwebuuza kwatuuka ku ntikko yaakwo mu 1865. Olw'embeera ez'omu maka, twali tuteekwa okuva mu maka gaffe amasanyufu e Germantown — wamu n'ekibiina kyaffe kyonna ekigazi eky'ebyo bye twali twagala — ne tusenguka okudda mu kyalo eky'ewala mu New Jersey, gye twagenda okusalibwako ddala ku buntu bwonna obw'emikwano. Mu by'ensimbi, kyali kya nkizo, naye mu ngeri endala yonna kyali kigezo kinene, naddala gye ndi. Nnyatula nti omwoyo gwange gwajeema n'obukyayi eri enkyukakyuka eyo.

Saalowooza nti mu kifo kino kyennyini, ekyawulikika ng'ekyereere era ekyawukanyiziddwa, ekitangaala ekiggya eky'ekitiibwa kyandimulisizza, nga kireeta omulembe ogwokuna era ogusinga ogw'obulamu bwange obw'omwoyo.

Kyaliwo bwe kiti. Nga bwe njogedde, nnali njeemye nnyo ku kusenguka. Naye nnali n'okutegeera kw'omwoyo okumala okumanya nti obujeemu buno bwali bubi. Olwokubanga okusenguka kyali kya lwatu nteekateeka ya Katonda esukka obuyinza bwange, eky'okuddamu ekituufu ekyokka kyali kukikkiriza n'essanyu era ne ŋŋamba mu mazima nti, “Ky'oyagala kikolebwe.” Naye wadde nga nneenenyanga buli kaseera, ssaasobola kukkiriza kya Katonda ky'ayagala — era mu mazima, ssaayagala kukikkiriza. Nnawulira nti kyali kikolwa kikambwe okuwalirizibwa okuva mu maka gange amasanyufu ag'e Germantown n'ekifo kyange eky'omugaso okubeera mu kifo eky'obwerere era eky'ewala nga Millville. Kyandabikira nti Katonda teyandikkirizza kino kubaawo, era nti nnali n'obuyinza bwonna okwemulugunya n'okweraliikirira.

Ekyavaamu kwe kuba nti nnagwa mu mbeera y'ebirowoozo etazza wabujja ennyo. N'enjigiriza zange ennyonnyofu ne zisoba okunnyamba nate, era nnatandika okutya nti nnali ŋŋenda kufiirwa obwomwoyo bwonna bwe nnali nsigazza.

Mu maaso g'obwetaavu obw'amazima bwe butyo, tekyali kya kubudaabudibwa kumanya nti nnali nsonyiyiddwa. Nnayagala ekisukka okusonyiyibwa — nnayagala okununulibwa. Naye ssaalina kirowoozo ku ngeri gye nnandikufunyemu.

Olwokubanga bulijjo twafunanga ababuulizi b'Obweereza abatukyalira, nnannyonnyola ensonga yange eri abamu ku bo ne mbasaba obuyambi, naye tewaali n'omu eyayinza okuntegeeza kintu kya mugaso. Ku nkomerero, omuyigiriza w'eddiini ow'obuwanguzi ennyo yajja okumala ennaku ntono, era gy'ali nnayiwa obuzibu bwange bwonna, nga mmwegayirira okunsalira ekkubo erimu ery'okununulibwa. Yalowooza ku mbeera yange n'obwesimbu era ku nkomerero n'agamba nti yakkiririza nti kye nnali nneetaaga kwali kwenyigira mu mulimu erimu ogwa Kikristaayo. Singa nnafuluma enkeera okukyalira abaavu ab'omu kitundu kyaffe ne ndaba engeri gye nnandibayambyemu, yalowooza nti obulamu bwange obw'omwoyo bwandizzeemu obuggya era nga byonna byandigenze bulungi.

Bwe kityo enkeera, nnagezaako eddagala lye yansalira. Naye amangu nnazuula obutaliimu bwalyo. Okumpi mu nnyumba esooka mwe nnayingira nnasangamu omukazi eyali alwanagana n'obuzibu bw'omwoyo bwe bumu obwange, era yali ayagala nnyo obuyambi — nga nze siriiko bwe nnali nnina okuwaayo. Nnawulira ng'omuntu agezaako okuliisa abalumwa enjala okuva mu bbakuli enkalu. Kyali mulimu gwa busirusiru era ogutasoboka. Nnadda eka nga nnamalidde amaanyi okusinga bulijjo, nga nkakasibwa nti nga sinnayamba muntu mulala yenna, nnandisoose kwezuulira kununulibwa nze nnyini.

Waaliwo omutunzi w'engoye ow'omu kitundu eyajjanga bulijjo okuntungira, era olwokubanga nnalina buntu buke nnyo obw'emikwano mu kyalo, oluusi nnatuulanga ne twogera naye nga tukola. Yalabika ng'ow'omwoyo mu ngeri etaali ya bulijjo, era nnasikirizibwa obumanyirivu bwe. Nnazuula nti yakkiririza mu buwanguzi obw'amazima ku kukemebwa — nti tekyali kyetaagisa, nga bwe nnali ndowoozezza, okuyita mu bulamu nga tujooneka ne twenenya, tujooneka ne twenenya, wabula nti Omukristaayo yali ayinza okununulibwa ddala. Yantegeeza nti mu Bamesodisti mwaliwo enjigiriza eyayitibwanga “Obutukuvu,” n'obumanyirivu obwagenda nabwo obwayitibwanga “okutukuzibwa,” oba “omukisa ogwokubiri,” obwaleeta abantu mu kifo eky'obuwanguzi. Nnasikirizibwa nnyo buli kye yayogera, era nnatandika okusuubira nti oboolyawo wano we wandibadde eky'okugonjoola okulwanagana kwange.

Era yantegeeza nti waaliwo olukuŋŋaana olutono lwe baakubiranga mu kyalo ku Lwomukaaga akawungeezi enjigiriza eno gye yayigirizibwanga era abantu gye baagabananga obumanyirivu bwabwe. Yankubiriza okugendayo. Nnalowooza nti nnandigenzeeyo lumu, naye nnaganya ebintu ebirala okuziyiza. Nnali nkakasibwa nti abaavu, abakozi b'amakolero abatasomesebwa, tebayinza kubaako kintu kye bandinjigirizza. Nnali njize ne nyigiriza Baibuli ennyo era nnalina endowooza waggulu ku bye nnali ntuuseeko mu by'eddiini. Nnawulira nti singa nnagenda ku lukuŋŋaana, oboolyawo nandibadde n'ebingi eby'okubayigiriza okusinga bye bandibadde n'okunjigiriza.

Kyokka ku nkomerero, akawungeezi kamu nnasalawo okubawa ekisa eky'okubeerawo kwange — era nnyatula, nnawulira nti kyali kisa kinene. Nnagenda ku lukuŋŋaana nga nzijjudde obukulu bwange n'obusukkulumu bwange, nga nsuubira okubeewuunyisa n'okumanya kwange okw'ebya Baibuli.

Bwe nnayingira, omukazi ow'oku kkolero ng'aliko oluwewo ku mutwe gwe — oboolyawo yali talina nkuufiira — yali ayogera. Nnamuwulira ng'agamba nti: “Amaaso gange gonna edda gaajjuzibwanga Nze wange ono omunene ennyo, naye bwe nnafuna akatunuulo ka Kristo ng'Omulokozi wange atuukiridde, Nze oyo omunene ennyo yakalira n'afuuka busa.”

Ebigambo ebyo byali kubikkulirwa gye ndi. Nnategeera nti saamanya kintu na kimu ku bumanyirivu bwe butyo. “Nze” wange yali munene nnyo era nga yeekakaasa nnyo, era saasobola kulowooza ngeri gye yandiyinzizza “okukendeera n'afuuka busa.” Naye obukakafu obungi ne bunjijira nti kino kiteekwa okuba Obukristaayo obw'amazima — era oboolyawo ekintu kyennyini kye nnali nnaayaanira.

Tekyetaagisa kugamba nti, ssaagezaako kuyigiriza kwonna ekiro ekyo. Mu kifo ky'ekyo nnatuula ng'omuyizi ku bigere by'Abakristaayo bano abeetoowaza, abaamanya bitono ku by'okuyiga mu bitabo naye ng'emmeeme zaabwe zaali ziyigirizibwa lwatu Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu buziba bw'amazima ag'omwoyo bwe nnali sinnakwatako. Nnatandika okugenda ku lukuŋŋaana bulijjo ng'omuyizi, era nnakozesa buli kakisa kye nnayinza okwogera n'abo abaategeera ekkubo lino ery'obulamu. Nnazuula nti entobo yaalyo yali kye kimu Pawulo kye yategeeza bwe yawandiika nti, “Si nze, wabula Kristo” — nti obuwanguzi bwe nnanoonya bwandijjidde okuva mu kulekera awo okubeera n'obulamu bwange nze nnyini n'okuganya amaanyi ga Katonda “okukola mu nze okwagala n'okukola nga bw'asiima.”

Mu kitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo, ekya Okitobba 18, 1866, nnawandiika nti: “Mukama abadde anjigiriza mu ngeri nnyingi mu biseera bino obunafu bwange obutuufu mu maaso g'okukemebwa. Nkuze nnyo mu kumanya, naye si mu kisa, era nsanga nti sirina maanyi ga mazima ku kibi okusinga ge nnalina bwe nnasooka okukyusibwa. Kino tekinneetedde kubuusabuusa nti ndi mwana wa Katonda — eyaweebwa obutuukirivu, eyasonyiyibwa, alina obulamu obutaggwaawo, era omusika w'obusika obw'omu ggulu.

Naye ne n'okukakasibwa kuno, siyinza kubeera musanyufu ng'omutima gwange gunsalira omusango. Nneegomba obutukuvu obungi, amaanyi amangi ku kibi, enkolagana etamenyeka na Katonda. Naye simanyi ngeri gye nnandikutuuseeko. Ensala tezirina mugaso; kaweefube wange wa bwereere. Okusaba kwange tekuddibwamu. Emirundi olukumi mbadde mwetegefu okuwaŋŋula mu kuggwaamu essuubi ne nsalawo nti si kya Katonda ky'ayagala nze okuba n'obuwanguzi ku kibi. Songa Baibuli eraga ekifaananyi eky'enjawulo ddala — 'ataliiko musango, atalina bulabe, atalina kunenyezebwa'; nga buli kukemebwa kuliko 'ekkubo ery'okuwona'; 'atukuzibbwa'; 'afaananyiziddwa ekifaananyi kya Kristo'; 'mutukuvu nga ye bw'ali omutukuvu.'”

Awo ne mpandiika nti: “Nsanga nti waliwo Abakristaayo abagamba nti nga tuweebwa Kristo olw'okukkiriza olw'okutukuzibwa kwaffe, nga bwe twamufuna olw'okukkiriza olw'okuweebwa obutuukirivu, omulimu guno gwonna gwe nneegomba gukolebwa — kwe kugamba, engeri ey'okugukola ezuuliddwa. Bagamba nti Baibuli eyigiriza nti Mukama ayinza okununula okuva mu buyinza bw'ekibi awamu n'okuva mu musango gwakyo, era nti emmeeme eyiga okumwesiga okukikola, ng'elekera awo okwesiga ensala zaayo oba kaweefube waayo mu butukuvu, n'ekwasa omulimu gwonna ogw'okukuumibwa okuva mu kibi Mukama yekka.”

Era ku nkomerero: “Ntandika okulaba bulungi nti Mukama asaanira okwesigwa okutakoma era okutaliiko nsalo; era oboolyawo kuno kwe kutandika okusooka okw'ekitangaala kye mbadde nnoonya. Nzikiriza ya Kimesodisti, era mmaze ebbanga ddene nga mpulira Abamesodisti nga banenyezebwa olw'ekyo, naye kiraga okuba ekintu kyokka ekituukiriza obwetaavu bwange, era nziggwa okugezaako.”

Nga Febwali 11, 1867, nnawandiika kaweefube wange ow'olubereberye ow'okukwata okukkiriza kuno okuwangula, era ne mpandiika nti: “Embeera y'emmeeme yange eya kaakano ye y'okwesiga Mukama. Era nzudde nti kino kya mazima agakola — ye ddala ye anunula. Okukemebwa bwe kujja, bwe nkyukira gy'ali amangwago n'okusaba nti, 'Mukama, ndokola. Siyinza kwerokola nze nnyini okuva mu kibi kino, naye ggwe osobola era ojja kukikola,' talemererwa n'akatono.

Oba akyusa ddala enneewulira zange oba anfuula okwerabira ensonga yonna — era obuwanguzi, oba nga bwe kiri obuwanguzi bwe, buba butuukiridde. Kino kya kyama eky'obulamu obwa Kikristaayo kye nnali sisookedde kumanya.

Naye lwaki ssaakimanya? Lwaki ekkubo lyange libadde ery'okusalasala era ery'ennaku bwe nnabadde nga nnandiyinzizza okubeera mu buwanguzi? Ndi kyokulabirako ekyeyoleka eky'okugoberera amateeka okw'obuzaaliranwa n'obutakkiriza obw'omutima gw'omuntu. Nga nnyesiga Mukama ddala olw'okuweebwa obutuukirivu kwange, bulijjo nneesiga nze nnyini olw'okutukuzibwa kwange.

Nneesiga kaweefube wange, ensala zange, okwekuuma, obunyiikivu, n'okufuba okutuukiriza obulamu obutukuvu. Kuno kwali kugoberera mateeka — kugoberera mateeka mu mazima nga singa nnali nneesiga ebintu bino okulokola emmeeme yange mu kusooka. Nnali 'ndemesa' ekisa kya Katonda mu kutukuzibwa nga bwe kimu abo be nnali nnenyezza ng'abagoberezi b'amateeka bwe baali bakiremesa mu kuweebwa obutuukirivu. Nnayinza okulaba mangu engeri gye baaggyaamu amakulu okufa kwa Kristo olwa kaweefube waabwe ow'amateeka, naye nnali muzibe eri ekituufu nti nange nnali nkola ekintu kye kimu. Okufuba kwabwe n'okwange kwawukana mu kiruubirirwa, naye mu mbeera zombi kyali kya nze so si kya Kristo. Kubanga 'obutuukirivu bwe buva mu mateeka, kale Kristo yafiira bwereere.'

Naye kaakano nga byonna bwe byawukana! Kaakano nkwasa obulamu bwange obwa buli lunaku gy'ali nga bwe nkwasa ekintu kyange eky'olubeerera. Nmwesiga bwe ntyo obwereere mu kimu nga bwe nkola mu kirala. Ndi munafu kyenkanyi mu byombi.

Siyinza kukola kintu — ne nze, 'omuntu omuggya' — era Mukama bw'atakola byonna, tewali kirikolebwa.

Era ayi, mazima ga kitiibwa — akikola ddala! Bwe mmwesiga, awa okununulibwa okuva mu buyinza bw'ekibi awamu n'okuva mu musango gwakyo. Nsobola okuteeka byonna mu kulabirira kwe — obuzibu bwange, okukemebwa kwange, okukula kwange, obuweereza bwange, obulamu bwange obwa buli lunaku, buli kaseera ne kaseera. Ayi, okuwummula n'okuteeka wabujja okw'okubeera bwe kutyo!

Era kuno kwe kumu 'omukisa ogw'obutukuvu' ogw'Abamesodisti. Kwe boogedde mu bigambo bye sikkiririzaamu ddala, era okwetooloddwa ekyo ekindabikira ng'okutabulatabula okw'obukyamu — naye nga kyategeerezebwa ddala era nga bakusanyukira. Nneebaza ddala olw'obujulizi bwabwe eri obw'amazima bwakwo. Era kaakano ndaba nti kisinga nnyo obulungi okuba n'obumanyirivu — ne bwe bwandibadde nga butabuddwamu obukyamu — okusinga okubeera awatali bwo n'oba omutuufu mu njigiriza, nga bwe nnali edda.”

Ekitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo eky'ekiseera kino kijjudde okuzuula okwewuunyisa kwe nnali nkola, naye ebiwuluddwa bino bimala. Okuva olwo, ebisoboka eby'okukkiriza byanjigulukukira mu ngeri ze nnali sirooteredde n'akatono. Nnalaba nti okukkiriza kwali ddala buwanguzi obuwangula ensi, era ne nneewuunya obuzibe bwange nti ssaali sisookedde kukutegeera.

Nate, kyawulikika ng'ekiremba kyaggibwako Baibuli, era ne kifuuka ekitabo ekiggya gye ndi: “Amazima agaali gange jjo Ge mazima amanene leero; Amaaso gaago gafuuse aga Katonda okusingawo, N'obwakabaka bwago obufuga obw'ekijjulo.

Kubanga amazima gateekwa okukula ng'emirembe giyita, Ne Katonda alabike omunene mu mmeeme.

Olunaku olumu nnali ku lukuŋŋaana omwogezi we yasomera Yokaana 15, era ebigambo “Awatali Nze temuyinza kukola kintu” byankwatako n'amaanyi agamalamu omukka. Nnali nsomye era ne njuliza ebigambo bino emirundi ebikumi — ne mbuulirako. Naye kaakano ne byaka n'amakulu ne kiba nti kyawulikika ng'ebyali byaakayongerwa mu Baibuli. Wano Mukama yali ayogera lwatu nti, “Awatali Nze temuyinza kukola kintu,” songa ebbanga lyonna nnali nnowoozezza nti nnayinza — era nnali nteekwa — okukola ebingi bwe bityo.

Amakulu ki ge nnali mpadde edda ekigambo “tewali kintu”? Nnagezaako okujjukira, naye waaliwo bbanga ereere lyokka. Nnali sisookedde kukiraba ddala.

Olunaku olulala nnasoma ekitundu ekiri mu Matayo 6 Yesu we yatugamba “muleme kweraliikirira bulamu bwammwe,” kubanga Kitaffe ali mu ggulu atufaako — ng'ajuliza ebinyonyi eby'omu bbanga n'amalanga ag'omu nnimiro, era ng'atujjukiza nti tuli ba muwendo munene nnyo okusinga. Nnasoma ekitundu ekyo emirundi mingi mu kwewuunya okungi. Kyandiyinza okuba nga kya mazima? Kyali kikyaali mu Baibuli emyaka gino gyonna? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, nnali sirabye kitya? Songa si nti nnali sikirabye — nnali nkijjukidde era nnakyogeranga bulijjo. Naye mu makulu gokka agagasa, nnali sisookedde kukiraba.

Kaakano nnakiraba — era ku kulaba okwo, okufaayo kwange, okweraliikirira kwange, entiisa yange, n'obweralikirivu bwange ne bibula ng'olufu mu maaso g'enjuba.

Ekyo kye kimu kyaliwo ku Byawandiikibwa byonna ebimanyiddwa — byamulisibwa n'amakulu amaggya ddala. Buli lupapula lwalangirira, ng'oyita mu kkondeere, obw'amazima obw'obulamu obwa Kikristaayo obw'obuwanguzi obubeerwamu olw'okukkiriza mu Yesu Kristo. Emmeeme yange yonna yayaka olw'okuzuula okwo. Ssaayinza kulowooza oba kwogera ku kirala okuggyako katono. Nnali nzudde ekintu ku bulokozi bwa Kristo kye nnali sirowoozangako — ekintu ekyakakasa nti yali Mulokozi atuukiridde ennyo okusinga bwe nnali sikitegedde.

Nnalaba nti yali si Mulokozi wange olw'ebiseera eby'omu maaso kyokka wabula Mulokozi wange amala byonna olwa kaakano.

Omuduumizi wange okulwana entalo zange nze ndyoke nneme okuzirwana nzennyini. Eyeetikka emigugu gyange nze ndyoke nyingulule emigugu gyange okuva ku bibegabega byange ebinafu. Ekigo kyange eri abalabe bange. Engabo yange, Omuluŋŋamya wange, Omubudaabudi wange, Omusumba wange. Ssaayongera kwetaaga kwekuuma, kwewolereza, oba kwerwanirira nze nnyini. Buli kintu kyali mu mikono gy'Oyo ow'amaanyi okulokola — era kiki ekirala kye nnayinza okukola okuggyako okumwesiga?

Tewali bigambo biyinza kunnyonnyola okujjuvu n'okumala kwe nnazuula nga kutereke mu Mukama. Ssaayinza kwekuumira mawulire ga kitiibwa bwe gatyo. Buli eyansemberera yateekebwa okuwulira olugero lwange.

Omu ku baasooka be nnategeeza yali mwannyinaze gwe nnayogeddeko emabegako — oyo eyali asobeddwa enjigiriza yange nti wadde ng'ebibi byaffe byasonyiyibwa, twali tuteekwa okusigala nga baddu ku buyinza bw'ekibi obulamu bwaffe bwonna. Nnakwata akakisa akasooka okumuyita akyale, era amangwago bwe yatuuka, nnaleekaana nti: “Ayi, Carrie, ndina ekintu eky'ekitalo eky'okukubuulira. Tetuteekwa kufiirwa daakiika!”

Amangwago bwe twasigala ffekka, nnayiwa okuzuula kwange — nti mu Kristo temuli kusonyiyibwa kwa kibi kwokka wabula n'okununulibwa okuva mu buyinza bwakyo, era nti tetukyeetaaga kubeera ng'abaddu b'ekibi wabula tuyinza okuba abasingirira ddala ku bwe.

Yampuliriza n'okwewuunya, n'okwesittala, ng'endabika ye yeeyongera okwewuunya ku buli sentensi. Ku nkomerero yabwatuka nti: “Naye Hannah, otegeeza ki? Bulijjo wantegeezanga nti wadde nga wali mwana wa Katonda, tewali kununulibwa kwe wandisuubidde okuva mu kibi oba mu kweraliikirira — nti Adamu ow'edda yali w'amaanyi nnyo era obuzaaliranwa obuggya nga bunafu nnyo. Bwe nnakyusibwa, nnasuubira ddala okununulibwa okuva mu kibi n'obutewombeefu, naye bwe nnakubuuza ku ekyo, wagamba nti tekisoboka mu bulamu buno. Era nnakukkiriza!

Ne kaakano oyogera ekyawukana. Kisobera nnyo — simanyi kya kulowooza!

Nnakkiriza nti kyasobera, naye bwali butamanya, si bukyayi, obwannyamba okuyigiriza endowooza eyo eyonoonese bwe kityo. Kaakano nga nzudde ekintu ekisingira ddala obulungi mu njiri, kye twali tuteekwa okukola kwokka kwali kwabulira awo obukyamu obukadde n'okwaniriza amazima amaggya agatulaziddwa.

Mwannyinaze — eyali ebbanga lyonna awulidde mu buzaaliranwa nti endowooza enkadde teyandiyinzizza kukiikirira ekisinga obulungi Kristo kye yalina okuwaayo — yaaniriza enjigiriza empya n'obunyiikivu era n'agibeeramu obwesigwa obusingira ddala bwe nnakola.

Enkola ey'olwatu ey'okuzuula kwange yanneewuunyisa. Nnawaayo omwoyo gwange gwonna ogujeemu eri Mukama ne mmugamba nti ssaayinza kuguwangula naye nnakkiriza nti ye yali ayinza okuguwangula ku lwange. Awo ne nvaayo ku bbali, ng'oyinza okugamba, ne ndeka olutalo gy'ali. Ku ssanyu lyange eritanyonnyoleka, yaggyawo obujeemu bwange bwonna n'aguzzaamu okukkiriza kw'okusiima ky'ayagala okw'emirembe ne kiba nti obulamu obwali bulabise ng'obutasanyusa kaakano ne bulabika ng'obusanyusa — ne busikiriza. Nnasobola okugamba “Ky'oyagala kikolebwe” n'okwebaza okw'amazima.

Okuzuula kwange kweyeeraga okuba obuwanguzi obw'olwatu, era nnasanyuka. Nnakugezesa mu ngeri ezitabalika — era tekwalemererwa n'omulundi gumu. Ekyokulabirako kimu naddala kisigala nga kikyakaayakana mu birowoozo byange.

Waatuuka ekiseera lwe nnayisibwa mu ngeri gye nnawulira ng'etali ya bwenkanya ddala — etaali ya nsonga mu kiseera ekyo, era ekyali etaali ya nsonga ne kaakano bwe ndabako emabega. Nnawulira nga nnyiizibbwa nnyo era nnakemebwa nnyo okudda mu busungu obwekwese obw'ekiseera ekiwanvu, nga nnganya okusirika kwange n'obunnyogovu bwange okwoleka obusungu bwe nnawulira nnyo.

Naye amangwago okukemebwa bwe kwajja, nnalaba mangu ekkubo ery'okuwona. Nnayanguwa okuba nzekka, okumpi nga ndduka okugenda mu kisenge kyange eky'okwebaka kubanga nnali njjudde obusungu ne kiba nti ssaayinza na kutambula kasirise. Nnaggalawo enzigi n'amaanyi emabega wange, nga neetaaga nnyo obwerere okumaliriza olutalo.

Bwe nnasigala nzekka, nnafukamira ne nsaba nti: “Mukama, nsunguwadde. Njagala kusunguwala. Era mu bwesimbu, ndowooza nnina ensonga ennungi.

Naye mmanyi nti sisaanira kukigondera, era njagala obuwanguzi. Ensonga eno yonna ngikuwa. Siyinza kulwana lutalo luno — Ggwe oteekwa okulunnwanirira. Yesu andokola kaakano.”

Nnayogera ebigambo ebyo omutima gwange nga gukyawulira nga gujeemye ddala. Ku bweru, oboolyawo kyalabika ng'ekigambo eky'obulimba kye nnali nnangirira. Ssaawulira nga nnokolebwa okuva mu busungu bwange, era tekyalabika n'akatono ng'ekisoboka nti nnandisobodde. Naye olw'okukkiriza nnanywerera ku mazima, nga nkakata — ne wakati mu kutabukatabuka — nti Mukama yali ayinza era yali andokola kaakano.

Awo ne kiryoka kibaawo.

Amangwago, obuteefu obwaka ng'enkya ey'ekiseera eky'ebbugumu bwankka. Obukyayi bwange bwonna ne bubula.

Obusungu bwange ne busaanuuka. Nnawulira nga siriiko kufaayo era nga nsanyufu ng'ekinyonyi mu musana, nga nsanyukira embeera yennyini eyali eyaakannyiiza akaseera nga tekannaba kuyita. Okukkiriza kwange kwali kukutte ekituufu ekya Katonda: Katonda yali asobola okununula, era yanunula ddala emmeeme eyamwesiga.

Nnategeera nga mazima ga kyewuunyo gatya nti ssaali nneetaaga kulwana ntalo zange n'akatono. Mukama yandinnwaniridde, era nnayinza obutasituka busitufu. Okuva ku lunaku olwo, entalo ez'ekika ekyo ebikumi zaalwanibwa — ne ziwangulwa — ku lwange Omuduumizi w'Obulokozi bwange. Ekyama kye nnayiga olwo, eky'okuteeka olutalo lwonna mu mikono gye n'okuvaayo ku bbali okumuganya okulwana, tekyalemererwa n'omulundi gumu bwe nkikola. Kyeyeeraze emirundi n'emirundi okuba obujulizi obulamu obw'ebigambo bya Kristo nti: “Musanyuke — Nywangudde ensi.”

Ye yagiwangula — si ffe — era bulijjo aligiwangula, singa tunaawaayo ensonga mu mikono gye.

Tewali mulundi na gumu, bwe nnakola kino, lwe nnanyiizibwa. Kya mazima ga kitiibwa — wadde ng'abatono nnyo be balabika okukitegeera — nti asobola okulokola ddala abo abajja eri Katonda ku bubwe, kubanga abeera omulamu emirembe gyonna okubawolereza. Yali asobola bwe waawandiikibwa Ebbaluwa eri Abaebbulaniya, era asobola bwe kimu ne kaakano, kubanga si mufu — akyali mulamu okutuwolereza.

Nnali nzudde nti okukkiriza kwe tteeka erifuga obwengula. Katonda yayogera, ne kikolebwa; era bwe twesiga ye, naffe tuyinza okwogera, ne kikolebwa. Ekitangaala ekiggya ekimasamasa kyaka ku bigambo ebiri mu 1 Yokaana 5:14–15: “Buno bwe bugumu bwe tulina mu ye: nti bwe tusaba ekintu kyonna nga bw'ayagala, atuwulira. Era bwe tumanya nti atuwulira, kyonna kye tusaba, tumanya nti tulina kye tumusabye.”

Bulijjo nnalowoozanga nti ebigambo bwe bityo byali birowoozo birungi byokka — biroota ebimasamasa eby'obulamu obwa Kikristaayo omuntu yenna ow'amagezi bye yandisuubidde okufunako ku nsi. Naye kaakano nnalaba nti tebyali biroota n'akatono, wabula bigambo bya butereevu eby'etteeka erya Katonda: etteeka ery'okukkiriza, ery'amazima era eryesigika ng'etteeka ery'okusika kw'ensi, singa omuntu akitegeera.

Kristo atugamba emirundi n'emirundi nti kiritubeerera ng'okukkiriza kwaffe bwe kuli, era alangirira awatali kukoma nti byonna bisoboka eri oyo akkiriza. Nnali nteebereza nti kuno kwali kwongera kwa bunyonyi. Kaakano nnategeera: yali annyonnyola bunnyonnyozi amateeka ag'obwakabaka obw'omwoyo — amateeka omuntu yenna g'ayinza okugezesa n'okukakasa. Okukkiriza kutuyunga ku maanyi ga Katonda ag'amaanyi gonna, ne kisoboka obunafu bwaffe okusika obwerere ku maanyi ge. Ebisoboka byakwo byalabika ng'ebitakoma.

“Okukkiriza, okukkiriza okw'amaanyi, kulaba ekisuubizo Ne kutunuulira ekyo kyokka; Kusekerera ebitasoboka, Ne kuleekaana nti, 'Kirikolebwa.'”

Nnandyagadde okugamba nti okuva mu kaseera ako okugenda mu maaso nnabeeranga bulijjo mu maanyi g'etteeka lino erya Katonda. Sikoze bwe ntyo. Naye nsobola okugamba kino: buli lwe nsalawo mu bugenderevu okukwata ku maanyi ga Katonda olw'okukkiriza, amaanyi ge gatuukirizibbwa mu bunafu bwange, era mbadde muwanguzi. Emirundi n'emirundi nsobodde okuddamu ebigambo by'omutume eby'obuwanguzi nti: “Mu bino byonna tuli basingirira ddala ku oyo eyatwagala.”
fields.body_text: Obutewombeefu buno n'okwebuuza kwatuuka ku ntikko yaakwo mu 1865. Olw'embeera ez'omu maka, twali tuteekwa okuva mu maka gaffe amasanyufu e Germantown — wamu n'ekibiina kyaffe kyonna ekigazi eky'ebyo bye twali twagala — ne tusenguka okudda mu kyalo eky'ewala mu New Jersey, gye twagenda okusalibwako ddala ku buntu bwonna obw'emikwano. Mu by'ensimbi, kyali kya nkizo, naye mu ngeri endala yonna kyali kigezo kinene, naddala gye ndi. Nnyatula nti omwoyo gwange gwajeema n'obukyayi eri enkyukakyuka eyo. Saalowooza nti mu kifo kino kyennyini, ekyawulikika ng'ekyereere era ekyawukanyiziddwa, ekitangaala ekiggya eky'ekitiibwa kyandimulisizza, nga kireeta omulembe ogwokuna era ogusinga ogw'obulamu bwange obw'omwoyo. Kyaliwo bwe kiti. Nga bwe njogedde, nnali njeemye nnyo ku kusenguka. Naye nnali n'okutegeera kw'omwoyo okumala okumanya nti obujeemu buno bwali bubi. Olwokubanga okusenguka kyali kya lwatu nteekateeka ya Katonda esukka obuyinza bwange, eky'okuddamu ekituufu ekyokka kyali kukikkiriza n'essanyu era ne ŋŋamba mu mazima nti, “Ky'oyagala kikolebwe.” Naye wadde nga nneenenyanga buli kaseera, ssaasobola kukkiriza kya Katonda ky'ayagala — era mu mazima, ssaayagala kukikkiriza. Nnawulira nti kyali kikolwa kikambwe okuwalirizibwa okuva mu maka gange amasanyufu ag'e Germantown n'ekifo kyange eky'omugaso okubeera mu kifo eky'obwerere era eky'ewala nga Millville. Kyandabikira nti Katonda teyandikkirizza kino kubaawo, era nti nnali n'obuyinza bwonna okwemulugunya n'okweraliikirira. Ekyavaamu kwe kuba nti nnagwa mu mbeera y'ebirowoozo etazza wabujja ennyo. N'enjigiriza zange ennyonnyofu ne zisoba okunnyamba nate, era nnatandika okutya nti nnali ŋŋenda kufiirwa obwomwoyo bwonna bwe nnali nsigazza. Mu maaso g'obwetaavu obw'amazima bwe butyo, tekyali kya kubudaabudibwa kumanya nti nnali nsonyiyiddwa. Nnayagala ekisukka okusonyiyibwa — nnayagala okununulibwa. Naye ssaalina kirowoozo ku ngeri gye nnandikufunyemu. Olwokubanga bulijjo twafunanga ababuulizi b'Obweereza abatukyalira, nnannyonnyola ensonga yange eri abamu ku bo ne mbasaba obuyambi, naye tewaali n'omu eyayinza okuntegeeza kintu kya mugaso. Ku nkomerero, omuyigiriza w'eddiini ow'obuwanguzi ennyo yajja okumala ennaku ntono, era gy'ali nnayiwa obuzibu bwange bwonna, nga mmwegayirira okunsalira ekkubo erimu ery'okununulibwa. Yalowooza ku mbeera yange n'obwesimbu era ku nkomerero n'agamba nti yakkiririza nti kye nnali nneetaaga kwali kwenyigira mu mulimu erimu ogwa Kikristaayo. Singa nnafuluma enkeera okukyalira abaavu ab'omu kitundu kyaffe ne ndaba engeri gye nnandibayambyemu, yalowooza nti obulamu bwange obw'omwoyo bwandizzeemu obuggya era nga byonna byandigenze bulungi. Bwe kityo enkeera, nnagezaako eddagala lye yansalira. Naye amangu nnazuula obutaliimu bwalyo. Okumpi mu nnyumba esooka mwe nnayingira nnasangamu omukazi eyali alwanagana n'obuzibu bw'omwoyo bwe bumu obwange, era yali ayagala nnyo obuyambi — nga nze siriiko bwe nnali nnina okuwaayo. Nnawulira ng'omuntu agezaako okuliisa abalumwa enjala okuva mu bbakuli enkalu. Kyali mulimu gwa busirusiru era ogutasoboka. Nnadda eka nga nnamalidde amaanyi okusinga bulijjo, nga nkakasibwa nti nga sinnayamba muntu mulala yenna, nnandisoose kwezuulira kununulibwa nze nnyini. Waaliwo omutunzi w'engoye ow'omu kitundu eyajjanga bulijjo okuntungira, era olwokubanga nnalina buntu buke nnyo obw'emikwano mu kyalo, oluusi nnatuulanga ne twogera naye nga tukola. Yalabika ng'ow'omwoyo mu ngeri etaali ya bulijjo, era nnasikirizibwa obumanyirivu bwe. Nnazuula nti yakkiririza mu buwanguzi obw'amazima ku kukemebwa — nti tekyali kyetaagisa, nga bwe nnali ndowoozezza, okuyita mu bulamu nga tujooneka ne twenenya, tujooneka ne twenenya, wabula nti Omukristaayo yali ayinza okununulibwa ddala. Yantegeeza nti mu Bamesodisti mwaliwo enjigiriza eyayitibwanga “Obutukuvu,” n'obumanyirivu obwagenda nabwo obwayitibwanga “okutukuzibwa,” oba “omukisa ogwokubiri,” obwaleeta abantu mu kifo eky'obuwanguzi. Nnasikirizibwa nnyo buli kye yayogera, era nnatandika okusuubira nti oboolyawo wano we wandibadde eky'okugonjoola okulwanagana kwange. Era yantegeeza nti waaliwo olukuŋŋaana olutono lwe baakubiranga mu kyalo ku Lwomukaaga akawungeezi enjigiriza eno gye yayigirizibwanga era abantu gye baagabananga obumanyirivu bwabwe. Yankubiriza okugendayo. Nnalowooza nti nnandigenzeeyo lumu, naye nnaganya ebintu ebirala okuziyiza. Nnali nkakasibwa nti abaavu, abakozi b'amakolero abatasomesebwa, tebayinza kubaako kintu kye bandinjigirizza. Nnali njize ne nyigiriza Baibuli ennyo era nnalina endowooza waggulu ku bye nnali ntuuseeko mu by'eddiini. Nnawulira nti singa nnagenda ku lukuŋŋaana, oboolyawo nandibadde n'ebingi eby'okubayigiriza okusinga bye bandibadde n'okunjigiriza. Kyokka ku nkomerero, akawungeezi kamu nnasalawo okubawa ekisa eky'okubeerawo kwange — era nnyatula, nnawulira nti kyali kisa kinene. Nnagenda ku lukuŋŋaana nga nzijjudde obukulu bwange n'obusukkulumu bwange, nga nsuubira okubeewuunyisa n'okumanya kwange okw'ebya Baibuli. Bwe nnayingira, omukazi ow'oku kkolero ng'aliko oluwewo ku mutwe gwe — oboolyawo yali talina nkuufiira — yali ayogera. Nnamuwulira ng'agamba nti: “Amaaso gange gonna edda gaajjuzibwanga Nze wange ono omunene ennyo, naye bwe nnafuna akatunuulo ka Kristo ng'Omulokozi wange atuukiridde, Nze oyo omunene ennyo yakalira n'afuuka busa.” Ebigambo ebyo byali kubikkulirwa gye ndi. Nnategeera nti saamanya kintu na kimu ku bumanyirivu bwe butyo. “Nze” wange yali munene nnyo era nga yeekakaasa nnyo, era saasobola kulowooza ngeri gye yandiyinzizza “okukendeera n'afuuka busa.” Naye obukakafu obungi ne bunjijira nti kino kiteekwa okuba Obukristaayo obw'amazima — era oboolyawo ekintu kyennyini kye nnali nnaayaanira. Tekyetaagisa kugamba nti, ssaagezaako kuyigiriza kwonna ekiro ekyo. Mu kifo ky'ekyo nnatuula ng'omuyizi ku bigere by'Abakristaayo bano abeetoowaza, abaamanya bitono ku by'okuyiga mu bitabo naye ng'emmeeme zaabwe zaali ziyigirizibwa lwatu Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu buziba bw'amazima ag'omwoyo bwe nnali sinnakwatako. Nnatandika okugenda ku lukuŋŋaana bulijjo ng'omuyizi, era nnakozesa buli kakisa kye nnayinza okwogera n'abo abaategeera ekkubo lino ery'obulamu. Nnazuula nti entobo yaalyo yali kye kimu Pawulo kye yategeeza bwe yawandiika nti, “Si nze, wabula Kristo” — nti obuwanguzi bwe nnanoonya bwandijjidde okuva mu kulekera awo okubeera n'obulamu bwange nze nnyini n'okuganya amaanyi ga Katonda “okukola mu nze okwagala n'okukola nga bw'asiima.” Mu kitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo, ekya Okitobba 18, 1866, nnawandiika nti: “Mukama abadde anjigiriza mu ngeri nnyingi mu biseera bino obunafu bwange obutuufu mu maaso g'okukemebwa. Nkuze nnyo mu kumanya, naye si mu kisa, era nsanga nti sirina maanyi ga mazima ku kibi okusinga ge nnalina bwe nnasooka okukyusibwa. Kino tekinneetedde kubuusabuusa nti ndi mwana wa Katonda — eyaweebwa obutuukirivu, eyasonyiyibwa, alina obulamu obutaggwaawo, era omusika w'obusika obw'omu ggulu. Naye ne n'okukakasibwa kuno, siyinza kubeera musanyufu ng'omutima gwange gunsalira omusango. Nneegomba obutukuvu obungi, amaanyi amangi ku kibi, enkolagana etamenyeka na Katonda. Naye simanyi ngeri gye nnandikutuuseeko. Ensala tezirina mugaso; kaweefube wange wa bwereere. Okusaba kwange tekuddibwamu. Emirundi olukumi mbadde mwetegefu okuwaŋŋula mu kuggwaamu essuubi ne nsalawo nti si kya Katonda ky'ayagala nze okuba n'obuwanguzi ku kibi. Songa Baibuli eraga ekifaananyi eky'enjawulo ddala — 'ataliiko musango, atalina bulabe, atalina kunenyezebwa'; nga buli kukemebwa kuliko 'ekkubo ery'okuwona'; 'atukuzibbwa'; 'afaananyiziddwa ekifaananyi kya Kristo'; 'mutukuvu nga ye bw'ali omutukuvu.'” Awo ne mpandiika nti: “Nsanga nti waliwo Abakristaayo abagamba nti nga tuweebwa Kristo olw'okukkiriza olw'okutukuzibwa kwaffe, nga bwe twamufuna olw'okukkiriza olw'okuweebwa obutuukirivu, omulimu guno gwonna gwe nneegomba gukolebwa — kwe kugamba, engeri ey'okugukola ezuuliddwa. Bagamba nti Baibuli eyigiriza nti Mukama ayinza okununula okuva mu buyinza bw'ekibi awamu n'okuva mu musango gwakyo, era nti emmeeme eyiga okumwesiga okukikola, ng'elekera awo okwesiga ensala zaayo oba kaweefube waayo mu butukuvu, n'ekwasa omulimu gwonna ogw'okukuumibwa okuva mu kibi Mukama yekka.” Era ku nkomerero: “Ntandika okulaba bulungi nti Mukama asaanira okwesigwa okutakoma era okutaliiko nsalo; era oboolyawo kuno kwe kutandika okusooka okw'ekitangaala kye mbadde nnoonya. Nzikiriza ya Kimesodisti, era mmaze ebbanga ddene nga mpulira Abamesodisti nga banenyezebwa olw'ekyo, naye kiraga okuba ekintu kyokka ekituukiriza obwetaavu bwange, era nziggwa okugezaako.” Nga Febwali 11, 1867, nnawandiika kaweefube wange ow'olubereberye ow'okukwata okukkiriza kuno okuwangula, era ne mpandiika nti: “Embeera y'emmeeme yange eya kaakano ye y'okwesiga Mukama. Era nzudde nti kino kya mazima agakola — ye ddala ye anunula. Okukemebwa bwe kujja, bwe nkyukira gy'ali amangwago n'okusaba nti, 'Mukama, ndokola. Siyinza kwerokola nze nnyini okuva mu kibi kino, naye ggwe osobola era ojja kukikola,' talemererwa n'akatono. Oba akyusa ddala enneewulira zange oba anfuula okwerabira ensonga yonna — era obuwanguzi, oba nga bwe kiri obuwanguzi bwe, buba butuukiridde. Kino kya kyama eky'obulamu obwa Kikristaayo kye nnali sisookedde kumanya. Naye lwaki ssaakimanya? Lwaki ekkubo lyange libadde ery'okusalasala era ery'ennaku bwe nnabadde nga nnandiyinzizza okubeera mu buwanguzi? Ndi kyokulabirako ekyeyoleka eky'okugoberera amateeka okw'obuzaaliranwa n'obutakkiriza obw'omutima gw'omuntu. Nga nnyesiga Mukama ddala olw'okuweebwa obutuukirivu kwange, bulijjo nneesiga nze nnyini olw'okutukuzibwa kwange. Nneesiga kaweefube wange, ensala zange, okwekuuma, obunyiikivu, n'okufuba okutuukiriza obulamu obutukuvu. Kuno kwali kugoberera mateeka — kugoberera mateeka mu mazima nga singa nnali nneesiga ebintu bino okulokola emmeeme yange mu kusooka. Nnali 'ndemesa' ekisa kya Katonda mu kutukuzibwa nga bwe kimu abo be nnali nnenyezza ng'abagoberezi b'amateeka bwe baali bakiremesa mu kuweebwa obutuukirivu. Nnayinza okulaba mangu engeri gye baaggyaamu amakulu okufa kwa Kristo olwa kaweefube waabwe ow'amateeka, naye nnali muzibe eri ekituufu nti nange nnali nkola ekintu kye kimu. Okufuba kwabwe n'okwange kwawukana mu kiruubirirwa, naye mu mbeera zombi kyali kya nze so si kya Kristo. Kubanga 'obutuukirivu bwe buva mu mateeka, kale Kristo yafiira bwereere.' Naye kaakano nga byonna bwe byawukana! Kaakano nkwasa obulamu bwange obwa buli lunaku gy'ali nga bwe nkwasa ekintu kyange eky'olubeerera. Nmwesiga bwe ntyo obwereere mu kimu nga bwe nkola mu kirala. Ndi munafu kyenkanyi mu byombi. Siyinza kukola kintu — ne nze, 'omuntu omuggya' — era Mukama bw'atakola byonna, tewali kirikolebwa. Era ayi, mazima ga kitiibwa — akikola ddala! Bwe mmwesiga, awa okununulibwa okuva mu buyinza bw'ekibi awamu n'okuva mu musango gwakyo. Nsobola okuteeka byonna mu kulabirira kwe — obuzibu bwange, okukemebwa kwange, okukula kwange, obuweereza bwange, obulamu bwange obwa buli lunaku, buli kaseera ne kaseera. Ayi, okuwummula n'okuteeka wabujja okw'okubeera bwe kutyo! Era kuno kwe kumu 'omukisa ogw'obutukuvu' ogw'Abamesodisti. Kwe boogedde mu bigambo bye sikkiririzaamu ddala, era okwetooloddwa ekyo ekindabikira ng'okutabulatabula okw'obukyamu — naye nga kyategeerezebwa ddala era nga bakusanyukira. Nneebaza ddala olw'obujulizi bwabwe eri obw'amazima bwakwo. Era kaakano ndaba nti kisinga nnyo obulungi okuba n'obumanyirivu — ne bwe bwandibadde nga butabuddwamu obukyamu — okusinga okubeera awatali bwo n'oba omutuufu mu njigiriza, nga bwe nnali edda.” Ekitabo kyange eky'ebyafaayo eky'ekiseera kino kijjudde okuzuula okwewuunyisa kwe nnali nkola, naye ebiwuluddwa bino bimala. Okuva olwo, ebisoboka eby'okukkiriza byanjigulukukira mu ngeri ze nnali sirooteredde n'akatono. Nnalaba nti okukkiriza kwali ddala buwanguzi obuwangula ensi, era ne nneewuunya obuzibe bwange nti ssaali sisookedde kukutegeera. Nate, kyawulikika ng'ekiremba kyaggibwako Baibuli, era ne kifuuka ekitabo ekiggya gye ndi: “Amazima agaali gange jjo Ge mazima amanene leero; Amaaso gaago gafuuse aga Katonda okusingawo, N'obwakabaka bwago obufuga obw'ekijjulo. Kubanga amazima gateekwa okukula ng'emirembe giyita, Ne Katonda alabike omunene mu mmeeme. Olunaku olumu nnali ku lukuŋŋaana omwogezi we yasomera Yokaana 15, era ebigambo “Awatali Nze temuyinza kukola kintu” byankwatako n'amaanyi agamalamu omukka. Nnali nsomye era ne njuliza ebigambo bino emirundi ebikumi — ne mbuulirako. Naye kaakano ne byaka n'amakulu ne kiba nti kyawulikika ng'ebyali byaakayongerwa mu Baibuli. Wano Mukama yali ayogera lwatu nti, “Awatali Nze temuyinza kukola kintu,” songa ebbanga lyonna nnali nnowoozezza nti nnayinza — era nnali nteekwa — okukola ebingi bwe bityo. Amakulu ki ge nnali mpadde edda ekigambo “tewali kintu”? Nnagezaako okujjukira, naye waaliwo bbanga ereere lyokka. Nnali sisookedde kukiraba ddala. Olunaku olulala nnasoma ekitundu ekiri mu Matayo 6 Yesu we yatugamba “muleme kweraliikirira bulamu bwammwe,” kubanga Kitaffe ali mu ggulu atufaako — ng'ajuliza ebinyonyi eby'omu bbanga n'amalanga ag'omu nnimiro, era ng'atujjukiza nti tuli ba muwendo munene nnyo okusinga. Nnasoma ekitundu ekyo emirundi mingi mu kwewuunya okungi. Kyandiyinza okuba nga kya mazima? Kyali kikyaali mu Baibuli emyaka gino gyonna? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, nnali sirabye kitya? Songa si nti nnali sikirabye — nnali nkijjukidde era nnakyogeranga bulijjo. Naye mu makulu gokka agagasa, nnali sisookedde kukiraba. Kaakano nnakiraba — era ku kulaba okwo, okufaayo kwange, okweraliikirira kwange, entiisa yange, n'obweralikirivu bwange ne bibula ng'olufu mu maaso g'enjuba. Ekyo kye kimu kyaliwo ku Byawandiikibwa byonna ebimanyiddwa — byamulisibwa n'amakulu amaggya ddala. Buli lupapula lwalangirira, ng'oyita mu kkondeere, obw'amazima obw'obulamu obwa Kikristaayo obw'obuwanguzi obubeerwamu olw'okukkiriza mu Yesu Kristo. Emmeeme yange yonna yayaka olw'okuzuula okwo. Ssaayinza kulowooza oba kwogera ku kirala okuggyako katono. Nnali nzudde ekintu ku bulokozi bwa Kristo kye nnali sirowoozangako — ekintu ekyakakasa nti yali Mulokozi atuukiridde ennyo okusinga bwe nnali sikitegedde. Nnalaba nti yali si Mulokozi wange olw'ebiseera eby'omu maaso kyokka wabula Mulokozi wange amala byonna olwa kaakano. Omuduumizi wange okulwana entalo zange nze ndyoke nneme okuzirwana nzennyini. Eyeetikka emigugu gyange nze ndyoke nyingulule emigugu gyange okuva ku bibegabega byange ebinafu. Ekigo kyange eri abalabe bange. Engabo yange, Omuluŋŋamya wange, Omubudaabudi wange, Omusumba wange. Ssaayongera kwetaaga kwekuuma, kwewolereza, oba kwerwanirira nze nnyini. Buli kintu kyali mu mikono gy'Oyo ow'amaanyi okulokola — era kiki ekirala kye nnayinza okukola okuggyako okumwesiga? Tewali bigambo biyinza kunnyonnyola okujjuvu n'okumala kwe nnazuula nga kutereke mu Mukama. Ssaayinza kwekuumira mawulire ga kitiibwa bwe gatyo. Buli eyansemberera yateekebwa okuwulira olugero lwange. Omu ku baasooka be nnategeeza yali mwannyinaze gwe nnayogeddeko emabegako — oyo eyali asobeddwa enjigiriza yange nti wadde ng'ebibi byaffe byasonyiyibwa, twali tuteekwa okusigala nga baddu ku buyinza bw'ekibi obulamu bwaffe bwonna. Nnakwata akakisa akasooka okumuyita akyale, era amangwago bwe yatuuka, nnaleekaana nti: “Ayi, Carrie, ndina ekintu eky'ekitalo eky'okukubuulira. Tetuteekwa kufiirwa daakiika!” Amangwago bwe twasigala ffekka, nnayiwa okuzuula kwange — nti mu Kristo temuli kusonyiyibwa kwa kibi kwokka wabula n'okununulibwa okuva mu buyinza bwakyo, era nti tetukyeetaaga kubeera ng'abaddu b'ekibi wabula tuyinza okuba abasingirira ddala ku bwe. Yampuliriza n'okwewuunya, n'okwesittala, ng'endabika ye yeeyongera okwewuunya ku buli sentensi. Ku nkomerero yabwatuka nti: “Naye Hannah, otegeeza ki? Bulijjo wantegeezanga nti wadde nga wali mwana wa Katonda, tewali kununulibwa kwe wandisuubidde okuva mu kibi oba mu kweraliikirira — nti Adamu ow'edda yali w'amaanyi nnyo era obuzaaliranwa obuggya nga bunafu nnyo. Bwe nnakyusibwa, nnasuubira ddala okununulibwa okuva mu kibi n'obutewombeefu, naye bwe nnakubuuza ku ekyo, wagamba nti tekisoboka mu bulamu buno. Era nnakukkiriza! Ne kaakano oyogera ekyawukana. Kisobera nnyo — simanyi kya kulowooza! Nnakkiriza nti kyasobera, naye bwali butamanya, si bukyayi, obwannyamba okuyigiriza endowooza eyo eyonoonese bwe kityo. Kaakano nga nzudde ekintu ekisingira ddala obulungi mu njiri, kye twali tuteekwa okukola kwokka kwali kwabulira awo obukyamu obukadde n'okwaniriza amazima amaggya agatulaziddwa. Mwannyinaze — eyali ebbanga lyonna awulidde mu buzaaliranwa nti endowooza enkadde teyandiyinzizza kukiikirira ekisinga obulungi Kristo kye yalina okuwaayo — yaaniriza enjigiriza empya n'obunyiikivu era n'agibeeramu obwesigwa obusingira ddala bwe nnakola. Enkola ey'olwatu ey'okuzuula kwange yanneewuunyisa. Nnawaayo omwoyo gwange gwonna ogujeemu eri Mukama ne mmugamba nti ssaayinza kuguwangula naye nnakkiriza nti ye yali ayinza okuguwangula ku lwange. Awo ne nvaayo ku bbali, ng'oyinza okugamba, ne ndeka olutalo gy'ali. Ku ssanyu lyange eritanyonnyoleka, yaggyawo obujeemu bwange bwonna n'aguzzaamu okukkiriza kw'okusiima ky'ayagala okw'emirembe ne kiba nti obulamu obwali bulabise ng'obutasanyusa kaakano ne bulabika ng'obusanyusa — ne busikiriza. Nnasobola okugamba “Ky'oyagala kikolebwe” n'okwebaza okw'amazima. Okuzuula kwange kweyeeraga okuba obuwanguzi obw'olwatu, era nnasanyuka. Nnakugezesa mu ngeri ezitabalika — era tekwalemererwa n'omulundi gumu. Ekyokulabirako kimu naddala kisigala nga kikyakaayakana mu birowoozo byange. Waatuuka ekiseera lwe nnayisibwa mu ngeri gye nnawulira ng'etali ya bwenkanya ddala — etaali ya nsonga mu kiseera ekyo, era ekyali etaali ya nsonga ne kaakano bwe ndabako emabega. Nnawulira nga nnyiizibbwa nnyo era nnakemebwa nnyo okudda mu busungu obwekwese obw'ekiseera ekiwanvu, nga nnganya okusirika kwange n'obunnyogovu bwange okwoleka obusungu bwe nnawulira nnyo. Naye amangwago okukemebwa bwe kwajja, nnalaba mangu ekkubo ery'okuwona. Nnayanguwa okuba nzekka, okumpi nga ndduka okugenda mu kisenge kyange eky'okwebaka kubanga nnali njjudde obusungu ne kiba nti ssaayinza na kutambula kasirise. Nnaggalawo enzigi n'amaanyi emabega wange, nga neetaaga nnyo obwerere okumaliriza olutalo. Bwe nnasigala nzekka, nnafukamira ne nsaba nti: “Mukama, nsunguwadde. Njagala kusunguwala. Era mu bwesimbu, ndowooza nnina ensonga ennungi. Naye mmanyi nti sisaanira kukigondera, era njagala obuwanguzi. Ensonga eno yonna ngikuwa. Siyinza kulwana lutalo luno — Ggwe oteekwa okulunnwanirira. Yesu andokola kaakano.” Nnayogera ebigambo ebyo omutima gwange nga gukyawulira nga gujeemye ddala. Ku bweru, oboolyawo kyalabika ng'ekigambo eky'obulimba kye nnali nnangirira. Ssaawulira nga nnokolebwa okuva mu busungu bwange, era tekyalabika n'akatono ng'ekisoboka nti nnandisobodde. Naye olw'okukkiriza nnanywerera ku mazima, nga nkakata — ne wakati mu kutabukatabuka — nti Mukama yali ayinza era yali andokola kaakano. Awo ne kiryoka kibaawo. Amangwago, obuteefu obwaka ng'enkya ey'ekiseera eky'ebbugumu bwankka. Obukyayi bwange bwonna ne bubula. Obusungu bwange ne busaanuuka. Nnawulira nga siriiko kufaayo era nga nsanyufu ng'ekinyonyi mu musana, nga nsanyukira embeera yennyini eyali eyaakannyiiza akaseera nga tekannaba kuyita. Okukkiriza kwange kwali kukutte ekituufu ekya Katonda: Katonda yali asobola okununula, era yanunula ddala emmeeme eyamwesiga. Nnategeera nga mazima ga kyewuunyo gatya nti ssaali nneetaaga kulwana ntalo zange n'akatono. Mukama yandinnwaniridde, era nnayinza obutasituka busitufu. Okuva ku lunaku olwo, entalo ez'ekika ekyo ebikumi zaalwanibwa — ne ziwangulwa — ku lwange Omuduumizi w'Obulokozi bwange. Ekyama kye nnayiga olwo, eky'okuteeka olutalo lwonna mu mikono gye n'okuvaayo ku bbali okumuganya okulwana, tekyalemererwa n'omulundi gumu bwe nkikola. Kyeyeeraze emirundi n'emirundi okuba obujulizi obulamu obw'ebigambo bya Kristo nti: “Musanyuke — Nywangudde ensi.” Ye yagiwangula — si ffe — era bulijjo aligiwangula, singa tunaawaayo ensonga mu mikono gye. Tewali mulundi na gumu, bwe nnakola kino, lwe nnanyiizibwa. Kya mazima ga kitiibwa — wadde ng'abatono nnyo be balabika okukitegeera — nti asobola okulokola ddala abo abajja eri Katonda ku bubwe, kubanga abeera omulamu emirembe gyonna okubawolereza. Yali asobola bwe waawandiikibwa Ebbaluwa eri Abaebbulaniya, era asobola bwe kimu ne kaakano, kubanga si mufu — akyali mulamu okutuwolereza. Nnali nzudde nti okukkiriza kwe tteeka erifuga obwengula. Katonda yayogera, ne kikolebwa; era bwe twesiga ye, naffe tuyinza okwogera, ne kikolebwa. Ekitangaala ekiggya ekimasamasa kyaka ku bigambo ebiri mu 1 Yokaana 5:14–15: “Buno bwe bugumu bwe tulina mu ye: nti bwe tusaba ekintu kyonna nga bw'ayagala, atuwulira. Era bwe tumanya nti atuwulira, kyonna kye tusaba, tumanya nti tulina kye tumusabye.” Bulijjo nnalowoozanga nti ebigambo bwe bityo byali birowoozo birungi byokka — biroota ebimasamasa eby'obulamu obwa Kikristaayo omuntu yenna ow'amagezi bye yandisuubidde okufunako ku nsi. Naye kaakano nnalaba nti tebyali biroota n'akatono, wabula bigambo bya butereevu eby'etteeka erya Katonda: etteeka ery'okukkiriza, ery'amazima era eryesigika ng'etteeka ery'okusika kw'ensi, singa omuntu akitegeera. Kristo atugamba emirundi n'emirundi nti kiritubeerera ng'okukkiriza kwaffe bwe kuli, era alangirira awatali kukoma nti byonna bisoboka eri oyo akkiriza. Nnali nteebereza nti kuno kwali kwongera kwa bunyonyi. Kaakano nnategeera: yali annyonnyola bunnyonnyozi amateeka ag'obwakabaka obw'omwoyo — amateeka omuntu yenna g'ayinza okugezesa n'okukakasa. Okukkiriza kutuyunga ku maanyi ga Katonda ag'amaanyi gonna, ne kisoboka obunafu bwaffe okusika obwerere ku maanyi ge. Ebisoboka byakwo byalabika ng'ebitakoma. “Okukkiriza, okukkiriza okw'amaanyi, kulaba ekisuubizo Ne kutunuulira ekyo kyokka; Kusekerera ebitasoboka, Ne kuleekaana nti, 'Kirikolebwa.'” Nnandyagadde okugamba nti okuva mu kaseera ako okugenda mu maaso nnabeeranga bulijjo mu maanyi g'etteeka lino erya Katonda. Sikoze bwe ntyo. Naye nsobola okugamba kino: buli lwe nsalawo mu bugenderevu okukwata ku maanyi ga Katonda olw'okukkiriza, amaanyi ge gatuukirizibbwa mu bunafu bwange, era mbadde muwanguzi. Emirundi n'emirundi nsobodde okuddamu ebigambo by'omutume eby'obuwanguzi nti: “Mu bino byonna tuli basingirira ddala ku oyo eyatwagala.”

fields.title: Kwali Kuzuula, So si Kutuukako
fields.body_html:
Nate njagala okuddamu okukiraga bulungi ddala: ekyanjijira kwali kuzuula, si kutuukako. Ssaafuuka mangu mukazi asinga obulungi. Nnategeera bumbunte nti Kristo yali Mulokozi asinga obulungi ennyo okusinga bwe nnali ndowoozezza. Ssaali nsobola kuwangula kukemebwa kwange okusinga bwe nnali edda — naye nnali nzudde nti ye yali asobola, era nga yeetegese, okukuwangula ku lwange. Ssaalina magezi na butuukirivu bwange nze nnyini, naye nnali njize ku nkomerero nti ye yali ayinza okunfuukira ddala — nga bw'Omutume yalangirira — amagezi, obutuukirivu, okutukuzibwa, n'okununulibwa.

Sirijjerabira omulundi ogusooka lwe nnazuula nti kino tekyali kigambo kirungi kyokka, wabula kya mazima, ekikola.

Nga tewannayita bbanga ddene nga naaka ntandika okukwata okujjuvu kw'obulokozi bwa Kristo, nnategeera nti waaliwo omuntu eyali ampakanya nnyo naddala eyali ajja okubeera mu nnyumba yaffe wiiki bbiri. Bulijjo yali ansunguwaza era nga muzibu. Ekiseera bwe kyasembera, nnawulira nga nkakasa nti singa nnamuyisa mu ngeri ey'obu Kristo, nnandyetaaze obugumiikiriza obungi ennyo okusinga bwe nnalina bulijjo.

Nga nkyali muggya mu bulamu obw'okukkiriza, nnateebereza nti ekkubo lyokka ery'okufuna obugumiikiriza obumala kwali kubuwakanira mu kusaba. Ennaku zange zaali za mirimu mingi nnyo, kyennava nsalawo okuwaayo ekiro kyonna eri okulwanagana kuno okw'omwoyo. Ab'omu maka bwe baagenda okwebaka, nneesibira mu kisenge kyange, ne nzireeta essowaani ya bisukaali singa nnaalumwa enjala, ne mfukamira ku kitanda kyange nga nneetegese olutalo olw'ekiro kyonna. Nnawulira ng'omuzira, kubanga essaawa ennyingi mu kusaba bulijjo zaankooyanga; naye olwokubanga nnali nneetaaga nnyo etterekero ery'obugumiikiriza, nnalowooza nti kuno kwe kkubo lyokka ery'okulufuna. Nnasuubira ekintu ekifaanana “ekifunfugu” ekinene eky'obugumiikiriza okuteekebwa mu mutima gwange — etterekero mwe nnandimenyereddeko ebitundu buli lwe nnaakyetaaga.

Naye amaviivi gange bwe gaali gaakakwata wansi, Ekyawandiikibwa ekimanyiddwa ne kimyansa mu birowoozo byange: “Naye ku bwe muli mu Kristo Yesu, eyafuuka gye tuli okuva eri Katonda amagezi, n'obutuukirivu, n'okutukuzibwa, n'okununulibwa… oyo eyeenyumiriza, yeenyumirize mu Mukama.”

“Yee!” nnaleekaana munda. “Era ekyo kiteekwa okuli n'obugumiikiriza nakyo!”

Amangwago nnasituka okuva ku maviivi gange n'obugumu obutuukiridde nti ssaali nneetaaga kukuŋŋaanya tterekero lya bugumiikiriza olubereberye. Mu kifo ky'ekyo, nnayinza obutunuulira Mukama olw'ebiweebwa eby'okaakano buli obwetaavu lwe bwajjanga. Nnalaba Kristo ng'etterekero eddene, eritaggwaawo, erisimattuse bulijjo, erijjudde bulijjo — eriwaayo ekisa kyennyini ekyetaagisa mu kaseera kennyini we kaali keetaagisa. Era amangwago kyalabika ng'ekitaliimu makulu okunneetikkanga ebisawo eby'ekisa mu nsawo zange ez'omwoyo, ebyo — ne bwe nnandibisobodde okubikuŋŋaanya — byandibuze mu kaseera kennyini we nnaali mbyetaagira ennyo.

Nga bwe kisuubirwa, okukkiriza okwo kwaddibwamu ddala. Omugenyi wange yeeraga okuba asunguwaza okusinga bulijjo, naye obugumiikiriza ne bunjijira buli kaseera ne kaseera — bulijjo obumala ddala olw'akaseera akaliwo.

Ekyewuunyisa okusinga obugumiikiriza bwennyini kwali kwe kuzuula kwe nnali nkoze: etterekero ery'ekisa kya Katonda lisimattuse bulijjo, era ebiweebwa bye bibeerawo bulijjo eri abaana be.

Abantu abamu bandiyita obugumiikiriza bwange “kutuukako.” Naye nnali situuseeko kintu. Nnali nzudde bumbunte ekiweebwa kya Katonda ne nkikwata olw'okukkiriza, essaawa ku ssaawa, nga buli ssaawa bwe yeetaaga.

Bwe kikendeezebwa ku ngeri yaakyo esingira ddala okuba ennyangu, okuzuula kwange kwe kuno: Mu Kristo mulimu ekiweebwa ekituukiridde eri buli bwetaavu, era okukkiriza kwokka kwe mukutu ekiweebwa ekyo kwe kiyita. Okulwanagana tekuyinza kukireeta. Okuwakanira tekuyinza kukireeta. Okweraliikirira n'okubonaabona tebiyinza kukireeta. Okukkiriza bulijjo kunaakireeta. Okukkiriza bulijjo kukikola.

Kirabika ng'okutegeera okwangu bwe kutyo — omuntu yandilowoozezza nti omukkiriza yenna asoma Baibuli yandikimanyi amangwago. Naye nze ssaakimanya, ne nga wayiseewo emyaka mwenda egy'okuyiga okw'obwegendereza n'okufuba okw'amaanyi. Era bwe nnakizuula ku nkomerero, kyakyusa obulamu bwange.

Tewaali kya kyama kyonna ku kyo. Tekyali kintu ekyayongerwa ku njiri — kyali makulu ga njiri ag'amazima. Kristo yajja, okusinziira ku Byawandiikibwa, okutuukiriza ebintu ebimu; okuzuula kwange kwali bumbunte nti ye yali ayinza okwesigibwa ddala okubituukiriza. Era bwe kiba nga kya mazima, kale ddala abo abaagala ebintu bino bituukirizibwe basaana okubikwasa Oyo eyeetisse omulimu.

Gye ndi, kino kyalabika — era kikyalabika — nga si kutuukako kwa mwoyo kwa njawulo, wabula magezi ga bulijjo amangu, agakola. Bwe mpangisa omuzimbi okuzimba ennyumba, kiba lwa kubanga amanyi okuzimba nga nze simanyi. Sitwala kumukwasa mulimu ng'ekintu kya “kutuukako” kinene ku lwange — kya magezi bwokka. Bwe ntuuka ku mugga oguwuuma ne nsanga olutindo, sitwala kugusomoka nga kutuukako — nkozesa bumbunte ekyo ekituwereddwa.

Olw'ensonga eno, nsinga okwagala ekigambo birabo okusinga kutuukako. Okutuukako kutegeeza omulimu gwange n'okufuba kwange; naye ebisa ebya Kikristaayo birabo bya bwereere okuva eri Katonda. Abo “abafuga mu bulamu” si abo abalinnya ku ntikko ennene olw'okufuba kwabwe, wabula abo abaweebwa ekisa ekingi n'ekirabo eky'obutuukirivu. Obanga Katonda teyalekayo Mwana we, wabula yamuwaayo ku lwaffe ffenna, alitulema atya okutuwa n'ebintu byonna awamu naye ku bwa buwa?

Okuzuula nti ebintu byonna mazima byaffe si kutuukako — kwe kuzuula okw'ekitiibwa. Era emmeeme yonna ezuula obugagga bwe butyo yandibuze ddala amagezi ag'obutakwata ku kyonna ky'eyetaaga.

Tewali malayika ayinza kunnyonnyola bulungi okuzuula kuno kye kwantegeeza. Naye kimala okugamba nti obulamu bwakyusibwa. Awo okuwaŋŋulwa n'okulemererwa we kwafuganga edda, obuwanguzi n'okuwangula ne bufuuka obumanyirivu bwange obwa buli lunaku era obwa buli ssaawa — buli lwe nnasalawo okubikwata olw'okukkiriza. Ssaali nate muddu wa kibi, awalirizibwa okukigondera ne bwe nnakikyawanga, wabula nnali nnyingidde mu ddembe Kristo ly'awa, nga sikyasibiddwa njegere enkadde.

Nnali neerowoozezza nga musanyufu edda, naye kaakano essanyu lyange lyali lisukka ebigambo. Oluusi kyandabikira nti n'Eggulu lyennyini teryandiyinzizza kuwa kisingawo. Songa essanyu lino teryali lisibuka mu nze, so si mu kutuukako kwange kwonna — kubanga ssaalina n'akamu. Lyali ssanyu mu Mukama.

Nnategeera, ku nkomerero, ebigambo bya nnabbi nti: “Ow'amagezi aleme kwenyumiriza mu magezi ge, newaakubadde ow'amaanyi mu maanyi ge, newaakubadde omugagga mu bugagga bwe; naye oyo eyeenyumiriza, yeenyumirize mu kino: nti antegeera era ammanyi.”

Ssaalina magezi, ssaalina maanyi, ssaalina bugagga mu nze — naye nnali njiga okumanya Mukama, era mu ye nnayinza okwenyumiriza n'omutima gwange gwonna.

“Kale okwenyumiriza kuli ludda wa?” bw'abuuza Omutume.

“Kuggyiddwawo… olw'etteeka ery'okukkiriza.”

Emmeeme etaliiko kutuukako teyinza kwenyumiriza mu yo yennyini; era emmeeme efuna byonna bwa buwa okuva eri Mukama teyinza butenyumiriza mu ye.

“Kubanga olw'ekisa mwalokolebwa olw'okukkiriza… si ku bwammwe… si lwa bikolwa, omuntu yenna aleme okwenyumiriza.”

“Tebaafuna nsi na kitala kyabwe, so n'omukono gwabwe tegwabalokola; wabula omukono gwo ogwa ddyo, ai Mukama, n'ekitangaala eky'amaaso go.”

Buno bwe bwali obumanyirivu bwange. Era n'omutima gwange gwonna nnayinza okuddamu ebigambo bya Muzabbuli nti: “Mu Katonda mwe twenyumiririza olunaku lwonna, era tutendereza Erinnya lye emirembe gyonna.”
